current_method:
INPUTS (engine/inputs.py:build_features): Assembles a business-day aligned DataFrame from Yahoo adjusted-close prices (store.read('yahoo', ...)), FRED latest-revision data (no ALFRED vintage pinning — per engine/equity_alloc.py:220, ALFRED is flagged as Phase 3 work), NY Fed EFFR/H41, OFR FSI, Treasury TGA/withheld taxes, CBOE GEX/SKEW, and SP500 breadth. FRED monthly series (payrolls, INDPRO, WEI, GDPNow, sticky CPI) are forward-filled up to 60-95 business days. A manual per-leg publication-delay lag is applied only in the macro-risk score (equity_alloc.py:223), NOT in the regime classifier itself.

AXIS SCORING (engine/axes.py + indicators.py):
- slope_z(s, sw=20, bw=60): drift = rolling(20).mean(log_diff); vol = rolling(60).std(log_diff); z = drift / (vol / sqrt(20)). This is a t-stat of 20d drift vs 60d vol — a first-derivative (rate-of-change) signal, NOT a second derivative (acceleration of rate of change).
- score_from_z(z, threshold=0.45): maps to {-1, 0, +1}; scores 0 if |z| < 0.45.
- GROWTH axis (10 components): copper_gold(w=1), xly_xlp(w=1), us2y_direction(w=0.5), iwm_spy(w=1), cyclical_defensive=XLI+XLB+XLF+XLY vs XLP+XLU+XLV(w=1), breadth_direction pct>50dma(w=1), payrolls_trend sign of 63d change(w=0.5), indpro_trend sign of 252d change(w=0.5), wei_trend sign of 65d change(w=0.5), gdpnow_trend sign of 63d change(w=0.5). Total weight sum = 7.0; effective full-weight market legs = 6 of those. Econ confirmers enter as monthly_sign() (binary sign of n-period change), not slope_z.
- INFLATION axis (7 components): breakeven_10y(w=1), breakeven_5y5y(w=1), energy_rs XLE/SPY(w=1), oil(w=1), infl_basket=(XLE+XLB)/(XLK+XLU)(w=1), tips_nominal_spread(w=0.75), sticky_cpi_3m direction(w=0.5).
- axis_score = weighted mean of available component scores (fillna=0 for unavailable, renormalized by available weight sum). confidence = |axis_score| * agreement, zeroed when n_comp < 3.
- LIVE OUTPUT (2026-06-29): growth_score=+0.20 confidence=0.125 (coin-flip territory), inflation_score=-0.52 confidence=0.416. WEI and xly_xlp/cyc_def are contradicting the growth axis.

QUAD ASSIGNMENT (engine/regime.py:29-34): raw_quad(g, i) = argmax over 4 boxes: G>=0 & I<0 -> Q1, G>=0 & I>=0 -> Q2, G<0 & I<0 -> Q4, G<0 & I>=0 -> Q3. Hard 0-boundary argmax, no probability.

HYSTERESIS (regime.py:41-76): State machine requiring new quad to hold hysteresis_days=7 consecutive days, OR a single-day shock: axis disagreeing with confirmed quad shows |score| >= shock_override_z=0.85. Implemented by iterating row-by-row over the full daily series. Pending countdown exposed in output.

REFINEMENTS (regime.py:153-159): recession = Q4 AND hy_oas > 5.0% AND hy_oas.diff(20) > 0. inflation_shock = Q3 AND expanding_percentile(inflation_score) >= 0.90 (no-lookahead expanding window, min 252 obs).

LIQUIDITY OVERLAY (regime.py:100-113): net_liquidity = WALCL - RRP - TGA (all $bn), 3-bd lagged, 20d RoC compared against +/-$25bn thresholds -> {expanding, neutral, contracting}. Optional debounce (persist_days, defaults 0). Currently: contracting.

CYCLE TAG (regime.py:116-134): 2s10s curve change over 60d vs inversion history (252d min, 60d min_periods); HY OAS 2y percentile rank; SPY 60d proximity; breadth 20d change. Labels: {early, mid, late}. Currently: mid.

TRANSITION FLAGS (engine/transition.py:20-82): 6 independent binary flags — (1) breadth/price: SPY within 2% of 60d high AND pct>50dma fell >10pts over 20d; (2) credit/equity: SPY +20d ret positive AND HY OAS z-score >1.0 over 252d; (3) ratio inflection: xly_xlp or sphb_splv 50d slope sign flip against quad stance; (4) inflation basket: infl_basket 50d slope inflecting against quad's inflation assumption; (5) confidence decay: dominant-axis agreement diff(10d) < -0.10; (6) GEX: net GEX < 0 OR spot within 1% of gamma flip. State machine: >=2 flags -> WEAKENING, >=3 OR pending>0 -> TRANSITIONING, quad change day -> NEW_REGIME (sticky 5 days). All flags currently false -> STABLE.

RENDER (templates/dashboard.html.j2:1489-1548): 2x2 quadrant mini-map highlights the active cell; headline regime name from latest.json; tooltip explains the 4 quads; hysteresis note ('7 straight days') shown inline. Confidence, transition state, confirming/contradicting lists rendered downstream in the same template.

TUNING (scripts/tune.py): grid search over z_threshold in [0.25, 0.35, 0.45], hysteresis_days in [5,7,9], shock_override_z in [0.7,0.85], us2y_weight in [0.5,1.0], scored against 5 criteria: whipsaw%, 2008 Q4 share, 2022 Q3 share, 2021H1 Q2 share, Covid flip lag. NO out-of-sample hold-out; tuning is done over the full history.
data_sources: Yahoo Finance adjusted-close prices (store.read('yahoo', ...)): SPY, IWM, XLY, XLP, XLE, XLK, XLU, XLF, XLI, XLB, HYG, LQD, SPHB, SPLV, RSP, QQQ, IJH, IWF, IWD, CL=F, HG=F, GC=F, DX-Y.NYB, VIX, VIX3M, VIX9D, MOVE, ZQ=F — LATEST revision, never vintage-pinned

gaps: L1 — NO base-effect determinism: the engine computes first-derivative slope-z of current price/economic levels, NOT the forward-path YoY second derivative driven by the deterministic base-period. The INDPRO component uses sign(252d change) which is a level-YoY direction, but there is zero code that projects the forward base-period path or computes the sign of the second derivative of the YoY rate. The Hedgeye edge — that tough comps known 12 months ahead deterministically bend the forward YoY — is entirely absent.

L1 — All FRED data is latest-revision, not point-in-time vintage. ALFRED integration is explicitly deferred (engine/equity_alloc.py:220: 'real fix is ALFRED vintages, Phase 3'). The regime classifier itself has no publication-lag offsets, only the downstream macro-risk score approximates this with manual LEG_LAGS constants. Backtest performance is therefore overstated vs any live forward period on economic data legs.

L1 — No mixed-frequency Dynamic Factor Model or Kalman-state growth/inflation distribution. The 4 econ confirmers (payrolls, INDPRO, WEI, GDPNow) enter as binary sign signals, not as a coherent mixed-frequency nowcast with variance. Each is treated independently with equal weight halving. There is no ADS cross-check, no DFM state vector, no posterior uncertainty propagation.

L2 — Regime assignment is hard argmax (raw_quad at the 0-boundary), not continuous Markov-switching probabilities. P(Quad_k) does not exist. There is no HMM, no Hamilton (1989) filter, no Kim-Nelson smoother, no transition matrix P(Q_j next | Q_i now), no time-in-regime hazard function. Confidence is a heuristic product |score| * agreement, not a proper posterior probability.

L2 — Liquidity and monetary policy stance are bolt-on overlays appended after quad assignment, not integrated as third/fourth axes in the regime space. The growth and inflation axes implicitly embed some liquidity signal (breakevens, energy_rs, us2y) but there is no explicit policy-stance score that enters the argmax.

L3 — No conditional expected-value engine. There is no computation of regime-conditional forward return distributions mu_{a,k} estimated on PIT regime labels and integrated over P(Quad_k). The sector_preferences dict in config.yml (Q1: [XLK, XLC, XLY, QUAL] etc.) is a textbook prior, not a measured, backtest-validated expected-value ranker. There is no E[r_a] = sum_k P(Quad_k)*mu_{a,k}*intensity_k calculation anywhere in the engine.

L3 — No intensity weighting of the quad. Confidence (|score|*agreement) exists but is not used to weight expected-value estimates or to size positions. A coin-flip growth score (+0.20, conf=0.125) is treated identically to a high-conviction read in the downstream playbook.

L4 — Vol surface is close-to-close RV only in the regime classifier. The vol_regime.py (separate subsystem) has HAR-RV and a VRP leg, but these are NOT fed into the growth/inflation axis scoring or the quad confidence. The regime engine has no conditional quantile forecast (skewed-t GARCH forward range), no measurable coverage check, and no regime-transition-conditional cone widening.

L4 — The HAR vol forecast in vol_forecast.py is equal-weight multi-lag blend without a fitted regression: 'equal-scale blend; the Phase-0 harness reports its forward-RV R²' suggests the regression is aspirational/display, not actually fitted in the code (cone_vol_ann is a simple mean of RV at 4 lags with no coefficients).

L5 — Mechanical flow front-running is fragmentary and outside the regime classifier. GEX enters only as a binary transition flag (net_gex < 0 OR spot within 1% of flip). Vol-control roll-off schedule (high-vol days aging out of trailing window) is not computed. CTA trend-flip levels are not computed. ETF create/redeem flow is not tracked.

L6 — No DSR, PBO, or purged K-fold CV on the regime classifier itself. scripts/tune.py performs a grid search over the full 1971-2026 history with no hold-out set — the 5 scoring criteria (2008, 2022, 2021, Covid) are drawn from the same in-sample data that set the thresholds. The calibrate_regime.py script covers only the BTC regime, not the main quad. No expectancy, profit-factor, or rank-IC scorecard exists for the quad labels against forward asset-class returns.

L6 — The tuning grid (scripts/tune.py) has only 3*3*2*2 = 36 combinations with no statistical significance testing on the objective improvement. Episode-fidelity scoring is hand-picked on known crises (selection bias). No block bootstrap CI on any regime metric.

L7 — No HRP, Black-Litterman, or vol-target/CVaR portfolio construction driven by regime. The playbook (engine/playbook.py) produces narrative recommendations and a sector heat table but no mechanically constructed, drawdown-budgeted portfolio. There is no gross/net leverage dial driven by quad intensity. The macro_risk score penalizes heat scores but is display-only by the code's own annotation.

upgrades.title: Base-effect deterministic forward projection for growth and inflation axes
upgrades.spec: Add engine/base_effect.py. For each monthly series (INDPRO, sticky_cpi_3m, core_cpi, core_pce): (a) compute the trailing 12-month base path (already stored); (b) project the YoY rate at +1, +2, +3 quarters assuming flat sequential momentum (zero monthly change) and under realized-momentum scenarios (+/-0.5 sigma of trailing 6m average monthly change); (c) sign of the second derivative of the projected YoY path = the deterministic quad-direction signal. Store as base_effect_growth and base_effect_inflation columns, each in {-1, 0, +1}. Feed into axes.py as display-only context columns (not scored in v1, validated in v2). No new data required — all series already in build_features(). Write a forward-grading log (append base_effect_growth_fwd.jsonl) to measure directional accuracy at +63/+126d.
deps: inputs.py already loads INDPRO, sticky_cpi, core_cpi, core_pce with correct ffill

upgrades.title: Replace latest-revision FRED with publication-lag offsets in the regime classifier
upgrades.spec: In engine/inputs.py:build_features(), apply the same LEG_LAGS pattern already proven in engine/equity_alloc.py:223. Specifically: (1) payrolls: shift 22 bdays after the 'reference month last day' stamp (use a mapping table indexed by PAYEMS vintage date, or conservatively add .shift(22) after ffill); (2) INDPRO: shift 30 bdays; (3) WEI: shift 5 bdays (weekly release Thursday); (4) sticky_cpi_3m: shift 30 bdays; (5) GDPNow: already a daily Atlanta Fed number with 0 lag. Add a config key engine.scoring.econ_pub_lags dict. Full ALFRED vintages are Phase 3; these conservative static lags remove the worst look-ahead for near-zero cost. Unit test: verify that the 2008 Q4 share and 2022 Q3 share are not significantly worse with the lags applied.

upgrades.title: Continuous regime probabilities via Markov-switching model
upgrades.spec: Add engine/regime_hmm.py. Fit a 4-state Gaussian HMM (using hmmlearn or statsmodels MarkovRegression) over the [growth_score, inflation_score] series in regime_history.parquet, with the Hamilton (1989) EM estimator. Output: (a) P(Quad_k | data_t) for k in {Q1,Q2,Q3,Q4} each day — a proper posterior; (b) transition matrix A[i,j] = P(Q_j next | Q_i now) from the fitted model; (c) expected time-in-regime as 1/(1-A[i,i]). Store in data/regime/hmm_latest.json and append to latest.json as regime_probs dict. Gate with enabled flag in config so existing argmax path is untouched. Validate: the HMM posterior should cluster more tightly during the well-known 2008 and 2022 episodes. Use a fixed train/test split (train through 2019, evaluate 2020-2026).

upgrades.title: Regime-conditional expected-value ranker for sectors/ETFs
upgrades.spec: Add engine/regime_ev.py. Using regime_history.parquet quad labels + Yahoo SPY/sector ETF returns: (1) for each asset a and quad k, estimate mu_{a,k} = mean(fwd_Nd_return | quad==k) for N in [21, 63, 126] using PIT regime labels (shift labels by hysteresis_days to avoid any overlap with the label's confirmation window); (2) compute CVaR_{a,k} = mean of worst 10% of fwd returns in that quad; (3) at each build, E[r_a] = sum_k P(Quad_k)*mu_{a,k} where P comes from the HMM posterior (L2) or falls back to argmax P=1; (4) intensity_k = confidence score from regime_history.parquet, used to scale the argmax probability before summing; (5) rank all 11 SPDR sectors + IWM + LQD + GLD by E[r]/CVaR -> the Hubble ranker. Write to data/regime/ev_ranker.json. Feed into the playbook sector heat table as a second column alongside existing RS score. Log each day's mu estimates for the forward-grading audit.
deps: L2 HMM probabilities for the proper posterior; can start with argmax fallback

upgrades.title: Second-derivative axis scoring (acceleration, not just slope direction)
upgrades.spec: In engine/indicators.py, add slope_accel(s, sw, bw): compute slope_z at two lookbacks (sw and 2*sw) and return their difference — this measures whether the drift is accelerating or decelerating, i.e. the second derivative sign. In engine/axes.py, add a second-deriv component for each axis (e.g. growth_accel = slope_accel(copper_gold, 10, 20) and inflation_accel = slope_accel(breakeven_10y, 10, 20)) as display-only columns initially (weight=0 in config, changeable). Expose them in latest.json as growth_accel and inflation_accel. Forward-grade against 63d realized quad persistence: does a negative growth_accel at positive growth_score correctly predict quad flip within 63d? Gate scoring weight increase behind that validation.

upgrades.title: Purged K-fold + episode-locked backtest with Deflated Sharpe on quad labels
upgrades.spec: Add scripts/validate_regime_quad.py. (1) Load regime_history.parquet; (2) for each of the 11 SPDR sectors + IWM + LQD, compute quad-conditional forward 63d returns; (3) run purged K-fold (K=6, embargo=21d matching hmmlearn gap) using the existing engine/validation.py purged_folds(); (4) compute rank-IC (Spearman) between growth_score and fwd 63d equity return, and between inflation_score and fwd 63d TIP return, per fold; (5) report mean IC, t-stat (Newey-West), hit rate, and Deflated Sharpe using engine/validation.py deflated_sharpe() accounting for the n=36 tuning trials from scripts/tune.py (n_trials input to DSR); (6) report separately by realized VIX bucket (<15, 15-25, >25). Write to reports/regime_quad_validation.json. This is the missing honest accounting document for the crown jewel.
deps: engine/validation.py already has purged_folds(), deflated_sharpe(), newey_west_tstat()

upgrades.title: Liquidity and policy stance as explicit scored axes (not post-hoc overlays)
upgrades.spec: In engine/axes.py, add score_axis(f, 'liquidity') and score_axis(f, 'policy'). Liquidity axis: components = net_liquidity_bn 20d RoC z-score, NFCI z-score (already in features), hy_oas 20d change z-score, a2p2_cp_90d level z-score. Policy axis: components = us2y direction (already in growth axis — remove from growth axis on this change), fed_funds vs us2y spread direction, GDPNow vs fed_funds level gap sign, rate_expectations_proxy direction. Each axis produces a score in [-1,1] with confidence. Extend raw_quad() to a 4-dimensional argmax (or keep 2D quad but treat liquidity+policy as multipliers on confidence). Minimum viable version: add the two new axis scores as quad_confidence modifiers — confidence_adj = confidence * (1 - 0.3*abs(liquidity_score) * (sign(liquidity_score) == adverse)) — feeding directly into the existing confidence output field.
deps: net_liquidity_bn, NFCI, hy_oas, a2p2_cp_90d all already in build_features()
L2 HMM useful but not required

upgrades.title: Forward range as conditional quantile forecast (replacing heuristic cone)
upgrades.spec: In engine/vol_forecast.py, add quantile_range(close, horizon, q_lo=0.10, q_hi=0.90). Fit a rolling quantile regression (using numpy.quantile over rolling windows, no external dep) of fwd horizon-day return on har_vol() and current regime confidence score. At each date output the q_lo and q_hi conditional return bounds. Store in latest.json as vol_range: {lo_10pct, hi_90pct, horizon_d, coverage_realized}. Add a coverage tracker: compare the prior N=252 day-ahead forecasts against realized and report empirical coverage in the JSON. This replaces the current cone_vol_ann heuristic (which has no coverage measurement) with a measurable, calibrated range. HAR regression coefficients should be fitted on a rolling 5-year window, not equal-weight, to remove the 'equal-scale blend' bias noted in vol_forecast.py line 8.

upgrades.title: CTA trend-flip levels and vol-control roll-off schedule as explicit mechanical-flow signals
upgrades.spec: Add engine/mechanical_flow.py. (1) CTA trend signal: for SPY, QQQ, IWM, TLT, GLD compute the sign of each of [21d, 63d, 126d, 252d] moving average crossovers; a CTA trend-flip occurs when the majority sign reverses. Flag the flip date and the proximity to flip (current price vs the MA that would trigger) in pct. (2) Vol-control roll-off: take the trailing 21d realized vol window; compute what 1-sigma SPY up day vs 1-sigma down day would do to the 21d realized vol (i.e., which high-vol days are about to age out); output days_to_high_vol_exit = number of sessions until the most extreme day exits the window. A value < 5 and recent vol high = mechanical buying pressure. Store in latest.json as mechanical_flow dict. Both signals are PIT by construction (use only data[t-252:t]).

upgrades.title: Tune.py: add hold-out split and block-bootstrap CI to prevent tuning overfit
upgrades.spec: Modify scripts/tune.py: (1) fix train window to 1971-2014; evaluate scoring criteria ONLY on 2015-2026 hold-out; (2) for the winning combo, add a block bootstrap CI (500 draws, block=504 days = ~2yr) on each criterion using the pattern from engine/validation.py block_bootstrap_ci(); (3) add a DSR calculation using n_trials = len(GRID Q1 * Q2 * Q3 * Q4) = 36; if DSR < 0.90 on the hold-out, print a clear warning that the threshold config is not statistically validated. Write results to reports/tuning_grid_holdout.csv. This is a small code change (~30 lines) that converts a known-overfitting grid search into an honest validation.

upgrades.title: MFD (Mixed-Frequency Dynamic Factor) nowcast replacing independent econ confirmers
upgrades.spec: Add engine/dfm_nowcast.py. Use a simplified Giannone-Reichlin-Small two-step DFM: (1) standardize each monthly/weekly series to zero mean unit variance; (2) estimate one latent factor via PCA on the balanced panel of monthly-frequency series (INDPRO, payrolls, sticky_cpi, WEI resampled to month-end); (3) propagate the Kalman filter forward to today using the unbalanced daily observation (WEI weekly; remaining monthly); (4) output factor_growth (the common growth factor) and factor_inflation (orthogonalized second factor) as continuous scores with posterior variance. These replace the 4 binary monthly_sign() components in axes.py at weight=1.0 each, with the growth factor replacing payrolls_trend+indpro_trend+wei_trend+gdpnow_trend and the inflation factor replacing sticky_cpi_direction. Posterior variance feeds directly into regime confidence as an additive uncertainty term. Validate: the filtered growth factor should lead NBER turning points by 1-3 months on hold-out. Requires: statsmodels or custom Kalman (small, no heavy dep).
deps: L1 publication-lag fix must come first to avoid contaminating the factor
monthly FRED data already in build_features()

one_line_verdict: The quad classifier is a well-engineered first-derivative market-proxy consensus engine with honest hysteresis and additive overlays, but it lacks the three real Hedgeye edges — base-effect forward projection, continuous regime probabilities, and regime-conditional expected-value weighting — and its tuning is done in-sample with no deflated Sharpe, making the crown jewel analytically sound but strategically incomplete.

Quad classification: raw_quad argmax, hysteresis state machine, liquidity overlay

current_method:
**Financial Conditions (conditions.py:86-95):** NFCI level + 5y percentile (1260d window) + 13w change (65d shift). State = loose/neutral/tight via fixed ±0.10 bands. OFR FSI (33-variable daily) + 8 sub-indices percentiled similarly. CP spreads (A2P2, CP-bill) percentiled over 1260d. All latest-revision data, no vintage awareness in the live path.

**Recession Risk Composite (conditions.py:123-166):** Weighted sum (0..100) over 5 available legs, renormalized:
- `recession_prob` (Chauvet-Piger smoothed, w=0.8): RECPROUSM156N from FRED, ffill 70d
- `ebp_recession_prob` (GZ/Fed Board EBP model, w=0.8): ffill 45d
- `curve` (TP-adjusted 2s10s, w=1.0): linear ramp from 0 (slope=0) to 1 (slope=-1.0)
- `ebp_level` (10y expanding pctile of EBP level, w=0.5)
- `claims` PRIMARY LABOR LEG (w=1.0): YoY of 4wk-MA initial claims / 252d shift, clipped 0..1 at 40% YoY; Sahm (SAHMREALTIME) is fallback when claims absent
Thresholds: elevated_score=30, high_score=55. Output: scalar 3.9 currently (low band).

**Growth Nowcast (conditions.py:458-465, inputs.py:182-183):** WEI (Lewis-Mertens-Stock weekly, ffill 10d) + GDPNow (Atlanta Fed, ffill 95d). Both consumed as point-levels only. Trend = sign of 65d change of WEI. No 2nd-derivative computation, no base-effect projection, no forward-path distribution. Current output: WEI=2.5 (falling), GDPNow=2.54%.

**Labor Nowcast (conditions.py:172-205, inputs.py:251-264):** Initial claims 4wk-MA (ICSA/IC4WSA, ffill 10d); claims YoY = level/level.shift(252)-1; claims z-score vs 3y rolling (756d); Indeed Hiring Lab postings index (IHLIDXUS, ffill 14d); 3m change = postings/postings.shift(63)-1; Treasury withheld taxes (daily flow, no ffill, 63d rolling sum, YoY of that sum over 252d). Vote-count to produce "labor firm/cooling/mixed" label (2-of-3 votes).

**Inflation Nowcast (conditions.py:498-517, inputs.py:185-191):** Atlanta sticky CPI (STICKCPIM157SFRBATL) + flexible CPI (FLEXCPIM157SFRBATL), both monthly, ffill 45d, already annualized %. Smoothed via 3-month rolling mean of distinct monthly prints. Persistent/transitory read = sticky_ann vs flexible_ann comparison. No forward projection, no base-effect computation, no distributional output.

**Business Cycle Model (business_cycle.py:51-150):** Conference-Board style. Leading tier (8 legs: mfg hours, initial claims, building permits, cap-goods orders, SPY, HY OAS, T10Y3M, UMich), Coincident (4: payrolls, real income ex-transfer, mfg/trade sales, INDPRO), Lagging (5: unemp duration, inventory/sales, C&I loans, prime rate, CPI services). Each leg: monthly resample (mean for daily/weekly; last for monthly), log-diff or plain-diff, causal rolling z over 120 months (min 36m), sign-flip for counter-cyclical legs. Mean of available legs -> cumulative index rebased 100. 6m momentum (roc_window_m from config), EMA trend (trend_smooth_m), diffusion = share of legs rising over 6m. Recession signal: 3 D's = depth (mom6 < calibrated roc_threshold) AND breadth (diffusion <= diffusion_max) held min_consecutive_m=3 months. Validated vs NBER: ~7 recessions, ~3 PIT (ALFRED). Publication lag: monthly legs shifted 1m in backtest only; live path uses whatever FRED has published. NFCI family excluded from ALFRED (whole history re-revises; API times out).

**Drawdown Risk (conditions.py:280-292):** 4 legs z-scored (1260d causal rolling) then averaged: recession_risk, NFCI, EBP, HY OAS. Expanding pctile (*100) -> 0..100 gauge. Bands: elevated>=60, high>=80, extreme>=90. Measured: >=80 -> P(>=10% dd/63d) ~45% vs 13% base (own backtest). Labeled "lagging" — lags price. Current output: score=15.5 (low band).

**Risk Appetite / VRP (conditions.py:207-278):** VRP = VIX - 21d realized vol annualized (SPY pct_change rolling std * sqrt(252) * 100). VRP pctile over 2y (504d). VIX term structure = VIX/VIX3M. RORO = equal-weight mean z-score (252d window) of 7 legs: VIX (negated), HY OAS (negated), SKEW (negated), VIX term (negated), NFCI (negated), copper/gold (positive), DXY 20d pct-change (negated). Vol-target scalar = 12% / 21d realized vol, clipped 0.5..1.5.

**MRS (conditions.py:750-784):** Weighted mean over 5 legs: recession (w=1.0), drawdown (w=1.0), nfci (w=0.5, only when tightening + NFCI>0), liquidity (w=0.5, binary: contracting=1), transition state (w=0.25, TRANSITIONING/NEW_REGIME=1.0, WEAKENING=0.5). All renormalized over available legs. Current: 0.2135 (low).

**Point-in-time status:** ALFRED vintage infrastructure EXISTS (collectors/fred.py:139-210, as_of_series(), load_vintages()) and is used in calibrate_regime.py and validate_claims_recession_pit.py, BUT the LIVE ENGINE (inputs.py, conditions.py, business_cycle.py) reads latest-revision FRED data exclusively. The vintage data is only consumed in offline validation scripts. NFCI is explicitly excluded from vintages (whole-history re-revision). WEI/GDPNow have vintages registered but the live path ignores them.

gaps: No base-effect / 2nd-derivative logic anywhere: WEI and GDPNow are consumed as point-levels; their YoY denominators are fully known 12 months ahead but never exploited. The system has no deterministic forward-path projection of where YoY growth or inflation MUST go given known base effects, which is the core Hedgeye edge (L1).

Vintage data infrastructure exists (as_of_series, ALFRED vintages.parquet) but the live engine — inputs.py, conditions.py, business_cycle.py — reads only latest-revision FRED values. The regime quad backtests and business_cycle recession signal operate on revised data for most series. This overstates precision: NFCI re-revises its whole history, claims re-revises week-by-week, sticky/flex CPI re-revises on methodology changes. The ALFRED gap is acknowledged in comments but not closed in any live scored path.

No continuous regime probabilities: regime.py uses discrete argmax (raw_quad = G>=0/G<0 x I>=0/I<0) with hysteresis. No Markov-switching, no HMM, no P(Quad_k) distribution. The confidence score (axes weight-averaged |score|) is not a probability; there is no transition matrix P(Quad_j | Quad_i), no time-in-regime hazard, no regime-change early warning via transition probability.

No forward projection or forward-path distribution for growth or inflation: the system has no out-of-sample Q+1 or Q+2 nowcast. GDPNow is just forwarded-filled for 95 days as a stale level. There is no mixed-frequency Dynamic Factor Model, no Kalman filter, no MIDAS regression, no forward-path cone. The ADS coincident index and NY Fed nowcast are not ingested.

No conditional expected-value engine (L3): there is no per-asset/per-sector mu_{a,k} estimated on PIT regime labels, no E[r_a] = sum_k P(Quad_k) * mu_{a,k} * intensity_k computation. The regime quad feeds allocation prose and a sector display, but there is no regime-conditional return ranking across assets. The MRS is a risk-level gauge, not a conditional return ranker.

No vol surface or forward vol computation: VRP = VIX minus 21d close-to-close realized vol only. No Yang-Zhang OHLC estimator, no HAR-RV, no IV skew decomposition (25d risk reversal), no term-structure slope from IV surface, no dispersion, no IV-RV premium decomposition. The vol-target scalar uses the same 21d window as the VRP realized leg (conditions.py:274-278).

No quantile / distributional risk-range: the drawdown_risk gauge outputs a scalar 0..100 and an unconditional P(dd>=10%/63d) estimate from backtest bands. There is no conditional quantile forecast, no skewed-t GARCH forward range, no coverage-validated interval. The forward 'range' is entirely absent.

Inflation nowcast reads are purely current-level: sticky vs flexible CPI comparison gives a persistent/transitory label but no direction projection. No base-effect path for CPI/PCE (knowing last year's monthly prints exactly determines the hard part of the YoY path). No Cleveland model forecast integration beyond level read.

MRS liquidity leg is binary (contracting=1, else=0) based on a qualitative label from the regime layer, not a quantitative measure of net liquidity impulse size. No differentiation between a mild QT drag vs a large TGA drawdown shock.

No DSR/PBO/Deflated Sharpe on any of the conditions signals: the capitulation gauge cites measured bounce probabilities from own backtest (conditions.py:612-616) but without purged K-fold, without PBO, without profit-factor or expectancy. The drawdown_risk band probabilities (8/26/36/38%) are stated as measured but the methodology is not validated with embargo CV.

Business cycle model effective N is tiny (7 modern recessions, ~3 PIT) and the calibrated signal thresholds (roc_threshold, diffusion_max) are tuned on that tiny sample. The calibration JSON acknowledges overfit risk but there is no Deflated Sharpe or PBO guard. The 'measured' lead times are upper bounds (revised data for most leading legs since NFCI is excluded from ALFRED).

No mechanical-flow front-running layer integrated with the conditions output: the GEX flip strike and vol-control roll-off schedule exist as display columns (inputs.py:303-311) but are not connected to the conditions/regime nowcast or to position sizing. CTA trend-flip levels and ETF create/redeem flow are absent.

upgrades.title: Base-effect forward path for growth & inflation (L1)
upgrades.spec: Add engine/base_effect.py. Inputs: monthly YoY series for WEI, GDPNow (or CPIAUCSL as proxy), STICKCPIM, FLEXCPIM — read from the ALFRED store (as_of_series from collectors/fred.py already exists). Algorithm: (1) Compute the known 12-month base sequence b_t = x_{t-12} for the next 4 quarters. (2) Fit a sequential-momentum model: dx_t ~ AR(1) on the deseasonalized MoM series, estimated causally to today. (3) Project: x_{t+k}^{YoY} = (level_t * (1 + momentum)^k / level_{t-12+k}) - 1. (4) The 2nd derivative sign = sign(x_{t+1}^{YoY} - x_t^{YoY}). Output: {'growth_2nd_deriv': +1/-1, 'inflation_2nd_deriv': +1/-1, 'growth_base_path': [q1..q4], 'inflation_base_path': [q1..q4], 'base_forcing_pct': float}. Add to conditions_snapshot under 'growth_nowcast.forward' and 'inflation_nowcast.forward'. The 2nd-deriv signs then feed L2 (regime probability). Config: base_effect block in config.yml under engine.conditions.
deps: WEI/GDPNow vintage series already registered in config.yml

upgrades.title: Continuous regime probabilities via Markov-switching (L2)
upgrades.spec: Add engine/regime_ms.py using statsmodels MarkovRegression (already a dep candidate) or a pure-numpy 2-state Hamilton filter. State vector: [growth_score, inflation_score] from engine/axes.py (already computed daily). Model: 2-dimensional 4-state MS-AR(1) over the two axis scores, fit causally on expanding window (re-estimate quarterly). Output per day: P(Q1), P(Q2), P(Q3), P(Q4) summing to 1.0, plus a 4x4 transition matrix and time-in-regime hazard. Persist to data/regime/regime_probs.parquet. Expose in conditions_snapshot as 'regime_probs': {Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4}. Add base-effect 2nd-derivative as an exogenous regressor to improve out-of-sample Q transitions. This replaces the argmax confidence score (conditions.py currently has no direct probability output — regime.py:29-34 is pure argmax). Config: add engine.regime_ms block (n_states=4, refit_days=63).

upgrades.title: Conditional expected-return ranker per asset/sector (L3)
upgrades.spec: Add engine/conditional_ev.py. Inputs: (a) P(Quad_k) from L2 regime_ms.py; (b) realized forward returns per asset (SPY, IWM, QQQ, GLD, TLT, HYG, sector ETFs XL*) from yahoo data already in store; (c) PIT regime labels from data/regime/regime_probs.parquet. Algorithm: for each asset a and quad k, estimate mu_{a,k} = mean forward 63d return on rows where PIT quad==k (expanding window to avoid look-ahead). Then E[r_a] = sum_k P(k) * mu_{a,k} * intensity_k where intensity_k = confidence score (axis |mean_score|). Rank assets by E[r] / CVaR_{95}. Emit to data/regime/conditional_ev.json for consumption by allocation pages. Run as part of the nightly build alongside conditions_snapshot. Config: conditional_ev block (horizon_d=63, min_obs_per_quad=20). Note: uses PIT regime labels only after L2 is built.

upgrades.title: ALFRED-gated PIT mode for live nowcast (L1 honesty)
upgrades.spec: In engine/inputs.py, add an optional as_of parameter to build_features(). When as_of is set AND vintages.parquet exists (load_vintages() returns non-None), replace ffill-carried FRED series with as_of_series(sid, as_of, vintages) for the vintage_series list: WEI, GDPNOW, RECPROUSM156N, SAHMREALTIME, STICKCPIM157SFRBATL, FLEXCPIM157SFRBATL, PAYEMS, INDPRO, ICSA, IC4WSA. This makes the live path optionally PIT-clean when FRED_API_KEY is present. Also update conditions_snapshot to tag each output field with 'revised': True/False based on whether the field's source series is in DEFAULT_VINTAGE_SERIES. No change to default behavior (as_of=None falls through to existing latest-revision path).
deps: vintages.parquet populated by collect.py vintage step

upgrades.title: Yang-Zhang realized vol + HAR-RV forward vol surface (L4)
upgrades.spec: In engine/conditions.py conditions_frame(), replace the 21d close-to-close realized vol (line 212-213: spy.pct_change().rolling(21).std()*sqrt(252)*100) with Yang-Zhang: YZ = sqrt(0.5*ln(H/L)^2 - (2ln2-1)*ln(C/C_prev)^2) summed over 21d. Requires reading SPY OHLC from store.read('yahoo','SPY') — inputs.py already loads _VIX OHLC (line 89-90), so SPY OHLC is a one-line extension. Add HAR-RV forward vol: rv_hat_{t+21} = alpha + beta_d*RV_d + beta_w*RV_w + beta_m*RV_m (HAR-RV, Corsi 2009) estimated via OLS on expanding window; emit as 'realized_vol_yz', 'forward_vol_har_21d'. Add VRP decomposition: vrp_level = VIX - rv_yz, vrp_premium = vix/rv_yz - 1. Config: add vrp.yz_open_close_weight=0.5 under engine.conditions.
deps: SPY OHLC in yahoo store (already available via store.read)

upgrades.title: Forward vol quantile forecast with coverage validation (L4)
upgrades.spec: Add engine/vol_cone.py. Use a skewed-t GARCH(1,1) (arch package, already likely installed for vol work) fit on SPY daily returns (expanding, re-fit weekly). Output: 10/25/50/75/90th percentile of forward 21d realized vol. Store empirical coverage (what % of actuals fell inside the 80% interval over trailing 252d) as a coverage audit metric. Emit to conditions_snapshot under 'risk_appetite.forward_vol_cone'. Flag in snapshot when coverage < 70% (cone is miscalibrated). Config: add vol_cone block (horizon_d=21, quantiles=[0.1,0.25,0.5,0.75,0.9], refit_days=5).
deps: L4 Yang-Zhang RV for HAR regressor

upgrades.title: Regime-transition probability as MRS leg (L2->L3 cross)
upgrades.spec: In engine/conditions.py macro_risk_score() and _macro_risk_legs(), replace the binary transition leg (TRANSITIONING=1.0, WEAKENING=0.5, else=0) with P(transition in next 21d) from the L2 Markov model: P_trans = 1 - P(same quad in t+21 | current quad). Wire into _mrs_weights() as the 'transition' leg scalar (replacing the heuristic _mrs_transition_val). This removes the heuristic config knob (transition_high: 1.0 in config.yml line 1722) and makes the transition leg proportional to measured regime-change probability. Add the transition probability to conditions_snapshot['macro_risk']['transition_prob'].
deps: L2 regime_ms.py outputting transition_matrix per day

upgrades.title: PBO + purged K-fold CV on capitulation/drawdown signals (L6)
upgrades.spec: Add scripts/validate_conditions_signals.py. For capitulation (VRP>90th pctile, VIX>30, COT washout) and drawdown_risk bands: (1) Compute forward 63d SPY returns on each signal date, point-in-time (use as_of_series for NFCI/EBP legs). (2) Run purged K-fold (embargo=21d between train/test folds) to measure rank-IC and profit-factor per signal. (3) Compute Deflated Sharpe Ratio (DSR) = SR * sqrt((1 - skew*SR/sqrt(n) + (kurt-1)/4 * SR^2/n)) / sqrt(T/n). (4) PBO via combinatorial cross-validation (N-choose-k). Write results to data/regime/signal_validation.json; expose in conditions_snapshot['capitulation']['pbo'] and ['drawdown_risk']['dsr']. Fail loudly if DSR < 0.5 (signal is likely overfit). The existing band probabilities (8/26/36/38%) become validated outputs of this harness.
deps: ALFRED vintages for NFCI (currently excluded — whole-history re-revision; use latest-revision with a revised-data caveat flag)
mlfinlab or manual purged CV implementation

upgrades.title: Inflation base-effect 2nd-derivative feed into quad axis (L1->L2)
upgrades.spec: In engine/axes.py (inflation_score computation), add a base_effect_2d_infl component with weight 0.5 (half-weight, same as payrolls_trend). Source: engine/base_effect.py inflation_2nd_deriv (from upgrade 1). This is the deterministic component — the sign is known 12 months ahead. The existing inflation axis uses breakevens, sticky CPI direction, and oil as leading reads; the base-effect 2nd deriv is the mechanistic complement. Config: add inflation_axis.base_effect_direction: {weight: 0.5} alongside the existing components. The score_axis function in axes.py already handles arbitrary component dicts.

upgrades.title: ADS coincident index + NY Fed Nowcast ingest (L1)
upgrades.spec: In collectors/fred.py, add FRED series GADSBPTN6SVENY (Philadelphia Fed ADS Business Conditions Index, daily) and NYFRBWSYXBSX (NY Fed Weekly Economic Conditions Index — an alternative to WEI). In engine/inputs.py, add put('ads_index', series.get('ads_index'), ffill_limit=5) alongside WEI. In conditions_snapshot growth_nowcast block, emit ads_index and ads_trend (sign of 65d change). The ADS is a Kalman-filter-based coincident index on daily/weekly data — a cross-check on the market-proxy-dominated growth axis. No new engine code required beyond the FRED pull and the ffill in inputs.py.

upgrades.title: Regime-conditional drawdown CVaR in MRS (L3)
upgrades.spec: In engine/conditions.py macro_risk_snapshot(), add a CVaR_{95} field: for the current MRS band, compute the 95th percentile of the forward 63d SPY drawdown distribution conditioned on the current band (from validate_conditions_signals.py output). Expose as 'macro_risk.cvar_95_pct'. This turns the MRS from a qualitative risk label into a regime-conditional sizing input: the portfolio construction layer can use CVaR as the denominator in the position-size formula (risk budget / CVaR). Requires the validation harness (L6 upgrade) to pre-compute and cache the conditional CVaR table per band in signal_validation.json.
deps: L6 validate_conditions_signals.py computing conditional CVaR by band

upgrades.title: HRP + BL portfolio layer consuming conditional EV (L7)
upgrades.spec: Add engine/portfolio_construction.py. Inputs: (a) conditional_ev.json (E[r_a], CVaR per asset) from L3; (b) covariance matrix from trailing 252d returns (already computable from yahoo closes). Algorithm: (1) HRP base weights via scipy linkage on the correlation matrix. (2) Black-Litterman: blend L3 conditional E[r] as views with market-cap prior (SPY/IWM/QQQ cap weights as proxy). (3) Vol-target overlay: scale HRP-BL weights so portfolio realized vol = target (12% annualized, same as vol_target scalar in config). (4) CVaR constraint: solve a simple cvxpy LP to enforce sum of (weight_a * CVaR_a) <= drawdown_budget (config: portfolio.dd_budget_pct, default 0.08). (5) Regime gross/net dial: when P(Q4) > 0.4, cap gross exposure at 0.6; when P(Q1) > 0.5, allow 1.2. Emit to data/regime/portfolio_weights.json for the allocation page. Config: add engine.portfolio_construction block.

one_line_verdict: The conditions layer is a well-engineered coincident/lagging macro dashboard with validated recession components and honest lead-lag labeling, but it is missing the three real edges from the blueprint: no base-effect 2nd-derivative forward projection (L1), no continuous regime probabilities or transition matrix (L2), and no regime-conditional expected-return engine (L3) — making it a risk thermometer rather than a return-generating nowcast.

Cycle Intelligence JS: build() synthesises cosine-interpolated oscillator + uncertainty cone (timing IQR + linearly growing amplitude heuristic amp=lerp(1.5,13,...)) for cycle.html
Sector/country/China cycle pages JS: seriesFor (price/osc toggle), _project_next band rendered as shaded IQR band + dashed central line (forecastPoint gate), focusBands
Walk-forward per-state statistics: n, hit_pct, avg_fwd_pct, dd_med_pct, dd_p10_pct, dd_bad_pct — the only external validation artifact for the ladder

current_method:
OSCILLATOR (sector_cycles.py:93–103): _detrended_osc divides daily close by a 252-day EMA (detrend), then stochastic-normalises over a 252-bar rolling window, double-smoothed with span=10 EWM. Output is 0–100; 0=washed-out, 100=euphoric. No vol-scaling. Lookback: 252 bars (~1yr) for both trend and range.

ZIGZAG PIVOTS (_detect_swings, sector_cycles.py:106–157): alternating peaks/troughs via a % reversal filter. Fixed threshold _ZZ_PCT=14% for US sector ETFs (sector_cycles.py:83); CN fixed at 18% (china_sector_cycles.py:51); vol-scaled for baskets via _zz_pct_for (annualised vol / 0.22 * 14%, floored). History window: WINDOW_YEARS=15 (sector_cycles.py:80) of daily tape, reduced to DEFAULT_WINDOW_YEARS=7 for the visible default view.

PHASE CLASSIFICATION (_classify_phase, sector_cycles.py:160–189): 5-phase wheel (Trough/Recovery/Expansion/Peak/Downturn) from oscillator level (thresholds: pos>=68 → Peak/Downturn; pos<=32 → Recovery/Trough; mid → Expansion/Downturn) crossed with a direction vote: weekly MACD positive = +2, 3-day MACD positive = +1, oscillator slope (22-day) > 3 or < -3 = +/-1, fresh weekly cross = +/-1. No transition probabilities. Discrete argmax on vote count.

NEXT-TURN PROJECTION (_project_next, sector_cycles.py:192–215): median of all historical half-cycle lengths (ZigZag pivot spacings in decimal years); IQR band = [25th percentile, 75th percentile] of those half-lengths; central = today + max(0.05, median − time_since_last_pivot). No regime conditioning, no return distribution, no backtest of projection accuracy. Pure rhythm estimate from the instrument's own pivot history (minimum 3 swings needed).

CONE RENDERING (cycle_app.js:105–112 for cycle.html; sector_cycles.py NOT a cone — just IQR band as vband on sector pages): cycle.html builds a cosine-interpolated projection path; the uncertainty cone width starts at amp=1.5 and grows linearly to amp=13 via lerp(1.5,13,(xc−today)/(projEnd−today)). The cone is additionally widened/narrowed by tilt (tailwind → 1.35×hi, 0.7×lo width; headwind reversed). The tilt comes from leadership RS + phase (sector_cycles.py:339–355). This is a purely heuristic, hardwired linear expansion — not derived from empirical forecast errors or regime transition probabilities.

LADDER / CYCLE STATE (cycles.py: find_troughs L179, cycle_state L203, ladder_state L734): daily cycle band fixed at DC_BAND=(36,42) trading days for equities; investor cycle IC_BAND_W=(16,26) weeks. Trough detection: local min with TROUGH_WINDOW=10 half-window, merge < TROUGH_MIN_GAP=18 days. Phase: new (<DC_EARLY=12), mid, approaching_band, in_band, stretched. Translation from last cycle peak position. Failed cycle = price < dcl_price. 8 states: DECLINE, BOTTOM WATCH, TURN SIGNALED, FRESH BUY, RALLY ON, TOP WATCH, ROLLING OVER, COUNTERTREND BOUNCE.

REGIME STATE (regime_state, cycles.py:665–731): weighted sum — weekly MACD cross: ±2; weekly positive/negative: ±1; 3-day cross: ±1; 3-day positive/negative: ±0.5; IC failed: -2; IC phase overdue: -1.5; translation left: -1. Regime = 'bear' if s≤-1.5, 'bull' if s≥1.5, else 'neutral'. No probability distribution.

LIQUIDITY OVERLAY (cycles.py:420–422, regime.py:100–111): LIQ_TAILWIND=8 / LIQ_HEADWIND=12 added/subtracted from conviction score on FRESH BUY or TURN SIGNALED only. Based on validated walk-forward: +6pp hit rate at 21d expanding, −2.3pp DD headwind contracting.

CALIBRATION (calibrate_ladder, cycles.py:2135–2192): walk-forward over a trailing 600-day window per instrument, step=5 days, starting at bar 300. Per-state: n, hit_pct, avg_fwd_pct, dd_med_pct, dd_p10_pct, dd_bad_pct at fwd=21 days. Loaded from data/regime/ladder_calibration.json. Current values: FRESH BUY hit_pct=57.4% (n=5280), BOTTOM WATCH=58.8% (n=10390), all states within 56–61% — barely above coin-flip on return, with drawdown differentiation being the primary edge.

BUSINESS CYCLE (business_cycle.py): 8 Leading / 4 Coincident / 5 Lagging components. Month-on-month log-change z-scored over rolling window (z_lookback_m, z_min_months from config). Cumulative index rebased to 100. 6-month momentum (mom6) + EWM trend (trend_smooth_m). 3D's recession signal: mom6 < roc_threshold AND diffusion <= diffusion_max, held for min_consecutive_m months. Calibrated threshold loaded from business_cycle_calibration.json. PIT: daily/weekly legs unlagged (knowable within month); monthly FRED series shifted by lag_m publication lag on the validation path only — live path uses released data as-is. Caveat explicitly stated: ~7 modern recessions, ~3 inside PIT vintage window.

DATA SOURCES: All price/oscillator data via yahoo_closes() (data/yahoo/*.parquet, dividend-adjusted closes). China sectors via engine/china_sector_index.sw_close (Shenwan L1 Akshare/Tushare, data/china_sectors/*.parquet). Business cycle FRED data via store.read('fred', ...). No ALFRED vintage API, no real-time data. All macro series use latest-revision values on the live path.

gaps: No regime-transition probability: regime_state() returns a discrete argmax (bull/neutral/bear) from a hardcoded weighted sum — no Markov-switching or HMM giving P(regime_k today) and P(regime_j next | regime_i now). The cone and projection carry no regime-conditional probability at all.

Heuristic cone, not empirical: the uncertainty cone in cycle_app.js grows linearly from amp=1.5 to amp=13 with hardcoded lerp — not derived from historical forecast errors of the median-half-cycle projection. The 'tilt' modifier (1.35/0.7) is also heuristic. No coverage backtest exists to validate that the IQR band contains the actual future turn X% of the time.

Point projection, not distribution: _project_next emits a central + IQR (25th/75th percentile of half-cycle lengths). This is a rhythm estimate from the raw distribution of past swings — it is not a probabilistic forecast, does not condition on current oscillator level or regime, and has zero measured coverage accuracy.

No transition matrix: the pages show current phase but no P(Recovery next month | Trough now). The business_cycle engine similarly outputs a phase label from lead/coincident momentum signs with no HMM transition probabilities.

Revised data (not PIT) on the live path: business_cycle.py uses FRED latest-revision series on the live path (lag_m=0). Only the validation harness (validate_business_cycle.py) applies a publication lag. No ALFRED vintage API is used for any series.

No conditional expected return: the calibrated ladder stats (ladder_calibration.json) report hit_pct and avg_fwd_pct per state — but all states cluster 56–61% hit rate, showing barely above coin-flip return differentiation. There is no regime-conditional return distribution E[r|state, regime, liquidity] integrated over P(regime). The liquidity modifier only nudges a scalar score, not a distribution.

No second-derivative growth/inflation forecast: the cycle pages (sector and country) run exclusively on price-derived oscillators. There is no base-effect 2nd-derivative growth/inflation axis feeding into phase classification — the _classify_phase vote count uses MACD momentum only, which is a price 1st-derivative proxy.

No DSR/PBO on any signal: calibrate_ladder uses a simple walk-forward with step=5 — no purged K-fold cross-validation, no embargo, no Deflated Sharpe Ratio test, no Probability of Backtest Overfitting. The 57–61% hit rates across all states are almost certainly overfit and no deflation has been applied.

No forward vol surface: oscillator spread (IQR cone) uses only amplitude heuristic — no OHLC realized vol (Yang-Zhang), no GARCH/HAR-RV for forward vol, no IV-RV premium. Vol regime from engine/vol_regime.py feeds into the ladder score penalty only as a binary kill-switch, not into projection band width.

No economy nowcast in cycle-phase pages: sector_cycles/country_cycles run purely on price oscillators. The business_cycle module (Leading/Coincident/Lagging) is a separate page and its output does NOT feed into the sector or country phase classification or the projection bands. The Goldilocks/stagflation quad from engine/regime.py similarly does not inform _classify_phase.

China forward_log exists but grader absent: append_forward_log in china_sector_cycles.py writes a PIT signal log, but no grading script reads it back to measure cycle/signature/pathway call accuracy. The forward edge of the China sector pathway is claimed from Phase-0 Wilson-CI odds but the cycle oscillator signal itself is ungraded.
Business cycle honesty gap: ~7 recessions / ~3 PIT-comparable = essentially ungraded out-of-sample. The caveat is explicit in code/UI but no PBO or walk-forward coverage stat is surfaced to the user.

upgrades.spec: Add engine/regime_hmm.py implementing a 4-state (or 3-state if data-thin) Gaussian HMM over [growth_score, inflation_score] from engine/axes.py. upgrades.title: Purged K-fold + Deflated Sharpe on ladder calibration
upgrades.spec: In scripts/validate_ladder.py (new), implement purged K-fold cross-validation (PurgedKFold from mlfinlab or manual implementation with embargo=5*fwd trading days) over the calibrate_ladder walk-forward. For each fold, fit the state-assignment rule on train, measure hit_pct/avg_fwd on test. Compute: (1) Deflated SR = SR * sqrt((1 - skewness*SR + (kurtosis-1)/4*SR^2) / (T-1)) per Bailey-Lopez-de-Prado; (2) PBO via combinatorial symmetric cross-validation over 16 folds. Store results in data/regime/ladder_validation.json. Surface DSR and PBO next to calibrated hit_pct in UI as honest caveats — the calibration JSON already ships with the panel, so the plumbing exists.

one_line_verdict: All four cycle pages derive phase and projection from a price-only first-derivative momentum oscillator with a hardwired heuristic cone — no regime-transition probabilities, no empirical cone coverage validation, no conditional return distribution, no PIT data, and barely above coin-flip win rates across all ladder states; the system is honest about its limitations but delivers display-level cycle-position reads rather than the regime-conditional expected-value engine the blueprint requires.

current_method:
**Risk Radar v2 (engine/risk_radar.py)**

Inputs: trailing-504d (≈2y) causal percentile of 10 legs, computed daily on SPY trading calendar with FRED series ffilled forward (leak-free):
- credit_oas_roc: FRED BAMLH0A0HYM2 21d diff, pct_rank_window(504)
- credit_hyg_tlt: -(HYG/TLT 20d ROC), pct_rank_window(504)
- rates_move: _MOVE level, pct_rank_window(504)
- rates_realrate: FRED DFII10 5d diff, pct_rank_window(504)
- bubble_ext: SPY/200dma_rolling-1, pct_rank_window(504)
- bubble_leadership: SMH/SPY 63d rel-momentum, pct_rank_window(504)
- growth_defensives: XLU/SPY 20d ROC, pct_rank_window(504)
- growth_cyc_def: -(XLY/XLP 20d ROC), pct_rank_window(504)
- vol_term: VIX9D/VIX3M (or VIX/VIX3M) level, pct_rank_window(504)
- vol_putcall / vol_gex: CBOE putcall equity ratio / net GEX — INERT until >=252 rows accrue (deep history unavailable)

Scare-types (4 Tier-A + 1 Tier-B): each = weighted mean of available leg percentiles ×100 → 0-100 sub-score. Weights: credit=(0.85,0.15), rates=(0.80,0.20), bubble=(0.85,0.15), growth=(0.50,0.50), vol=(0.5,0.3,0.2).

Thresholds: _DEFAULT_BANDS = {watch:55, caution:68, elevated:78, risk_off:88}. State = worst Tier-A band. Escalation: "ARMED+CONFIRM conjunction" — >=1 validated leading leg (lift_2020>=1.20) inside a hot Tier-A scare AND >=2 Tier-A scares at watch+ → state bumps one level. Tier-B vol may escalate a hot Tier-A but never originate.

Context gate (line 280-316): LOUD banner (elevated+) only when SPY<200dma AND pct_rank_window(504) of breadth %above200dma <=0.40. Below this the state is capped at 'caution'. Measured precision improvement 0.085→0.249, fire-rate 80%→17%.

Election-cycle modulator (engine/election_cycle.py): in risk-ON midterm Apr-Oct window, lowers watch/caution bands by band_delta (approx 3-5pt) and applies gross_mult trim — never touches elevated/risk-off bands. Additive only.

Drawdown probabilities: _PROB_CAL lookup by state + horizon (h5/h10/h21), incremented by _CONJ_BUMP per hot Tier-A beyond the first. Base rates: h5=0.036, h10=0.086, h21=0.178. At risk-off: h21=0.33 (1.85x lift vs base).

Gross factor: {calm:1.0, watch:0.97, caution:0.90, elevated:0.78, risk-off:0.60, floor:0.50}. Election-cycle gross_mult applied when state!=calm.

Trajectory (lines 549-665): intensity = max of Tier-A sub-scores daily over 30d window. Phase = calm/rising/peaking/flat/receding based on velocity threshold ±1.5pt/5d and off_peak thresholds 3-4pt. SVG sparkline pre-scaled at 96×26px.

Validated leg lifts (2020+ holdout): bubble_ext=2.34x, credit_oas_roc=1.23x, rates_move=1.52x, growth_cyc_def=1.63x, growth_defensives=1.62x. Others FAIL the 1.20x bar but remain as low-weight corroborators. No leg is point-in-time/vintage-aware (latest-revision FRED data throughout).

**Risk State v1 (engine/risk_state.py)**

10 legs, each returning intensity in [0,1], combined as weighted mean (renormalized over available). Weights (config.yml lines 1747-1754): complacency=1.0, breadth_div=0.9, dealer_gamma=0.9, technical=0.8, extension=0.8, vol_structure=0.7, credit=0.6, turning_point=0.4, cross_asset=0.3, macro_backdrop=0.3. Score=(num/den)*100 in [0,100]. Bands: neutral<20, caution<40, elevated<60, risk_off>=80. Conjunction escalator: count of LEADING legs (complacency/breadth_div/dealer_gamma/technical/extension/vol_structure) with intensity>=0.6; >=2→floor=caution, >=3→floor=elevated. Gross: {caution:0.90, elevated:0.78, risk_off:0.60, floor:0.50}. Alert fires at elevated+. Live snapshot reads dealer GEX from site/gex/index.json (one-build lag), HYG/TLT 20d ROC from store, tech_intensity from mtf_monitor.published().

**MRS + Sector Beta (engine/conditions.py lines 684-858)**

MRS = weighted mean of: recession (conditions.recession.score/100, w=1.0), drawdown_risk (conditions.drawdown_risk.score/100, w=1.0), nfci (nfci_pctile when tightening, w=0.5), liquidity (1 if contracting else 0, w=0.5), transition (0/0.5/1.0 by WEAKENING/TRANSITIONING/NEW_REGIME, w=0.25). All renormalized over available. sector_macro_beta table: XLF=1.0, XLC=1.0, XLY=0.64, XLB/XLRE=0.5, XLI=0.48, XLK=0.39, XLE=0.16, XLU=-0.29, XLV=-0.46, XLP=-0.56. Overlay applied as subtract-only penalty (macro_max=7pt sector heat, macro_headwind=7pt per-stock), never alpha.

**Market State radar override (engine/market_state.py lines 522-611)**

_radar_override runs LAST (highest priority). When radar state in {caution,elevated,risk-off}: 7 corroborators checked — conjunction, two_plus_scares, complacency, breadth_div, drawdown_band, systemic_stress, turning_point. amp=count of active corroborators. severe_gated = state==caution AND (ungated in {elevated,risk-off} OR top_score>=85). _ceiling_for() computes amplified ceiling via _ms_calib() auto-tuned weights. ceiling<42 → forced to RISK_OFF; 42-59 → capped at MIXED. The final score = min(raw_score, overridden_score, radar_ceiling). Recovery panel injected here from risk_radar_recovery.assess().

**De-escalation panel (engine/risk_radar_recovery.py)**

DISPLAY-ONLY. Fires when: trajectory.reached_risk AND phase in {peaking,receding} OR (phase!=rising AND n_fresh_catalysts>=2). strength = heuristic: off_peak*3 + max(0,-vel)*3.5 + n_cat*11 + n_fresh*6 + 14if_receding, capped 0-100. Liquidity catalysts: Fed net-liq expanding (liquidity_overlay==expanding), Fed dovish/easing/cuts>=1.5 (fed_stance/fed_path), PBoC easing (china_pboc_stance.snapshot()), global CB tide expanding (global_liquidity.snapshot()). NOT forward-tested — caveat stated explicitly in code.

**Vol-Shock Scorecard (engine/vol_shock_scorecard.py)**

9 factors, weighted mean over available: concentration=1.0 (cross_asset absorption_pctile_5y×100), dealer_gamma=1.0 (regime+prox heuristic, 75-100 for short-gamma), vix_term=0.8 (ratio scaled linearly between lo=0.85 and hi=1.05), vrp_skew=0.7 (avg of (1-vrp_pctile) + skew_pctile), put_call=0.5 (young-downweighted by 0.35 factor), complacency=0.8, drawdown=0.6 (from conditions.drawdown_risk.score), turning_point=0.5 (capped at 60), event_window=0.4. Bands: elevated=40, high=60, extreme=75. Has forward outcome log (SPY MAE + VIX jump) but FEEDS NOTHING — display-only.

**Risk Brain (engine/risk_brain.py)**

DEFAULT OFF (enabled:false). When enabled: reads evidence pack from latest.json (risk_state, conditions, mtf_monitor, gex, baskets, allocation, standouts), calls claude-opus-4-8 (or oauth fallback), outputs brain_state + bounded directive (subtract-only gross_tilt clamped to [-max_gross_tilt,0]=-0.5..0). Posture clamped: brain cannot be LESS cautious than engine. Elevated+ engine → non-zero tilt injected in code even if model says 0. Accountability ledger at data/risk_brain/theses.jsonl grades elevated+ calls on SPY max-drawdown >=5% within 21d.

FRED via store.read('fred',...): BAMLH0A0HYM2 (HY OAS, weekly, latest revision), DFII10 (10y real rate, daily, latest revision)
CBOE putcall/GEX (store.read('cboe','putcall'/'gex')): accruing forward, INERT until >=252 rows
Breadth store: pct_above_200dma for context gate and breadth_div leg

gaps: L1 GAP — No base-effect determinism anywhere in the risk subsystem. The growth/inflation axes that drive the regime quad are first-derivative market-proxy reads (20d slope z-scored vs 60d, axes.py). The validated Hedgeye kernel — forward 2nd-derivative sign is ~68% determined by the KNOWN base-period 2nd-derivative — is absent. Risk state calls therefore cannot see that a forced deceleration or acceleration is coming 1-3 quarters out, only that it has arrived.

L1 GAP — No point-in-time data. All FRED inputs (BAMLH0A0HYM2, DFII10, WALCL/RRP/TGA for liquidity_overlay) are latest-revision. In drawdown events, revised series are systematically smoother than real-time vintages, biasing the MRS toward 'low' when it should fire. ALFRED real-time vintages are free and available.

L1 GAP — No mixed-frequency nowcast. conditions.py approximates the growth axis with claims YoY + withheld-tax YoY (causal), but these are heuristic weights, not a DFM/Kalman state with variance. No ADS cross-check. No MIDAS bridge for mixed-freq predictors.

L2 GAP — No regime probability distribution. The quad is a discrete argmax (engine/regime.py raw_quad). risk_radar.compute() returns a single gated state, not P(scare_type) per day. No Markov-switching or HMM to give transition probability P(Quad_j | Quad_i) or time-in-regime hazard. The conjunction heuristic proxies intensity but is not a probability.

L2 GAP — No liquidity or policy axis in the regime model. The MRS has a binary liquidity leg (contracting=1/else=0). The regime quad itself has no liquidity axis. Fed net-liq expansion/contraction enters only via the binary liquidity_overlay and the recovery panel (display-only). The blueprint calls for explicit liquidity + policy axes with continuous values.

L3 GAP — No conditional expected-value engine. risk_radar.compute() produces drawdown probabilities (P(>=5% drawdown | state)) but not per-asset/per-sector conditional return distributions mu_{a,k} integrated over P(Quad_k). The sector_macro_beta overlay is subtract-only and heuristic (not empirically calibrated by regime-conditional returns). No cross-sectional ranker by E[r]/CVaR.

L3 GAP — Gross factor is discrete state lookup (calm=1.0, watch=0.97, caution=0.90, elevated=0.78, risk-off=0.60), not an intensity-weighted, continuously interpolated sizing dial. The delta into the quad (intensity) is not used to weight the gross factor — a barely-elevated state and a deeply-elevated one get the same gross.

L4 GAP — Vol surface is rudimentary. Only VIX9D/VIX3M ratio (term structure level) and VRP percentile (from conditions). No realized vol surface (Yang-Zhang OHLC not computed), no HAR-RV forward vol with prediction interval, no 25-delta skew as a separate signal, no dispersion or correlation term. Vol-Shock Scorecard is display-only and feeds no sizing.

L4 GAP — No forward range as conditional quantile forecast. risk_radar gives P(>=5% drawdown) but not the conditional distribution of returns — no skewed-t GARCH or quantile regression for the loss tail. The 'risk range' implied by the gross factor is a heuristic dial, not a measured coverage interval.

L5 GAP — Mechanical flow front-running is incomplete. GEX net dealer gamma is in risk_state/vol_shock (from site/gex/index.json, one-build lag). No vol-control roll-off schedule (high-vol days aging out of trailing window = mechanical buying). No CTA trend flip level. Put/call is in vol_shock (Tier-B) and INERT in risk_radar until 252 rows accumulate. COT z-scores are absent.

L5 GAP — vol_putcall and vol_gex legs in risk_radar are Tier-B INERT (lines 73-76, 241-246) because deep CBOE history is not freely available. These are the two fastest orthogonal signals per the blueprint and they contribute nothing to the live radar.

L6 GAP — No Deflated Sharpe Ratio (DSR) or Probability of Backtest Overfitting (PBO) on any strategy. The backtest reports lift (1.23-2.34x) and a frequency-matched permutation bar, but no multiple-testing correction. The calibration.json Opus loop retunes bands from realized outcomes — no embargo or purged K-fold.

L6 GAP — Win-rate not expectancy. risk_radar._PROB_CAL reports P(>=5% drawdown) but not the conditional expected return or profit-factor. The de-risk response (gross reduction) is not validated against the actual gross P&L improvement over the signal period.

L6 GAP — The vol_shock_scorecard forward outcome log (append/resolve/track_record) is the most complete validation loop in the subsystem, but it is display-only and feeds nothing. No integration to a circuit breaker or sizing gate.

L6 GAP — Scorecard not broken out by realized regime OR VIX bucket. risk_radar_backtest.gate_report splits by era (pre-/post-2020) but not by concurrent VIX regime or quad label. The leg lifts may be regime-conditional in ways not captured.

L7 GAP — No HRP or Black-Litterman portfolio construction. Sizing is inverse-vol per-name (Layer A, engine/risk_sizing.py) + HAR vol-target scalar (Layer B) + a scalar gross_factor from the radar. No risk-contribution budget, no BL blending of conditional-EV views with a market prior, no CVaR constraint.

L7 GAP — No gross/net dial driven by regime probability. The blueprint calls for max-gross/tight-net-short in high-P(Q1) and min-gross/net-short in high-P(Q4). The current system has only a discrete 5-level gross step and no net-short logic.

RENDER GAP — Market State overrides Risk Radar, not the reverse. The memory file says 'Risk Radar OVERRIDES Market State' (macro-frontpage-radar-merge.md), and _radar_override does run last (line 698-704 of market_state.py), but Market State is still a blend of 6 components that can pull the score up before the radar ceiling is applied. The ceiling mechanism is correct but the confluence multiplier weights (_ms_calib) are auto-tuned by Opus from a display-only audit log, not from the strict permutation gate used on the radar legs.

DATA GAP — Recovery panel liquidity catalysts (Fed net-liq, Fed cuts, PBoC, global CB) are display-only and not forward-graded. The risk_radar_recovery.assess() explicitly states it has NOT been forward-tested (line 22 of risk_radar_recovery.py). A positive recovery read while risk is still materially elevated could mislead sizing.

DATA GAP — No CTA trend-flip level in any engine. The energy of systematic vol-control + CTA flows (estimated >90% of volume) is not modelled mechanically — only the GEX dealer-gamma leg partially captures this via the spot-vs-gamma-flip proximity.

upgrades.title: Add base-effect determinism — forward 2nd-derivative sign from known comp path
upgrades.spec: In engine/conditions.py or a new engine/base_effect.py: for each monthly FRED series already collected (CPIAUCSL, PCE, PAYEMS), compute the 12m YoY series. Then compute the forward comp path: the denominator for the next 4 quarters is already known. Forward 2nd-derivative sign = sign(sum of 2nd-diff of base period). Expose as base_effect_growth_sign (+1/-1/0) and base_effect_inflation_sign into latest.json. In engine/market_state.py _comp_stress, blend as a light (w=0.5) context indicator alongside the MRS. upgrades.spec: New engine/regime_hmm.py: implement a 2-state (or 4-state) Markov-switching model over [growth_score, inflation_score] using statsmodels MarkovRegression (or hmmlearn). Fit once monthly on full history; daily filtered probabilities give P(Quad_k | history_t). Add transition matrix P(Quad_j | Quad_i) and time-in-regime hazard (geometric with per-quad lambda). Expose via latest.json.regime_probs dict {Q1:.., Q2:.., Q3:.., Q4:..} and transition_probs. one_line_verdict: The risk radar stack has a genuine validated core (5 legs with 1.2-2.3x 2020+ lift, context gate, Opus self-correction, accountability ledger) but lacks the blueprint's three real edges — base-effect determinism is absent, the quad is a discrete argmax with no transition probabilities, and the gross dial is a lookup table not an intensity-weighted conditional-EV ranker — making it a well-engineered COINCIDENT risk flag rather than a leading drawdown forecaster.

subsystem: Volatility Engines (vol_regime, vol_shock_scorecard, froth_fragility, vol_forecast, vol_managed, vol_sentiment, vol_squeeze) vs Hedgeye 6-part vol surface

HAR-style realized vol forecast (equal-weight blend of RV at lags 2,5,22,66d) — close-to-close only, no OHLC. Feeds VRP physical leg and cone width.

Research/backtest vol-targeting helper (EWMA-blend HAR-lite scalar). Not the live production path — that is engine/risk_sizing.

Single-stock vol-compression state machine (COILED/FIRED/EXPANSION). Dual gate: Bollinger-bandwidth percentile AND realized-vol percentile (both <25th of trailing 252d), optional TTM-squeeze gate when OHLC available. Directionally agnostic timing confirmer.
Single-name IV skew (Xing-Zhang-Zhao 2010): 25-delta OTM put IV minus 50-delta ATM call IV at ~30d tenor. Display-only / gate-closed (chain coverage too narrow).
Single-name IV spread (Cremers-Weinbaum 2010): OI-weighted mean(call IV - put IV) at matched strikes, ~30d tenor. Display-only / gate-closed.

Empirical conditional forward-distribution kernel. Quantile bands on state -> forward return quantiles + drawdown. Used by anticipation engine; vol is an equal-weight HAR-style cone width, not a fitted regime-conditional distribution.

Firewall validation script. HAC t-bar=2.5 on forward-vol predictability (horizons 21,63d) + Clark-West vs expanding mean + subperiod fold-sign stability. Gate currently CLOSED for all 3 scored-eligible legs (basket_overlay_gate.json: live_overlay_helps=false, scored_marginal=false, dsr=0.9943).

Live gate verdict: live_overlay_helps=false, regime_marginal_over_voltarget=false, scored_marginal=false. Only mech vol-target (vol_target_scalar) is active. data/vol_regime/gate.json does NOT exist — all legs scored=false.

current_method:
ARCHITECTURE: Five distinct vol sub-engines with a strict validate-first doctrine. The firewall is enforced in code: `scored_score` (vol_regime.py:304) returns None when gate.json is absent, and the basket_overlay_gate.json (asof 2026-06-21) confirms all channels are currently gate-closed. Only the mechanical vol-target scalar (target_vol_pct=12.0 / max(RV_21d, VIX), clipped [0.5,1.5]) is live (vol_regime.py:175). Live output (asof 2026-06-29): VIX=17.65, ts_slope=0.904 (contango), VRP=0.63 at pctile=0.07 with vrp_chg_21d=-7.08 (vrp_state='collapsing de-risk'), fragility_confluence=1 (vrp_collapse flag), vol_target_scalar=0.66.

REALIZED VOL (vol_forecast.py:22-25, vol_regime.py:173): CLOSE-TO-CLOSE ONLY. `realized_vol(close, win)` = pct_change().rolling(win).std(ddof=0). HAR predictor = equal-weight mean of RV at lags (2,5,22,66) days (vol_forecast.py:28-32). No OHLC: Yang-Zhang, Parkinson, or Garman-Klass estimators are absent from every vol file.

VRP (vol_regime.py:161-170): VIX minus `cone_vol_ann(spy)` in vol-points. Physical leg = HAR equal-weight RV blend annualized. Scored as risk-on when high (BTZ 2009 logic). Complemented by 21d rate-of-change (vrp_chg_21d). No separation of IV-RV premium into components (no term-structure of VRP, no skew-adjusted VRP).

TERM STRUCTURE (vol_regime.py:143-146): VIX/VIX3M ratio. Contango (<1.00) = calm; near-backwardation (>=0.975); backwardation (>=1.00, kill-switch). Front-end VIX9D/VIX is context-only (CONTEXT_LEGS). No multi-tenor curve fitting, no VX futures curve, no slope-of-slope second derivative.

SKEW (vol_regime.py:177-183, froth_fragility.py:459-471): CBOE SKEW level as insurance-cost percentile. Deliberately NOT scored in vol_regime (comment at line 24: 'perverse as a timer'). downside_vrp proxy = (SKEW-100)/10 - (down_semivol/VIX) is context-only. Single-name options_skew.py computes XZZ-style 25d put/50d call spread but gate is closed (chain too narrow). No dispersion vol (cross-sectional IV vs realized), no term-structure of skew.

DISPERSION (froth_fragility.py:808-858): Cross-sectional realized (not implied) dispersion among MEGACAP cohort via Solnik-style rho-hat = var(EW-cohort 42d return) / mean(var(member 42d return)), EWMA span=10. Used as a binary direction signal (rho_low AND rho_falling AND disp_rising) in the Stealth Distribution sub-score. This is PRICE dispersion, not IV dispersion surface. No single-stock IV cross-section, no IV dispersion index.

VOL-OF-VOL (vol_regime.py:204-210): VVIX/VIX ratio as candidate leg. VVIX percentile (peak-fear) + ratio percentile. Context/candidate: gate stays closed until incremental edge over scored legs is proven (2006+ history, HAC t~15 per docstring). Not scored.

FORWARD RANGE / CONE (forward_dist.py, anticipation.py:314-316): Cone width = HAR-style equal-weight RV blend * sqrt(252). Quantiles are empirical conditionals from the state-band distribution (forward_dist.multi_horizon_cone), not a parametric skewed-t or GARCH quantile regression. No formal coverage test (no conditional coverage or DQ test). No forward vol surface shape — just a symmetric normal-approximation cone widened by the vol scalar and the macro overlay.

MECHANICAL FLOW (vol_shock_scorecard.py): Dealer-gamma regime from gex_model (short/long/flip distance) contributes one of 9 factors with weight=1.0. VIX-term inversion (ratio in [0.85..1.05] mapped linearly to [0..100]). Put/call complacency. Cross-asset absorption percentile. These are assembled but the scorecard is display-only (accruing forward log, not yet driving any decision).

SIZING OVERLAY (vol_regime.py:466-552): Subtract-only gross scalar = min(vol_target_scalar,1.0) * regime_caution (0.85 for 'warning', 0.70 for 'backwardation-stress') * scored_deepener (only when gate open AND scored_score<0). Current live lever = vol_target_scalar=0.66 (mech channel only). Regime_caution is NOT active (regime='normalizing'). Floor=0.40.

gaps: No OHLC/Yang-Zhang realized vol: vol_forecast.py:22-25 uses only close-to-close pct_change().rolling().std(). Yang-Zhang (2000) reduces daily RV RMSE by ~30-40% vs close-to-close (the overnight gap + intraday range carry independent information). The physical RV leg of the VRP is therefore noisier than it needs to be, understating vol in gap-open regimes and overstating VRP during quiet intraday sessions.

No IV surface: the system has no continuous implied-vol surface. CBOE SKEW (a single number) is context-only and not scored. options_skew.py computes 25d/50d delta skew for ~10 mega-caps but the gate is closed due to insufficient cross-section history. There is no dispersion vol (VIX vs single-stock IV average), no term-structure of skew (1m vs 3m vs 6m), no vol-of-vol surface. Hedgeye's 6-part surface (level, IV-RV premium, 25d skew, term slope, dispersion, term structure of skew) maps to: level=partial (VIX used), IV-RV=partial (VRP exists but physical is close-to-close), 25d skew=display-only chain, dispersion=absent from IV, term slope=VIX/VIX3M only (no VX futures curve), skew term-structure=absent.

Gate-closed composite: validate_vol_regime.py has run and basket_overlay_gate.json (asof 2026-06-21) shows live_overlay_helps=false, scored_marginal=false. data/vol_regime/gate.json does NOT exist in the data directory, so all three scored-eligible legs (ts_slope, move, vrp) are scored=false. The continuous scored_score is null in the live output. Only the mechanical vol-target scalar (0.66 as of 2026-06-29) acts. This means the regime-state caution path (warning/backwardation-stress haircuts at 0.85/0.70) is active for gross sizing but the deepener channel is permanently off until someone manually promotes via --write-gate.

HAR forecast uses unfit equal weights: vol_forecast.py:28-32 averages RV at lags 2,5,22,66 with equal weight 0.25 each. Corsi (2009) fitted OLS weights from daily RV lag, weekly lag, monthly lag show roughly 0.4/0.35/0.25 split; the 66d lag is not in Corsi's original 3-lag HAR-RV but is reasonable. However, equal weights are never re-estimated: there is no fitted regression, no expanding-window OLS, no MIDAS or GARCH component. The docstring at vol_forecast.py:9 acknowledges 'without a fitted regression (equal-scale blend)' and says the Phase-0 harness reports forward-RV R2 so it is 'measured not assumed' — but no Phase-0 harness output or gate exists for vol_forecast itself. This is the physical leg that determines VRP.

Forward cone is symmetric/heuristic: forward_dist.multi_horizon_cone uses empirical quantile bands on a single composite state score — it returns p5/p25/p50/p75/p95 return quantiles from historical analogs in the same state band. This is an empirical lookup table, not a calibrated forecast. (1) No formal coverage test (DQ/conditional coverage) of the quantile intervals. (2) No asymmetric/skewed-t or GARCH-driven tail estimate. (3) Cone width = HAR vol * sqrt(h) — the Gaussian square-root-of-time scaling ignores vol-of-vol and jump risk at short horizons. Hedgeye's 'forward range as conditional quantile forecast with measurable coverage' (L4 blueprint) requires: calibrated quantile regression or skewed-t GARCH with empirical coverage verification.

No regime-conditional expected value ranking: the vol engines produce risk-on scores and sizing overlays but do NOT compute regime-conditional forward return distributions per asset/sector. The L3 blueprint (E[r_a] = sum_k P(Quad_k)*mu_{a,k}*intensity_k) is entirely absent from the vol stack. The vol composite feeds a gross haircut only, not a cross-sectional conditional EV ranker.

No transition probability / hazard: vol_regime.py uses a 4-state argmax label (backwardation-stress / warning / normalizing / calm-contango) with fixed thresholds (backwardation=1.00, near_backwardation=0.975, deep_contango=0.92 at vol_regime.py:75). There is no Markov-switching model, no HMM, no P(regime_j_next | regime_i_now) transition matrix, no time-in-regime hazard. The regime can snap between states in one day with no uncertainty quantification.

Vol-target scalar uses max(RV,VIX) denominator without uncertainty: vol_regime.py:174 uses max(rv_ann, vix) with a fixed target_vol_pct=12.0 and clip [0.5,1.5]. The target is not regime-conditional (it should be tighter in Q4/backwardation). There is no uncertainty band on the vol forecast itself — when the HAR forecast carries high RMSE (regime transitions), the scalar is applied with false precision.

No forward-vol surface shape for VX futures: the term-structure leg uses only VIX/VIX3M ratio (two points). The full VX futures curve (VX1..VX8) would give roll yield, the steepness slope, and carry. CTA trend-flip levels (the vol-control mechanical flow L5 item) require knowing the rolling window schedule and the 12d/1d MA crossover on VIX futures, which is not implemented.

win-rate-not-expectancy in vol_shock forward log: vol_shock_scorecard.py:671-697 track_record() reports hit_rate and avg_score by band, but NOT expectancy (avg gain when hit minus avg loss when miss), profit_factor, or max drawdown-of-signal. The band edges are pre-registered but no coverage test or DSR/PBO is reported for the scorecard itself.

Dispersion vol = price-only, not IV: froth_fragility._rho_dispersion (line 808) computes Solnik-style correlation among mega-cap price returns, not implied-vol cross-section. True IV dispersion (avg single-stock IV vs VIX) would capture the 'vol-selling complex fragility' Hedgeye emphasizes — when IV dispersion is compressed, any vol-targeting fund that is long single-name vol is flush, but the unwind can be sudden.

upgrades.title: Yang-Zhang OHLC realized vol in vol_forecast.py
upgrades.spec: Add `yang_zhang_vol(high, low, open_, close, win)` to engine/vol_forecast.py using the Yang-Zhang (2000) formula: YZ = sigma_open^2 + k*sigma_close^2 + (1-k)*sigma_rs^2 where k=0.34/(1.34+(win+1)/(win-1)), sigma_open=Rogers-Satchell, sigma_close=close-to-close. Replace `realized_vol` in the HAR predictor set (har_vol) with YZ when high/low/open are available, falling back to close-to-close. In vol_regime.py:173 replace `realized_vol(sp, 21)` with a YZ call using SPY OHLCV (already in data/yahoo/SPY.parquet which has high/low/open/close columns). Update validate_vol_regime.py to test whether YZ improves forward-vol NW-t before promoting. Expected RMSE reduction ~25-35% vs close-to-close in gap-open regimes.
deps: data/yahoo/SPY.parquet must have high/low/open columns (verify with store.read)

upgrades.title: Fit HAR-RV regression weights via expanding OLS (replace equal-weight blend)
upgrades.spec: In validate_vol_regime.py, add a `_fit_har_weights(rv_daily, rv_weekly, rv_monthly, fwd_rv)` function using expanding-window OLS (min 504 obs) to estimate the 3-lag Corsi weights [beta_d, beta_w, beta_m] each year-end. Persist fitted weights to data/vol_regime/har_weights.json. In vol_forecast.py add `har_vol_fitted(close, weights_path)` that loads the latest weights and computes the weighted blend. The equal-weight path remains the fallback when the weights file is absent. In vol_regime.py replace `cone_vol_ann` with `har_vol_fitted` for the VRP physical leg. Validate: compare NW-t(VRP_fitted vs VRP_equal) on 21d and 63d forward vol — gate only if incremental improvement clears HAC bar.
