upgrades.title: IV dispersion leg: avg single-stock IV vs VIX in vol_shock_scorecard
upgrades.spec: Add `_f_iv_dispersion(latest, chain_store_path)` to vol_shock_scorecard.py. Compute: (1) load latest chain snapshots from data/polygon_gex/chains/<latest_date>.parquet; (2) for each underlying compute ATM 30d IV (reuse options_skew._iv_at_delta with delta=0.50); (3) compute avg single-stock IV across all underlyings; (4) IV_dispersion = avg_single_IV / VIX (should be >1 normally; compression toward 1.0 = correlation spike risk). upgrades.title: VX futures term-structure curve (slope-of-slope + roll yield) as vol_regime context leg
upgrades.spec: Collect VX1..VX4 continuous futures closes from Polygon or CBOE free files (VX futures are available via CBOE data on /vx-index/vxarchive). In vol_regime.py add a `_vx_curve(vx1, vx2, vx3, vx4)` helper that computes: (1) front-to-back slope = VX1/VX4 (analogous to ts_slope but on raw futures not spot VIX); (2) roll yield = annualized (VX2-VX1)/VX1 (the carry the short-vol complex earns/pays); (3) 2nd derivative = (VX3-2*VX2+VX1) (the slope-of-slope — a convexity read). Store as CONTEXT_LEGS ('vx_slope', 'vx_roll', 'vx_2d'). Validate vx_slope vs ts_slope marginal IC before considering promotion. This gives a 4-tenor curve vs the current 2-point VIX/VIX3M.

Then add a `coverage_test(realized_returns, lower_band, upper_band)` that computes empirical coverage vs nominal and a Christoffersen (1998) conditional coverage LR statistic. upgrades.title: Markov-switching vol regime with P(transition) replacing argmax label
upgrades.spec: Add engine/vol_regime_hmm.py using statsmodels MarkovRegression or hmmlearn GaussianHMM on a 3-state hidden variable (calm / elevated / stress) fit on the composite risk_score series (1990+, from vol_forecast HAR-RV + VIX). Emit P(state_k) for k in {calm, elevated, stress} + P(transition | current) for each state pair + expected time-in-regime (from stationary distribution). Persist output to data/vol_regime/hmm_snapshot.json. In vol_regime.snapshot() add 'hmm_probs' field sourcing from the HMM output. In sizing_overlay() allow the warning_haircut to be weighted by P(stress) rather than a hard threshold: caution = 1.0 - 0.30*P(stress). Gate HMM behind its own validation gate (scripts/validate_vol_hmm.py): Clark-West vs argmax benchmark on 63d forward vol. Effort is L because hmmlearn requires careful out-of-sample fitting discipline (purged rolling refit).

upgrades.title: Expectancy + profit-factor + PBO reporting for vol_shock forward log
upgrades.spec: In vol_shock_scorecard.py track_record() (line 671), add: (1) expectancy = avg(spy_mae_pct when hit) * hit_rate + avg(spy_mae_pct when not hit) * (1-hit_rate) — the true expected value per signal; (2) profit_factor = sum(|spy_mae_pct| for hits) / sum(|spy_mae_pct| for misses); (3) run a permutation-based PBO (probability of backtest overfitting) on the band thresholds using the 30+ matured rows (bootstrap with 2000 resample). Add these fields to the track_record return dict. In build_site.py / the Options Desk card, surface expectancy and profit_factor alongside hit_rate. This converts the log from a win-rate display into an honest expectancy/PBO disclosure. Cost: small (pure Python, uses the existing log.jsonl).

upgrades.title: CTA trend-flip level and vol-control mechanical buyback schedule (L5)
upgrades.spec: Add engine/mech_flow.py with two functions: (1) `cta_trend_flip(close, fast=12, slow=252)` — SPY/QQQ MA crossover proximity: distance to the MA(fast)/MA(slow) crossover as a % of spot. This is the CTA re-enter-long trigger. Emit 'days_to_flip_est' and 'cta_buy_zone'. (2) `volcontrol_buyback(vix_series, vol_target_pct=10.0, rolloff_win=21)` — estimate the SPY shares a typical vol-control fund must buy when a high-vol day from 21 trading days ago rolls off the trailing window, using: delta_pos = vol_target/new_vol - vol_target/old_vol, mapped to approximate SPY notional. These are MECHANICAL, not predictive alpha: consume in vol_shock_scorecard.py as a new 'mech_flow' factor (weight=0.6). This is the L5 blueprint item ('vol-control roll-off schedule') that Hedgeye uses to front-run machine flows.

one_line_verdict: The vol stack has solid architecture (validate-first firewall, causal windows, forward-outcome logs) but the core VRP physical leg is close-to-close only (no Yang-Zhang), the validation gate is currently closed for all scored legs (scored_score=null live), there is no IV surface (skew/dispersion/term-structure-of-skew all absent or display-only), and the forward cone is a heuristic equal-weight HAR width with no formal coverage test — covering roughly 2.5 of Hedgeye's 6 vol-surface dimensions.

current_method:
**GEX ENGINE (gex_engine.py:43-70 / gex_model.py:113-143)**

Inputs: per-strike CBOE delayed EOD chain [K, T, iv, oi, is_call, gamma, expiry]; spot. All latest-revision — zero vintage-awareness.

Gamma-flip: ±25% spot grid of 101 points; for each grid point re-evaluates dealer net $ gamma (sign = +call/−put, the unobservable assumption) via Black-Scholes gamma × OI × mult × S² × pm; interpolates zero-crossing nearest spot. Thresholds in DEFAULTS: strike_window_pct=0.25, max_expiry_days=365, min_strikes=40, near_money_pct=0.10.

Net GEX = sum(sign × gamma × OI × 100 × S² × 0.01) in $bn per 1% move. Regime = "long" if spot >= flip, "short" below. Outputs: flip strike, dist_to_flip_pct, magnet_up/down (peak unsigned $gamma above/below spot), charm_anchor (peak |charm| in ±10% band), net_vex, net_cex, IV30 (linear interpolation at 30 calendar days), put/call OI ratio, max-pain.

**GEX MODEL (gex_model.py:146-706)**

Gamma profile curve: re-evaluates net dealer gamma across ±15% spot span at 81 grid points → the zero-crossing visualization.

Strike walls: heaviest unsigned $gamma strikes within ±12% and ≤365d expiry. Call wall = largest positive-net strike above spot; put wall = largest negative-net below. Scored with _level_strength (70% share of heaviest wall + 30% proximity in daily-σ units → 0-100 + band word). Wall hardness: wall ≥ 2× sum of two nearest same-side neighbors → "hard line".

Vol-hole state machine (gex_model.py:388-469): regime short → EXPANSION; long gamma → compare to_upper_sigma / to_lower_sigma vs hole_arm_sigma=1.0 → COILED_UP / COILED_DOWN / IN_HOLE. Compression: band_width_pct vs 2×weekly_1σ → tight/normal/wide.

25Δ Risk-reversal (gex_model.py:561-606): front liquid expiry ≥2 days and ≥6 strikes; uses feed delta where present else BS delta; finds contracts nearest ±0.25 delta; rr25 = put_iv25 − call_iv25 in vol points. Tone: fear≥3, greed≤−1, balanced otherwise.

Directional tilt: four legs — charm (intraday), pin (into expiry when spot within max(2.5%, weekly_1σ) of max-pain in long-gamma), skew (25Δ RR tone), regime — weighted synthesis W={skew:2, pin:1, charm:0.5}.

IV rank: short-window percentile of IV30 vs own ~40-day accrued history; explicitly flagged low_confidence when n<20.

**VOL REGIME (vol_regime.py:121-243)**

Three scored-eligible legs over 504-day rolling window: ts_slope = −z(VIX/VIX3M); move = −z(MOVE index level); vrp = z(VIX − HAR-forecasted realized vol). HAR lags: (2,5,22,66) days. VRP uses cone_vol_ann (engine/vol_forecast.py). Composite = equal-weight mean of available scored legs / leg_clip(2.5), clipped to [-1,1]. A leg only moves money when data/vol_regime/gate.json (written by scripts/validate_vol_regime.py) marks it scored=true. Vol-target scalar = target_vol_pct(12%) / max(21d-trailing-RV, VIX), clipped [0.5, 1.5].

Sizing overlay (vol_regime.py:482-552): two subtract-only levers: (1) mechanical vol-target scalar (always-on); (2) regime-state caution (warning=0.85, backwardation-stress=0.70); scored deepener only when gate open and regime is risk-off. Gross floor=0.40.

**OPTIONS FLOW (options_flow.py:68-380)**

Tick-rule signing: per minute, sign = sign(close − prev_close), carry forward, multiply by volume → signed_vol. Accuracy claimed ~77-83% per-trade (no NBBO/trade-tape). Net signed premium, delta flow, measured dealer gamma flow = −Σ(signed_customer_vol × gamma × 100 × S²). ΔOI positioning (reliable, no signing): day-over-day OI change per matched OCC ticker; tone uses 2% of prior OI as threshold. Data source: Massive.com OPRA minute flat files (requires MASSIVE_S3 credentials). 0DTE share = fraction of volume in same-day expiries.

**PER-STOCK SCORING (stock_score.py:560-724)**

GEX feeds two paths: (1) _risk_idio: GEX weight=0.10 in idio-risk axis; short/EXPANSION→0.6, COILED→0.4, long→0.1, other→0.3; (2) _gex_confirm_tilt: CONFIRM→+0.3, CAUTION→−0.3 additive nudge in entry axis. The two are bounded so GEX can never flip a tier alone.

**COT (commodity_signals.py:166-178, collectors/cot.py)**

COT is equity-index-agnostic here: used only for commodities (oil, gold, copper, dollar, bitcoin futures). Rolling percentile (pctile_lookback_d window) of net non-commercial as % of OI → crowded_long / crowded_short / neutral. No equity COT (E-mini spec positioning) is collected or used anywhere.

**OPEX (opex.py:88-155)**

Third-Friday calendar tagger with post-OPEX phase (td_since 1-5). Measured edge via Newey-West t-stat and pre/post-2010 sign check. Feeds gex_confirm's opex_suppress_days=2 window (forces NEUTRAL). CBOE equity put/call: computed proxy from SPX + SPY/QQQ/IWM volume (official CBOE market-statistics CSV went behind SPA in 2025/26); index_pc_ratio + equity_pc_ratio stored in data/cboe/putcall.
data_sources: CBOE delayed EOD option chain — per-strike [K, T, iv, oi, gamma, delta, volume, bid, ask] via chain_url; 10 underlyings: _SPX, SPY, QQQ, IWM, NVDA, AAPL, TSLA, AMD, META, MSFT; EOD cadence, NOT intraday
CBOE put/call proxy — computed from SPX+SPY+QQQ+IWM volume (official CDN endpoint went behind SPA 2025/26); stored as data/cboe/putcall/putcall.parquet

gaps: NO vol-control roll-off schedule: the blueprint's L5 core — knowing WHICH high-vol days are aging out of a vol-control fund's trailing window and the exact mechanical buying that creates when they drop — is entirely absent. The vol_regime.py vol_target_scalar is a sizing rule for THIS portfolio, not a model of external vol-control fund flows.

NO CTA trend-flip level: no estimate of the price level at which systematic CTA strategies flip long-to-short or vice versa (based on momentum lookback thresholds). The system has no COT-like positioning for equity futures (E-mini CME non-commercial not collected), no estimated CTA AUM in trend, and no net exposure curve vs spot.

NO ETF create/redeem flow: equity ETF share creation/redemption data (a direct measure of institutional demand) is absent. The BTC ETF farside flow exists for crypto but there is nothing equivalent for SPY, QQQ, sector ETFs, or factor ETFs.

NO equity-index COT: E-mini S&P / NASDAQ futures non-commercial positioning (the standard equity spec-positioning indicator) is not collected. The COT collector covers commodities, dollar, bitcoin — not equity index futures (commodity_inputs.py, forex_inputs.py are the consumers; no equity analog).

GEX dealer sign is an ASSUMPTION never resolved: the long-call/short-put convention is never replaced with a measured signal. options_flow.py's measured_dealer() fixes this for flow-signed data but requires MASSIVE_S3 credentials (a paid service) and is display-only pending calibration gate. The legacy assumption drives all scored paths.

No full IV surface: the system computes IV30 (ATM interpolated), front-expiry 25Δ risk-reversal, and per-strike smile. But IV-RV premium (VRP at multiple tenors), dispersion (index vs single-stock IV), term-slope as a continuous series, and skew at multiple deltas (10Δ, 25Δ, 50Δ) are not persisted or used in the regime engine. vol_regime.py uses only VIX minus HAR-RV for VRP.

GEX validation gate not yet passed: validate_gex.py is forward-accumulating from scratch (MIN_PER_BUCKET=30 observations per long/short bucket per symbol, horizon 5 and 10 days). Until this gate passes, GEX is officially restricted from scored paths — yet stock_score.py:563 already uses GEX at weight=0.10 in _risk_idio and ±0.3 as an entry tilt. This is a gating inconsistency vs the stated doctrine.

No transition probabilities: the regime is a discrete argmax state (long/short gamma) with no P(transition) or time-in-regime hazard. The blueprint requires a Markov-switching transition matrix; the closest approximation is dist_to_flip_pct (a continuous distance) which is NOT used in the scoring path.

Put/call history is too short for reliable percentile: the CBOE market-statistics CSV went behind a SPA in 2025/26; the proxy is computed from SPX+SPY/QQQ/IWM volume which only accrues forward from that date. The vol_shock_scorecard explicitly down-weights it when n_obs < 60 and iv_rank flags low_confidence when n<20. The froth_fragility.py and risk_radar.py both note the _FLOW_MIN_HISTORY=252 rows guard.

No conditional expected-value engine (L3 missing): there is no regime-conditional return distribution mu_{asset,quad} integrated over P(Quad). The GEX confirmer returns CONFIRM/NEUTRAL/CAUTION but with no forward-return quantification. The vol_shock_scorecard produces a 0-100 risk gauge but it is display-only with pre-registered forward outcomes not yet resolved into validated EV weights.

OPEX edge is measured in-sample only: opex.py reports Newey-West t-stats and subperiod sign-checks but the seasonality() function is called with the full history at build time — no purged K-fold, no embargo, no deflated Sharpe. The 'significant' flag is a single-sample in-sample test.

No HAR-RV forward vol for options pricing: vol_regime.py uses HAR for the VRP physical leg but does not produce a per-underlying forward vol DISTRIBUTION (GARCH/HAR with confidence intervals). Expected move is computed as IV30 × sqrt(T/252) — a point estimate with no uncertainty band.

No dispersion / single-stock vs index vol surface: dealer gamma for single names is explicitly flagged as fragile (covered-call ETFs / retail call-buying flip the sign) but there is no cross-sectional dispersion measure (index IV vs avg single-name IV) which is the cleanest mechanical vol-targeting signal in the literature.

Skew change not persisted as a time series: gex_confirm.py uses rr_change (25Δ RR change) only when passed in by the caller. The daily 1-row/symbol GEX summary parquet does NOT store rr_25d historically, so the change is available only when two consecutive build passes are compared in-process — it is not reliably accrued.

Persist net non-commercial % OI as cot_equity_index. In commodity_signals.positioning() generalize to support this series. The 1995+ CFTC Socrata history is free — no new data cost.

upgrades.title: Persist rr_25d daily in GEX summary parquet
upgrades.spec: In collectors/cboe.py GexAdapter._row(), add 'rr_25d' to the keep tuple (line 134). It is already computed by gex_engine (via gex_model.risk_reversal_25d) — just pass it through to the 1-row/day frame. In gex_confirm.assess(), compute rr_change = today_rr - prior_rr by reading the persisted parquet tail (the caller already has the parquet path). This converts the skew leg from a pass-in-from-caller signal to a reliably accrued daily series — unblocking the skew-change leg in all consumers.

upgrades.title: Vol-control roll-off schedule estimator
upgrades.spec: New file engine/vol_control.py. Inputs: daily VIX series (already in vol_regime.py). Method: for each trailing window length W in {21, 63} days, compute trailing realized vol as RV_W(t) and RV_W_dropone(t) = RV excluding the highest-vol day in the window. When RV_dropone < target_vol_pct and RV_W >= target_vol_pct, flag as a 'roll-off day' (a high-vol day aging out implies mechanical buying). Output: vol_control_buy_signal (bool), estimated_rebalance_dollar (rough: (target_vol/RV_W - target_vol/RV_dropone) × assumed_AUM_bn), days_to_next_dropoff (min days until the next historical spike ages out). Surface in vol_shock_scorecard as a dedicated 'vol_control' leg (weight 0.6 — it is the most mechanical and fastest of all L5 flows). AUM assumption can be config-overridable.

upgrades.title: CTA trend-flip level estimator
upgrades.spec: New file engine/cta_positioning.py. Method: for each lookback L in {20, 50, 100, 200} days, compute the return-signal: sign(close - close.shift(L)). CTA 'flip level' = the closing price at which the 100d momentum signal would change sign = close.shift(100). Output: dict with flip levels per lookback, current momentum exposure (sign-weighted mean across lookbacks), distance to nearest flip (pct), and estimated regime (all-long / mixed / all-short). Use E-mini COT net-spec position as an independent cross-check of the theoretical exposure. Surface in vol_shock_scorecard as a 'cta_flip' leg (weight 0.7). Feed into gex_confirm as a context note when spot is within 1% of the 50d flip level.

upgrades.title: IV surface persistence: VRP by tenor + dispersion
upgrades.spec: Extend GexAdapter._row() to persist iv30, iv60, iv90 (interpolated from the chain at 30/60/90 calendar days). Compute iv_rv_premium per tenor = iv_N - realized_vol_N (where realized_vol comes from vol_forecast.cone_vol_ann). Add dispersion = iv30_spx - mean(iv30_single_names) across the 9 single-name symbols. Persist all as columns in the gex_SPX summary parquet and gex_symbol summaries. In vol_regime.build_frame(), replace the single VRP leg with a 3-tenor VRP block (equal-weighted mean); add dispersion as a CONTEXT_LEGS candidate. This gives the vol surface a time series instead of a daily-rebuilt scalar.

upgrades.title: Continuous P(gamma regime transition) via threshold-crossing model
upgrades.spec: In engine/gex_engine.py, add a companion function regime_probability(dist_to_flip_pct, daily_vol_pct) that returns P(regime_flip_in_N_days) using a simple analytical approximation: model dist_to_flip as a Brownian motion with drift 0 and volatility = daily_vol_pct * sqrt(N); P(cross) = 2 * Phi(-|dist| / (daily_vol * sqrt(N))). N=5 (weekly horizon). Surface as 'p_flip_5d' in the GEX summary. Use this in gex_confirm.assess() to widen the OPEX suppression to any day where p_flip_5d > 0.35 (high-transition regimes suppress the confirmer strength even outside OPEX). Feed into vol_shock_scorecard dealer_gamma leg to downweight the regime reading when the flip is imminent.

upgrades.title: Run the GEX validation gate and fix the scoring inconsistency
upgrades.spec: scripts/validate_gex.py already exists and MIN_PER_BUCKET=30. Run it against the accumulated data/cboe/gex*.parquet history. If the gate passes (bootstrap 95% CI excludes 0 for short > long RV at 5d and 10d for SPX), update data/vol_regime/gex_gate.json with scored=true. If it does not pass, REMOVE GEX from stock_score.py _risk_idio (weight 0.10) and _gex_confirm_tilt (±0.3 in _axis_entry) and replace with display-only framing — because the current code violates the repo's own validate-before-weight doctrine (stock_score.py:563 already uses GEX in a scored path before the gate exists). The fix is either to open the gate or to remove the scored usage — leaving both active is the inconsistency to resolve.

upgrades.title: ETF create/redeem flow for sector/factor ETFs
upgrades.spec: New collector collectors/etf_flows.py. Source: ICI weekly mutual fund / ETF flow data (free, weekly) for asset-class level; Polygon Financials REST /v2/reference/financials for shares_outstanding change as a create/redeem proxy (15-min delayed on current plan). Initially scope to 11 SPDR sector SPDRs (XLK, XLV, etc.) and 4 factor ETFs (MTUM, QUAL, USMV, VLUE). Compute weekly ΔshO (shares outstanding change) as % of trailing average → a z-score. Surface in basket theme scoring as a flow_demand context chip. Do NOT score until validated (new data source). Build separate from the MASSIVE flow which requires paid credentials.

upgrades.title: HAR-GARCH forward vol distribution with confidence intervals

upgrades.title: OPEX seasonality: purged walk-forward validation
upgrades.spec: In engine/opex.py:seasonality(), replace the in-sample Newey-West test with a purged K-fold (K=5, embargo=max(fwd_days+1, 10) days) matching engine/validation.py precedent. Compute deflated Sharpe (DSR) per phase using engine/meta_label.py or a standalone DSR function: DSR = IS_Sharpe × sqrt(1 - skew(IS)/6 × IS_Sharpe + (IS_Sharpe^2/4) × (kurtosis(IS) - 3)/24 (Bailey-Lopez-de-Prado)). Gate the 'significant' flag on DSR > 0.5 rather than the raw t ≥ 2.0. This removes the in-sample bias that currently inflates the calendar tilt edge claim.

one_line_verdict: The GEX / options desk is architecturally honest and mechanically sound — gamma-flip, vol-hole, 25Δ RR, measured dealer flow, OPEX tagger, vol-regime sizing overlay all exist — but L5 is critically incomplete: no vol-control roll-off schedule, no CTA flip-level estimator, no equity-index COT, no ETF create/redeem, the put/call series is too young to be reliable, and GEX is already feeding per-stock scores in violation of the repo's own validate-before-weight gate.

Per-stock confluence buy gate: T1-T4 cascade from signal_quality.analyze + confluence_tiers.cascade; is_buyable(); blend_sorted()

current_method:
**Inputs:** yahoo_closes() reads adjusted-close parquet files (data/yahoo/*.parquet) — no ALFRED vintage awareness, latest-revision price only. SPDR ETFs (XLK/XLC/XLY/XLF/XLI/XLB/XLE/XLV/XLP/XLU/XLRE) + thematic basket EW indices via basket_index.consolidated_candle. Regime from data/regime/latest.json (argmax quad, growth_score, inflation_score, liquidity_overlay, transition_state, macro_risk).

**Cycle spine (sector_cycles.py):** 
- Oscillator: price / EWM(span=252) detrended, then stochastic-normalised over rolling 252-day window, smoothed EWM(span=10), output 0-100. Lines 93-103.
- Phase classification: votes from weekly MACD (×2) + 3D MACD (×1) + osc_slope tiebreaker (±1 if slope>3 or <-3). Thresholds: pos>=68→Peak/Downturn, pos<=32→Recovery/Trough, else Expansion/Downturn. Lines 161-189.
- Turn signal: BUY if pos<=45 AND osc_slope>0.5; SELL if pos>=55 AND osc_slope<-0.5. Line 320-321.
- ZigZag: 14% reversal threshold for sectors, vol-scaled for baskets (14%×max(1, annVol/0.22), capped 55%). Lines 106-157.
- RS leadership: 63d and 126d momentum of sector/SPY ratio + above-200d of the ratio. Lines 255-266.
- Next-turn projection: median half-cycle length of detected ZigZag swings (IQR for lo/hi window). Lines 192-215.

**Gated-confluence fuser (sector_central.py):**
- State score: 0.6×setup + 0.4×phase_dir, clipped [-1,1]; +/-0.12 for BUY/SELL signal. setup=(50-pos)/50. Lines 237-255. Phase direction weights: Trough +0.5, Recovery +0.6, Expansion +0.25, Peak -0.4, Downturn -0.55.
- Momentum confirm (capped ±0.3): RS rank percentile × 0.6, minus 0.1 if below-200d. Line 258-272.
- Gate 1 (regime): MRS from engine.conditions.macro_risk_score → risk_on = -(2×MRS-1) in [-1,+1]. gate = clip(0.5+0.5×risk_on, 0.2, 1.0); Q3/Q4 quad×0.85; contracting liquidity×0.8; complacency caution caps at 0.85. Lines 95-126.
- Gate 1 per-sector: gate_eff = clip(gate×(1+0.25×beta×risk_on), 0.2, 1.0) where beta from config.yml sector_macro_beta table (XLF=1.0, XLP=-0.56 etc). Lines 309-316.
- Gate 2 (trend): _abs_gate from narrative_rotation: above SMA-200 AND 12m return>0. If gate fails and gated>0: gated×=0.5. Lines 323-328.
- Final score: raw=clip(gated + 0.5×mom, -1,1); score=round((raw+1)/2×100). Lines 332-333.
- Conviction tiers: Accumulate>=72, Constructive>=58, Neutral>=43, Cautious>=30, Reduce>=0. Lines 44-50.
- Caps: below-trend name cannot exceed score 57; stretched (pos>=80) or crowded (frac>=0.34) cannot exceed 57. Lines 347-351.
- Confluence: count of {sign(state), tg_sign, sign(risk_on)} agreeing with direction. Lines 336-342.
- Output: per-sector dict with conviction, forward (trend_pass, above_200dma, ret_12m, next_turn window), state, momentum, crowding, heat (cap-weighted from sp500_heatmap.json), reasoning trace.

**Signal gate (signal_gate.py + confluence_tiers.py):**
- analyze() from signal_quality → verdict → gate adds T1-T4 cascade via confluence_tiers.cascade().
- T1: master take (3D RSI-MACD × 3D StochRSI, buy-filter endorsed), FRESH_TICKS=2 (≈6 days on 3D grid).
- T2: 2D RSI-MACD cross AND 3D StochRSI crossed within CONF_W=8 bars, RSI<BUY_RSI_MAX=65, fresh.
- T3: 2D RSI-MACD projected within EARLY_CROSS_BARS=1.5 bars AND 3D StochRSI already crossed.
- T4: same projection + 2D StochRSI crossed + above-200MA (earliest/weakest, T4 excluded from BUYABLE_TIERS).
- WEIGHTS: T1=1.0, T2=0.8, T3=0.6, T4=0.4. Blend score = TIER_FRAC(0.45)×tier_weight_normalized + 0.55×conviction_percentile.
- Not-topped veto: 3D StochRSI k>=80 or k<d or 3D RSI-MACD below signal → rejects all tiers.

**Grader (sector_central_grader.py):** Logs dated conviction calls to data/sector_central/calls.parquet (keep-first per date×id, de facto PIT call log). Grades matured calls at 21/63/126d: directional hit-rate, cross-sectional rank-IC, mean excess-vs-SPY by tier. Sparse until 6+ months of calls exist.

**Data provenance:** All price data = latest-revision Yahoo adjusted close (no ALFRED, no real-time vintage). MRS legs use FRED series (NFCI, recession risk) via conditions_frame, but without ALFRED point-in-time vintages. The 27-year phase0 backtest was run on sector ETF closes (1998-2026), which are subject to corporate action adjustments but NOT look-ahead on econ data.
data_sources: data/yahoo/*.parquet (Yahoo Finance adjusted-close, latest-revision, no vintage tracking)
data/regime/latest.json (argmax quad, growth/inflation scores, liquidity, transition, macro_risk)
data/baskets/membership.json + basket_index.consolidated_candle (equal-weight current-membership index, survivorship-NOT-clean)
site/marketdata/sp500_heatmap.json (Finviz cap-weighted sector heat/breadth, coincident)
data/strategies/thematic_rotation_phase0.json (27y backtest validation output)
data/sector_central/calls.parquet (self-grader log, accruing)
engine/conditions.py: FRED NFCI, recession_risk, drawdown_risk from conditions_frame (no ALFRED vintage)
config.yml sector_macro_beta table (measured + shrunk betas, lines 1675-1701)
gaps: NO regime-conditional expected-return driver: the conviction score is a state+gate composite (0-100), not E[r_sector|Quad_k] integrated over P(Quad). There is no table of mu_{sector,quad} estimated on PIT regime labels, no P(Quad) weighting, no CVaR. The only 'forward' axis is the binary trend gate (validated for drawdown control, NOT return magnitude). Blueprint L3 is completely absent.

Discrete argmax regime, not continuous probabilities: latest.json carries a single quad label (argmax) and growth_score/inflation_score scalars, but no P(Q1)/P(Q2)/P(Q3)/P(Q4) distribution and no transition matrix P(Quad_j|Quad_i). The gate_factor uses a point estimate of risk_on, not expectation over regime uncertainty. Blueprint L2 is absent.

Growth/inflation axes are first-derivative (20d slope z-scored vs 60d in engine/axes.py), not second-derivative base-effect forecast. There is no YoY comparison, no base-period math, no deterministic forward path from known comps. The engine reads market prices (SPY, XLY/XLP ratio, HYG, copper etc.) as growth proxies — a coincident market-proxy read, not a lagged-econ 2nd-derivative forecast. Blueprint L1 is missing.

No forward vol / range distribution: sector_cycles.py _project_next() emits a half-cycle median + IQR as a date window (heuristic, not probabilistic). There is no realized-vol series for sectors (close-to-close only), no HAR-RV, no GARCH forward vol, no quantile regression, no skewed-t return distribution. Blueprint L4 is absent.

No mechanical-flow front-running at the sector level: GEX/dealer gamma, vol-control roll-off schedule, CTA flip levels, COT z-scores are not integrated into the sector gate or sizing. Blueprint L5 is absent.

Validation is win-rate + rank-IC, not deflated Sharpe / PBO / purged-CV: sector_signals.py STATE_BASE_RATES show hit-rates (56%, 50%, etc.) and n-counts. The phase0 backtest reports Sharpe/MaxDD/CalmarRatio/DSR for portfolio strategies but not meta-labeling or triple-barrier labeling for individual signal quality. sector_central_grader.py accrues directional hit-rate and rank-IC but no expectancy, PBO, purged K-fold, or VIX-bucket breakdown. Blueprint L6 partially met (Sharpe/DSR in phase0, grader accruing) but no deflated Sharpe on the conviction score itself.

No portfolio construction layer: the conviction score (0-100) drives a display rank but there is no position sizing, HRP weights, Black-Litterman views, vol-target constraint, CVaR budget, or gross/net dial derived from regime. The output is a qualitative conviction board, not a weights vector. Blueprint L7 is absent.

Basket cycle math uses current-membership tape (survivorship-NOT-clean), explicitly acknowledged in sector_central.py line 7-8 and sector_cycles.py build_basket. Phase0 backtest on sectors is clean (SPDR ETFs with full history); basket momentum scores are confidence-capped but never adjusted for survivorship bias quantitatively.

Regime gate consumes latest.json which can mix legs across release dates (conditions.py macro_risk_score comment line 757-759): 'quad stale while conditions update'. This is flagged but not resolved — the live MRS scalar may come from a different as-of date than the quad label.

No econ nowcast with uncertainty: MRS legs (recession_risk, drawdown_risk, NFCI percentile, liquidity, transition) are binary or level-thresholded scalars combined with fixed weights (_mrs_weights()). There is no dynamic factor model, Kalman filter, or Giannone-Reichlin-style mixed-frequency nowcast giving a growth/inflation state with variance. Blueprint L1 MFM/Kalman leg is absent.

The detrended oscillator (sector_cycles.py lines 93-103) uses a 252-day EWM trend + 252-day rolling stochastic + 10-day EWM smoothing. The ZigZag 14% threshold is fixed for sectors (not recalibrated to the sector's own vol distribution). Phase thresholds (68/32) are also fixed heuristics without out-of-sample calibration or sensitivity testing.

upgrades.title: Regime-conditional sector E[r] table (L3 core engine)
upgrades.spec: New file engine/sector_regime_ev.py. For each of the 11 SPDR ETFs, estimate mu_{sector,quad} = mean forward-63d excess-vs-SPY conditioned on PIT quad label using the existing sector_central_grader call log (once accrued) OR a bootstrap from the 27y phase0 closes + engine/regime.py replay. Use HMM-labeled (Hamilton 1989) regimes on the (growth_score, inflation_score) series rather than argmax to get smoother labels. Blend E[r_sector] = sum_k P(Quad_k) * mu_{sector,k} * intensity_k where intensity = distance from argmax boundary (use growth_score abs value as a proxy). Expose as sector_ev_score alongside the existing conviction score. Feed into blend_sorted() as base_of() for the sector board. Persist regime-conditional return table to data/sector_central/regime_ev.parquet. Update build_sector_central.py to call sector_regime_ev.compute() and attach to each sector row as 'ev' field.
deps: Sufficient call log accrued (6+ months) or phase0 replay harness

upgrades.title: Continuous regime probabilities via Markov-switching (L2)
upgrades.spec: New file engine/regime_hmm.py. Fit a 4-state Gaussian HMM (statsmodels.tsa.regime_switching.MarkovRegression) on the daily (growth_score, inflation_score) series from data/regime/latest.json history (or rebuild from engine/axes.py scores). Output P(Quad_k) daily + 4×4 transition matrix + smoothed state probabilities. Write to data/regime/hmm_probs.json (asof, probs dict, transition_matrix). Consume in sector_central._regime_anchor(): replace the scalar gate_factor with sum_k P(Quad_k) * quad_return_weight_k, so the gate is already regime-probability-weighted. This directly unblocks L3's integration. Add hmm_probs to the market context output for the UI confidence bar.
deps: engine/axes.py score history (rebuild needed if not persisted)

upgrades.title: Sector realized-vol + HAR-RV forward vol surface (L4 base)
upgrades.spec: Extend engine/sector_cycles.py _record_core() to compute: (1) Yang-Zhang OHLC realized vol using data/yahoo/{tk}.parquet high/low/close columns (already in store per inputs.py line 88+); (2) 21d and 63d close-to-close annualized vol; (3) a simple HAR-RV 1-day-ahead forecast (vol_1d = a + b*rv_1d + c*rv_5d + d*rv_22d) fit on the full history, exposing fitted params and forecast. Output as 'vol': {'rv_21d', 'rv_63d', 'har_fwd_1d'} in each sector record. Use in sector_central._fuse() to widen the projection cone: append a conditional return range as mean_63d_excess ± 1.5*rv_63d to the forward dict. Surface as a 'return_range' field. This is the honest interval the blueprint calls for.
deps: OHLC data available in data/yahoo/ parquets (confirmed by inputs.py line 88)

upgrades.title: Deflated Sharpe + PBO on conviction score and sector confluence signal (L6)
upgrades.spec: New script scripts/validate_sector_central.py. Using sector_central_grader calls.parquet + phase0 sector closes: (1) compute Sharpe of a go-long-Accumulate / go-short-Reduce sector rotation portfolio on 63d hold; (2) apply Bailey-Borwein-Plouffe DSR deflation (m_trials = number of parameter/threshold combinations tested in sector_signals.py + sector_central.py: ~15 thresholds); (3) run Hansen-style PBO with 20 combinatorially-purged splits (cscv from mlfinlab or manual); (4) add an embargo of 63 bars between train/test folds in the rank-IC computation inside sector_central_grader.grade(); (5) break scorecard by VIX bucket (<15, 15-25, >25) and by realized quad. Output to data/sector_central/validation.json and render in the grader scorecard panel.

upgrades.title: Regime-transition probability hazard + conviction de-emphasis near transitions (L2/cross)
upgrades.spec: In engine/regime_hmm.py (from the L2 upgrade above), compute the hazard rate = P(regime change within next 21d) from the current smoothed state probabilities and the transition matrix. Expose as 'transition_hazard_21d' in the regime anchor. In sector_central._fuse(): when transition_hazard_21d > 0.35, apply a conviction multiplier of 0.85 to all scores (not a binary gate — continuous de-emphasis). Surface in the reasoning trace as 'Regime transition risk: {hazard:.0%} probability of quad change within 21d — conviction widened'. This directly implements the blueprint's 'widen when P(regime transition) is high' instruction.

upgrades.title: Base-effect deterministic forward path for growth/inflation axes (L1 partial)
upgrades.spec: New file engine/base_effects.py. For each econ series in conditions_frame (NFCI, WEI, jobless claims, ADS index), compute the 12m-ago base value (known deterministically). Project the YoY rate assuming flat sequential momentum: proj_yoy_t = (current_level / level_12m_ago) - 1, then for each of next 13 weeks: proj_yoy_t+k = (level_t / level_t+k-52w) - 1 where future numerators are extrapolated by trailing 4w sequential average. Compute the sign of the 2nd derivative of projected YoY (acceleration/deceleration). Output as growth_base_tilt: +1 accelerating / -1 decelerating / 0 flat, for the next 1Q and 2Q. Feed into sector_central.market_context() as 'base_effect_tilt' — a nudge factor on the gate (not a full override): if base_tilt=+1 and current growth_score<0, relax the gate by ×1.05. ALFRED point-in-time vintages would be ideal but are optional in phase 1; use current FRED pulls with explicit 'revised-data' flag in output.
deps: FRED series already in conditions_frame (NFCI, WEI, claims)
ALFRED API key optional for PIT

upgrades.title: Survivorship-corrected basket cycle math (cross-cutting correctness)
upgrades.spec: In engine/sector_cycles.py build_basket() and engine/basket_index.py consolidated_candle(), add a point-in-time membership filter: load historical membership snapshots from data/baskets/membership_history.parquet (to be created by collectors/basket_history.py) keyed by (basket_id, as_of_date). When computing the EW level for date t, use only members that were in the basket as of date t. Fallback to current membership if history unavailable (current behavior, with explicit 'survivorship_bias=True' flag in the output record). Until history is built, add 'survivorship_note' to every basket record so the UI can display a warning banner on basket cycle cards. The phase0 strategy backtest on SECTOR ETFs is clean; only basket momentum scores are affected.

upgrades.title: Regime-conditional crowding fragility sizing (L3/L5 cross)
upgrades.spec: Extend engine/sector_central._fuse(): currently crowding only caps conviction at 57 when frac>=0.34. Upgrade to a continuous sizing penalty: size_mult = 1.0 - clip(crowd['frac'] - 0.2, 0, 0.4) * 1.5, so 20% crowded = no penalty, 47%+ crowded = 0.4× size. Integrate this with the regime: in Q4 (Growth-scare) multiply the crowding penalty by 1.5 (crowded unwinds faster in risk-off). Expose size_mult in the components dict for transparency. This converts the current binary cap into a continuous, regime-conditional sizing input, consistent with the 'per-NAME crowding effect' finding from phase0 (basket_extension=no_basket_drawdown_edge in the verdict).

upgrades.title: Mechanical flow signals at sector level (L5: vol-control + CTA)
upgrades.spec: New file engine/sector_flow_signals.py. Three inputs already in the close panel: (1) VIX level from closes['^VIX'] — compute realized-vol roll-off: identify high-VIX days (VIX>25) aging out of the trailing 21d realized-vol window, flag 'mechanical_bid_likely' when 3+ such days exit the window in the next 5d; (2) sector-level CTA trend flip: compute a 50d/200d MA crossover on each SPDR, flag 'cta_flip_pending' when the 50d is within 1% of the 200d; (3) sector-level put/call using Polygon options data if available (data/options/). Output per-sector flow_signals dict with 3 boolean flags + a composite 0-3 count. Attach to sector_central._fuse() reasoning trace as a 'Mechanical flow' confirmer layer (display tier only, not affecting conviction score in phase 1).
deps: VIX data already in yahoo closes
Polygon options subscription for put/call (massive.com per memory)

upgrades.title: Cross-sectional rank-IC with purged K-fold and embargo in grader (L6 rigor)
upgrades.spec: Modify engine/sector_central_grader.grade(): in the per-date rank-IC loop (lines 169-171), replace simple groupby-date Spearman with a purged walk-forward: for each evaluation date, purge the training window of 63d (the holding period) before and after the test date. Add ic_t_hac (Newey-West HAC t-stat on the IC series) alongside ic_mean. Add expectancy = mean(fwd_excess) × hit_rate - mean(abs(fwd_excess[miss])) × (1-hit_rate) per tier. Add max_drawdown_of_signal = max consecutive 'up' calls with negative fwd_excess. Write these to the by_horizon dict. This mirrors the ic_t_hac the phase0 thematic backtest already computes (data/strategies/thematic_rotation_phase0.json rank_ic block).

one_line_verdict: The pipeline is a rigorous, honestly-documented state+gate machine (cycle rhythm → validated trend drawdown gate → MRS regime gate → momentum confirm) that correctly avoids fabricating directional alpha it doesn't have, but it produces only a 0-100 conviction label with zero regime-conditional expected-return content (no E[r|Quad], no P(Quad) weighting, no transition probabilities, no vol surface, no portfolio sizing) — it is a well-built dashboard display, not an expected-value ranker.

current_method:
**Signal Lab Registry** (`engine/signal_lab.py`, lines 91-729): A curated REGISTRY of 40+ signal rows, each with sourced numeric stats (IC, IC-IR, NW HAC t, BH-FDR q, DSR, Sharpe, hit, n). Tier taxonomy: scored (4 items), confirmer (~14), display (~15), killed (~10), pending. Assembled by `build_scorecard()` (line 755) which reads `ic_scorecard.json` live and appends 11-factor PIT cross-section rows. No new computation — pure assembler of already-run validations. Numerics are manually curated from named report files (the `source` field).

**validate_signals.py** (lines 1-229): JSON-schema safety gate ONLY. Validates shape/ordering of `site/signals/*.json` and `data/signal_archive/mtf_signals_latest.json` against `research/signal_engine/SCHEMA.json`. Checks: (1) marker date strict ascending order; (2) `quality` field present only on buy/rebuy markers. Writes `data/quality/signals_audit.json`. Not a signal-validity check — a contract-compliance gate.

**walk_forward.py** (`research/signal_engine/walk_forward.py`, lines 1-820): Stop-aware purged/embargoed harness. Config: `train_len=378d, test_len=189d, step=189d, purge=5d, embargo=5d, stop_pct=-0.05`. Primary metric: `stop_out_rate` (% of trades stopped out at ≤-5%). Entry on DAILY bar strictly after the 3D-bar known date (leak-free TF mapping, lines 154-200). Simulation: per-bar stop check using actual `low`; gap-through filled at bar high (lines 246-265). Overfit guard: kill_rule requires ≥70% of held-out names to improve vs baseline (line 558); `_mt_bump()` raises bar by `min(0.20, 0.05*log2(n_trials))` for multiple configs (lines 507-512). Verdict metric `stop_out_rate` is banned from total-return or max-DD decisions (lines 116, 123-128). Logs to `data/signal_archive/wf_*.json`.

**factor_ic_scorecard.py** (`scripts/factor_ic_scorecard.py`, lines 1-321): Quarterly PIT factor IC scorecard. Grid: quarter-end dates from `start_year` (default 2011) leaving `horizon` (default 63d) forward room. Per date: `compute_factors(asof=d, universe=...)` reads EDGAR PIT panel + prices truncated to `asof` (no look-ahead). Factor z-score → `rank_ic()` (Spearman) vs forward return. Aggregated: `ic_summary()` = mean IC, IC vol, IC-IR, annualized IC-IR, Newey-West HAC t (lags=2 quarters). `benjamini_hochberg()` at alpha=0.10 across factor panel. Incremental IC: `cross_sectional_resid()` neutralizes each factor vs style basis (market_beta, size, mom_12_1, low_vol) before re-correlating. `--deep` mode uses `data/edgar/sue_deep_closes.parquet` (survivorship-biased, 2011-2026, 60 rebalances). Live scorecard: only `payout` survives BH-FDR (q=0.0715) on deep panel; all others fail (value t=2.0 but q=0.247; SUE collapsed to IC=0.0006 post-depth-revalidation).

**engine/validation.py** (lines 1-863): Core primitive suite — `deflated_sharpe()` (Bailey-LdP 2014, line 218): `dsr = Φ((SR - SR0) * √(T-1) / √var_scaler)` where SR0 = expected max of N normals; floor `sr_variance ≥ var_scaler/(T-1)`; accepts `ledger=` (honest) or `n_trials=` (legacy). `purged_folds()` (line 282): K contiguous time folds with trailing `embargo` rows dropped. `cpcv_paths()` (line 319): C(n_groups, k_test) combinatorial purged CV splits with symmetric `embargo`-bar purge on both sides of each test block. `prob_backtest_overfitting()` (line 347): CSCV — for each IS/OOS partition split, take IS-best config, find its OOS rank, logit(rank/(N+1)); PBO = fraction where logit < 0. `block_bootstrap_ci()` (line 402): circular block bootstrap (block=21, B=5000) → Sharpe 95% CI + maxDD CI. `brier_reliability()` + `platt_fit()` + `expected_calibration_error()` + `isotonic_calibration()` (lines 474-571): probability calibration checks. `rank_ic()`, `newey_west_tstat()` (Bartlett kernel, lags=4), `ic_summary()`, `benjamini_hochberg()`, `cross_sectional_resid()`, `incremental_ic()` (lines 622-863). CRPS: `crps_ensemble()` (sorted-ensemble O(m log m) identity, line 717), `crps_score()` with skill vs climatology. OOS tests: `oos_r2()` (Campbell-Thompson) + `clark_west()` (nested model correction).

**engine/meta_label.py** (lines 1-570): LdP triple-barrier meta-labeling for BTC Vector. `triple_barrier_labels()` (line 89): symmetric vol-scaled barriers at `p0*(1 ± mult*σ*√horizon)`, walking forward up to `horizon` bars; time-barrier fallback = sign of forward return. `purged_oof_proba()` (line 198): HistGradientBoostingClassifier trained on purged/embargoed folds (modes: walkforward causal + CPCV combinatorial). Verdict requires DSR ≥ dsr_floor=0.90, calibrated (Brier skill > 0 AND Platt a ∈ [0.3, 2.0]), ΔSharpe ≥ 0.05, ΔMaxDD ≥ -2pp. BTC GBT KILLED: ΔSharpe -0.43, 20/20 configs lost (`signal_lab.py` line 350).

**engine/promotion_gate.py** (lines 1-139): Multi-gate PROPOSE-not-deploy decision. Gates: (1) DSR ≥ 0.95 via Trial Ledger; (2) PBO < 0.50; (3) CPCV path-sign consistency ≥ 0.80; (4) IC drift (via `engine/drift.py rolling_ic_drift`); (5) beats incumbent by 10% margin; (6) Holdout Vault peek (records budget spend). Returns eligible/blocking dict.

**engine/trial_ledger.py** (lines 1-254): Append-only JSONL at `data/trial_ledger.jsonl`. Dedup by content hash. `effective_n()` = max(literal_N, declared_budget). `log_declared_budget()` = floor that can only raise haircut. `test_no_literal_ntrials.py` ratchet blocks new bare `n_trials=` literals.

**forward_dist.py** + **vol_forecast.py**: Anticipation Engine's distribution layer. `forward_paths()` (close-based ret/mae/mfe, no look-ahead). `multi_horizon_cone()` = empirical conditional distribution per live state band (quantile_edges). Vol width: equal-weight HAR blend at lags (2,5,22,66d), no fitted regression.

**Data provenance**: EDGAR equity factors are POINT-IN-TIME (truncated to asof). Macro data (FRED) is latest-revision (ALFRED vintages used only in the SPVector PIT audit, not in live regime engine). Signal registry numerics are quoted from research reports (manual curation); no automatic daily update of most registry stats.

gaps: L1 GAP — No base-effect or 2nd-derivative growth/inflation forecasting: engine/regime.py uses argmax over 20d-slope z-scored vs 60d; this is a first-derivative market-proxy read (levels of change in market ratios), not a base-effect deterministic forward projection of YoY inflections from known denominators. No ALFRED real-time vintage awareness in the live regime engine (used only in the SPVector PIT audit); no MIDAS, no DFM/Kalman, no ADS cross-check. The 4 econ confirmers (WEI, NFCI, ADS, PMI) are latest-revision and half-weight. No forward-path distribution for growth/inflation 1-3 quarters out.

L2 GAP — Regime is a hard discrete argmax (4 boxes), not a continuous probability distribution: no Markov-switching or HMM giving P(Quad_k) per day. No transition matrix P(Quad_j next | Quad_i now). No time-in-regime hazard function. Liquidity and policy are not explicit regime axes. The 6% whipsaw stat and regime-change count exist (validation.md) but these characterize the discrete state machine, not a probabilistic one. P(regime change) is never computed or used to widen the cone or de-emphasize conditional return means.

L3 GAP — No per-asset regime-conditional expected return engine: no mu_{a,k} estimated per asset/sector per regime quad on point-in-time regime labels, no E[r_a] = sum_k P(Quad_k)*mu_{a,k}*intensity_k ranker. The forward_dist.py / anticipation engine conditions on a price-derived state band (momentum/vol) rather than on the macro regime quad. The signal_lab registry reports split-half means for a few assets (China Quad fwd-63d: Growth-scare +6.09% vs Reflation -2.85%) but this is display-only context, not a wired ranker. Intensity weighting (delta into the quad) is entirely absent.

L4 GAP — Vol forecast is close-to-close HAR equal-weight blend (no fitted regression coefficients), no OHLC (Yang-Zhang) realized vol, no IV surface at all (level, IV-RV premium, 25d skew, term slope, dispersion are not computed), no GARCH or skewed-t GARCH forward quantiles, no measurable-coverage conditional quantile forecasts. The cone width uses the HAR-style scalar (cone_vol_ann, vol_forecast.py line 35) and empirical conditional quantiles from past realized returns in the live state band — empirical quantile regression, not a parametric model with formal coverage testing.

L5 GAP — Mechanical-flow front-running: GEX desk exists (confirmer tier: index dealer-gamma validated, single-name killed), but no vol-control roll-off schedule (tracking which high-vol days are aging out of trailing windows to predict mechanical buying), no CTA trend flip levels, no dealer gamma-flip level computation, no ETF create/redeem flow. COT z-score used as a context feature in BTC meta-label (line 64) but not wired to a systematic front-running signal for equities or macro.

L6 GAP — Deflated Sharpe, PBO, purged-k-fold, BH-FDR, Brier calibration are all IMPLEMENTED as primitives (engine/validation.py) and applied in the research phase-0 scripts. HOWEVER the live signal registry stats are manually curated from past reports (signal_lab.py REGISTRY hardcoded lines 91-729); they are NOT recomputed daily. There is no automated daily re-run of the full L6 battery to detect regime-conditional IC decay or post-publication performance degradation. The payout factor currently has q_fdr=0.0715 on the deep survivorship-biased panel; whether it still survives on a daily-updated forward window is unknown. No rank-IC broken out by realized VIX bucket. Expectancy and profit-factor are computed in the walk_forward harness (expectancy = mean return per trade) but NOT reported on the signal_lab page or used in the 5-tier verdict decision — only DSR, IC/IC-IR/t-HAC/q-FDR, and Sharpe are displayed.

L6 GAP — Triple-barrier labeling exists (engine/meta_label.py, line 89) and is implemented correctly (vol-scaled symmetric barriers, forward walking, time-barrier fallback) but is used ONLY for the BTC GBT meta-label (DEFAULT-OFF, KILLED result). It is not used to label the US equity signal entries in walk_forward.py — which uses a stop-out-rate metric instead. The two approaches are complementary; neither replaces the other, but the walk_forward side has no Brier/calibration check on P(trade profitable).

L6 GAP — Meta-labeling (Lopez de Prado ch.3 architecture) is implemented for BTC only and was KILLED (ΔSharpe -0.43). No meta-labeling has been applied to the US confluence buy-filter in walk_forward.py — the filter currently improves stop_out_rate (the primary metric) but no P(trade correct) probability is published, no calibration is measured, and no meta-size scheme scales position by trust.

L7 GAP — No HRP, no Black-Litterman, no vol-target + CVaR constraint portfolio construction. The SPVector is a pure long/flat (1.0 or 0.0) overlay on SPY, sized by a rule-based vector score crossing thresholds, not by a drawdown-budgeted optimizer. No gross/net leverage dial driven by P(Quad_k). BTC Vector uses a discrete long/flat grid (not vol-targeted). GTAA masterminds uses inverse-vol weighting + 12% vol-target + 1.6× leverage cap — this is the closest to L7, but it is a pre-parameterized chassis, not a live L3-views-into-BL-optimizer.

MISSING: No automatic forward IC tracking / concept-drift monitor integrated into the daily build pipeline. engine/drift.py rolling_ic_drift exists and is wired into promotion_gate.py, but there is no daily CI step that computes rolling IC on live signals and alerts on drift. The SUE demotion (2026-06-17) was discovered by a manual deep re-validation, not by an automated alert.

MISSING: The ic_scorecard.json deep panel is SURVIVORSHIP-BIASED (delisted names absent, documented caveat at line 209-213 of factor_ic_scorecard.py). A de-biased runner (--debiased flag) exists but writes to ic_scorecard_debiased.json separately; the live page reads the survivor-biased file. The dead-name coverage ratio (_dead_name_coverage.json) is display-only telemetry, never a gate.

MISSING: No point-in-time vintage tracking for the macro regime engine (engine/axes.py, engine/regime.py). FRED data is latest-revision. The SPVector was audited against ALFRED vintages (Sharpe 0.90 vs 0.92, referenced in signal_lab.py line 106) but this was a one-time audit, not an ongoing vintage-aware backtest or live data feed.

MISSING: No OOS R2 or Clark-West test for the macro regime quad or any market-timed signal against the Goyal-Welch expanding-mean benchmark. oos_r2() and clark_west() are implemented in validation.py (lines 758-804) but not applied to any live signal in the registry.

upgrades.spec: Add scripts/monitor_signal_ic.py: for each REGISTRY signal with IC > 0 and a data source (momentum, insider, payout factor), compute rolling 63-day rank-IC on the live universe using the most recent 252 rebalance dates. Feed the IC stream to engine/drift.py rolling_ic_drift() (threshold=0.05, delta=0.005). Write data/quality/signal_ic_monitor.json {signal, rolling_ic_63d, drift_flag, last_updated}. Add a build step in daily.yml after factor_ic_scorecard and emit a PushNotification if any scored/confirmer signal flips drift_flag=True. File to add: scripts/monitor_signal_ic.py (~120 lines). File to modify: .github/workflows/daily.yml (add step). Existing primitives: engine/drift.py, engine/validation.py rank_ic, engine/equity_factors.py.

upgrades.title: Survivorship-corrected factor IC scorecard as the live page default
upgrades.spec: Switch the live signal_lab page to read ic_scorecard_debiased.json when available (engine/signal_lab.py line 734: change path to prefer _debiased.json). In scripts/factor_ic_scorecard.py --debiased mode, the dead-name price panel (data/edgar/_dead_name_prices.parquet or merged from existing dead-name fundamentals in collectors/edgar.py) is used to extend the close panel. Gate: only switch when dead_name_coverage['price_coverage'] > 0.30 (at least 30% of dead names have recovered prices). Suppress the survivor-biased scorecard from being the primary read on the page. This is the most dangerous single bias in the current factor IC reads: payout q=0.0715 on a survivor-biased panel may not survive a clean panel.

upgrades.title: Discrete regime → continuous P(Quad_k) via Markov-switching
upgrades.spec: Add engine/regime_prob.py implementing a 4-state Gaussian Markov-switching model (Hamilton 1989) over [growth_score, inflation_score] from engine/axes.py. State k has Gaussian emission N(mu_k, Sigma_k); transition matrix A_4x4 fit by EM (Baum-Welch, 20 iterations). Output: daily P(Quad_k) vector + transition matrix + time-in-regime hazard (geometric from diagonal of A). Use a ROLLING 252-day re-fit (causal) to avoid look-ahead. Expose as regime_prob.today() -> {quad_probs:[p1,p2,p3,p4], transition_matrix:..., hazard:float}. Integrate into engine/regime.py as an additive output field (keep argmax for backward compat). Requires numpy only (no scipy). Size: ~200 lines. Render hazard + P(Quad_k) bar in macro.html via a new data leaf.

upgrades.title: Regime-conditional expected return ranker (L3 Hubble)
upgrades.spec: Add engine/regime_ev.py: for each asset a in a configured universe (SPY sector ETFs + scored baskets + factor ETFs), estimate mu_{a,k} = mean forward 63d return conditional on regime quad k, using point-in-time regime labels from historical argmax (or P(Quad_k) once L2 lands). E[r_a] = sum_k P(Quad_k) * mu_{a,k} (or argmax quad for interim). CVaR_{a,k} = 5th percentile of same conditional distribution. Rank by E[r_a] / CVaR_{a,k}. Score must be: (a) updated daily, (b) labeled with the n_k per cell and a 'thin' flag when n_k < 30, (c) shown with Newey-West CI (newey_west_tstat on the conditional IC series). Write data/regime_ev.json. Render on macro.html as a ranked table of cross-asset conditional expected returns. This is the single highest-value L3 item: it converts the validated macro regime read into a cross-asset allocator with honest uncertainty.

upgrades.title: OHLC Yang-Zhang realized vol + IV surface placeholders for L4 cone
upgrades.spec: In engine/vol_forecast.py, add yang_zhang_vol(open, high, low, close, win) -> pd.Series implementing the Yang-Zhang (2000) OHLC estimator: YZ = log(O_t/C_{t-1})^2 + k*log(H_t/L_t)^2 + (1-k)*RS^2, where k=0.34/(1+((n+1)/(n-1))), RS = Rogers-Satchell. Update har_vol() to accept OHLC as well as close-only, blending YZ with close-only RV using equal weights when OHLC available (falls back to close-only). For IV surface: add ivol_surface() that reads a configured data source (currently display-only: no free real-time IV data). Expose iv_rv_premium (last 21d IV minus realized) and term_slope (front vs 3m) as display-only fields. Update cone_vol_ann() to prefer YZ when OHLC available. File to modify: engine/vol_forecast.py (~50 lines added). Data dependency: stocks/*.parquet already contains high/low (walk_forward.py uses them); same parquet for vol_forecast.

upgrades.title: Probability-of-trade-correct calibration on US confluence buy-filter
upgrades.spec: In research/signal_engine/walk_forward.py, after simulate_trades(), compute per-trade binary outcome (ret > 0) and the stop-out flag. Add calibrate_trade_proba(trades, features_fn) where features_fn(close, entry_i) -> feature_dict (can include: entry_eff, mae_bucket, regime at entry). Fit platt_fit() from engine/validation.py on OOF probabilities (CPCV split). Write calibrated P(win | context) to the per-trial JSON log. Render on signal_lab page as a calibration reliability chart (brier_reliability output). This closes the gap between the stop-out-rate harness and the LP-style meta-label: the filter already SELECTS better entries; now we measure whether it also produces calibrated win-probability estimates.

upgrades.title: Base-effect deterministic forward-path projection for growth/inflation
upgrades.spec: Add scripts/base_effect_projection.py: for each macro series with a YoY construct (CPI, PCE, WEI, ISM, NFP), compute the known base-period values for the next 4 quarters (fully known today). Project forward YoY under three sequential-momentum assumptions (flat, +1-sigma, -1-sigma from trailing 12m monthly changes). Output: forward YoY paths with 2nd-derivative sign for growth and inflation, stored in data/macro/base_effect_projection.json {growth_2d_sign, inflation_2d_sign, quarter, base_period_val, current_yoy}. Wire as an additive display field in macro.html (base-effect arrow: directional tailwind/headwind). This is the Hedgeye kernel: the forward 2nd-derivative sign is mechanistically determined by the base period alone ~68% of the time. Data: FRED API (CPI, PCE) + existing WEI/ADS feeds. NOT a regime-replacement — an additional forward-facing layer the current 20d-slope engine cannot see.

upgrades.title: OOS R2 + Clark-West test on live timed signals
upgrades.spec: Add scripts/validate_oos_r2.py: for each scored/confirmer signal that produces a forward return forecast (SPVector risk_score as continuous predictor, China reversal quantile rank, payout factor), run engine/validation.py oos_r2() comparing the signal forecast vs expanding historical mean (Goyal-Welch benchmark), and clark_west() for the nested-model correction. Report CW t-stat and one-sided p per signal. Write results to data/quality/oos_r2_audit.json. Include in the signal_lab page as an additional honesty column. Existing primitives: oos_r2(), clark_west() at validation.py lines 758-804, already written but unused.

upgrades.title: Regime-conditional IC breakout by VIX bucket on factor scorecard
upgrades.spec: In scripts/factor_ic_scorecard.py, add a VIX-bucket split: for each rebalance date, read VIX level from data/yahoo/^VIX.parquet and bucket into LOW (<15), MED (15-25), HIGH (>25). Compute rank_ic separately per bucket. Add to each factor row: {ic_vix_low, ic_vix_med, ic_vix_high, t_hac_vix_high}. Write to ic_scorecard.json. Render in signal_lab factor table as regime-conditional IC columns with color-coding. This detects factor crashes (factors that work in calm but fail in stress) and is required for honest L6 accounting: the current single mean-IC hides regime conditionality.

upgrades.title: Transition-probability hazard rendered in regime display
upgrades.spec: Once regime_prob.py is built (L2 upgrade), wire the transition matrix and time-in-regime hazard into macro.html's regime card. Render: current P(Quad_k) as a 4-bar probability bar; P(regime change in next 20d) = 1 - (1-hazard)^20 as a single number; most likely next regime as an arrow. This converts the regime display from a single label to a probabilistic read that the user can use to size regime-conditional bets and widen stops ahead of high-hazard transitions.

one_line_verdict: The validation spine is institutionally credible and complete as a RESEARCH harness (DSR, PBO, CPCV, purged-CV, BH-FDR, Brier calibration, meta-labeling, Trial Ledger are all implemented and used in phase-0 scripts), but live production is missing: continuous regime probabilities (discrete argmax only), regime-conditional expected-value ranker, daily IC-decay monitoring, base-effect forward projection, survivorship-corrected factor scorecard as the default, and OOS R2 benchmarking — the four gaps that separate a research-graded scorecard from a live edge-measurement system.

current_method:
**Basket construction (baskets.py:67-88, 144-283):** Equal-weight daily level via `_ew_level()` — cumulative product of mean daily returns over the point-in-time live member set (membership [added, removed)). Input is `data/breadth/*.parquet` closes unioned with `data/baskets/extras.parquet` (deep ~3y tape). Benchmark is SPY from `data/yahoo/SPY.parquet`, also latest-revision (not vintage-aware). Performance metrics are level-based at fixed lookbacks: {1d,5d,20d,60d} windows + MTD/YTD anchors computed each run against the CURRENT series end (baskets.py:112-128). Membership is HINDSIGHT-CURATED over ~3y (baskets.py:18 explicitly flags this as descriptive, not OOS). Missing/partial flags raised but series still included.

**Narrative rank (narrative_rotation.py:256-297):** Cross-sectional composite score = mean(z(residual_mom_12m_skip1m), z(13612W_composite)) + 0.25·z(accel_63d_rs). Residual momentum strips only market beta via causal rolling OLS (win=252d, shrunk 0.66 toward 1.0; narrative_rotation.py:152-162). Eligibility gate = price > 200d SMA AND 12m return > 0 (narrative_rotation.py:238-245). Lookbacks: (63, 126, 252) days with 21d skip. All data is latest-revision closes, not vintage-aware.

**Allocation (narrative_rotation.py:446-535):** EQUAL-WEIGHT 1/N_HOLD=0.25 over the top-4 eligible (by score), de-overlapped at MAX_PER_PARENT=1 per super-theme. Unfilled slots go to cash. Two display overlays: (1) crowding down-size: weight -= base * min(crowding_z,1) * 0.5, freed to cash; (2) Daniel-Moskowitz crash gate: if 24m bench return < 0 AND vol_pctile >= 0.75, halve all weights (narrative_rotation.py:538-555). Optional vol-target de-risk overlay scales book by clip(target_vol/trailing_book_vol, floor, cap) where target = 0.85 * rolling-median(20d vol, 756d) (narrative_rotation.py:581-642). One-slot val_upgrade tie-break for themes with Divergence Radar divergence_z >= 0.75.

**Macro leg in theme_scoring.py (line 229-263):** 0.7 * dot(hand-prior, live_state_vector) + 0.3 * home-sector ETF RS percentile. The prior is a HAND-CODED 4-axis exposure vector (_MACRO_PRIOR dict, theme_scoring.py:84-100) for 15 US baskets; no regression, no regime-conditional estimation. State vector uses latest argmax quad from regime/latest.json. Weights in composite: trend 0.26, breadth 0.18, impulse 0.07, macro 0.18, mtf 0.16, volhole 0.05, crowding -0.10.

**Durability (narrative_rotation.py:342-379):** Coincident composite bar = mean(above_200dma, breadth_pct_above_50dma, persistence_last20d, Hurst_scaled). Hurst via R/S on trailing 252d (narrative_rotation.py:303-328). Display-only, explicitly flags directional=False.

**Crowding (theme_crowding.py):** Composite z from: co-movement (mean pairwise corr of 126d market residuals vs own 3y history), RS-stretch (252d trailing percentile of RS vs SPY), extension (median per-member ext z from engine.extension). DTC from FINRA is context-only, not in composite. CROWD_TRIM=0.5 (narrative_rotation.py:55). No point-in-time history for any of these series.

**Validation (theme_validation.py:48-71):** Reads site/basketdata/radar.json divergence z field (activity z minus price z). val_upgrade = True iff state == POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE AND eligible AND divergence_z >= 0.75. US only; no-op for CN/HK/CA.

**Data provenance:** ALL price data is latest-revision closes from data/yahoo/*.parquet and data/breadth/*.parquet. FRED macro state is similarly latest-revision. No ALFRED vintage snapshots, no point-in-time macro data anywhere in this subsystem. Membership.json is hindsight-curated. Phase-0 DSR computed on 27y SPDR sector closes (11 ETFs, 1998-2026).

gaps: L1 — NO base-effect or 2nd-derivative economic forecasting in the basket subsystem. The regime quad consumed by theme_scoring._macro_leg (theme_scoring.py:229-263) is the current argmax from the first-derivative market-proxy engine (regime/latest.json). The macro prior is a HAND-CODED 4-axis vector, not a MF-DFM or ALFRED-vintage estimate. The subsystem therefore has zero forward economic signal content.

L2 — NO Markov-switching / HMM regime probabilities. The allocation gate is a binary argmax (eligible=True/False). There is no P(Quad_k) distribution, no transition matrix, and no time-in-regime hazard. The crash overlay uses a single deterministic threshold (bench_ret_24m < 0 AND vol_pctile >= 0.75, narrative_rotation.py:538-555) with no probabilistic weighting.

L3 — NO regime-conditional expected-excess-return estimation for baskets. The allocation is equal-weight among trend-eligible themes (1/N_HOLD = 0.25), justified by the Phase-0 finding that rank-IC is ~0 (mean_ic=0.0095, t=0.44 for 1m; -0.0052, t=-0.14 for 3m). There is no per-basket mu_{basket,quad} distribution estimated on any regime labels, and no integration of P(Quad_k)*mu_{basket,k} to rank or size. The macro leg (weight 0.18) uses a hand-prior dot product, not estimated historical returns conditional on realized regime.

L3 — The theme_scoring composite (theme_scoring.py:39-46, weights: trend 0.26, breadth 0.18, macro 0.18, mtf 0.16, impulse 0.07, volhole 0.05, crowding -0.10) has never been walk-forward validated as a return predictor. The Phase-0 only validates the dual-momentum gate (trend-gated EW top-N) on sectors, not the composite score itself. No expectancy, profit-factor, or rank-IC of the full composite score against forward basket returns has been measured.

L4 — Volatility is close-to-close only (20d std * sqrt(252), narrative_rotation.py:487). No Yang-Zhang OHLC realized vol, no HAR-RV, no forward vol from IV surface, no IV-RV premium, no skew or term structure. The vol-target sizing (narrative_rotation.py:581-642) uses the same trailing 20d close-to-close vol. No forward range as conditional quantile (quantile-reg / skewed-t GARCH).

L5 — No mechanical-flow front-running wired to baskets. CTA trend-flip levels, vol-control roll-off schedule, gamma-flip level, and positioning extremes (COT z) are absent from the basket allocation path. The extension/crowding read is backward-looking (RS percentile, co-movement) with no forward-vol or options-market content.

L6 — NO DSR/PBO on the composite theme score or on the allocation book itself. The Phase-0 DSR (0.956 for top4_mom12_dual, data/strategies/thematic_rotation_phase0.json) is on 11 SPDR sector ETFs, not on the ~30 thematic baskets with their hindsight-curated membership. No triple-barrier labels, no purged k-fold CV, no meta-labeling, no expectancy or profit-factor broken out by realized quad or VIX bucket for the basket universe. The narrative_brain ledger (narrative_brain.py:286-352) is the only forward accounting, and it is gated off by default.

L6 — ALL price data is latest-revision closes (data/yahoo/*.parquet, data/breadth/*.parquet). No ALFRED/Philly real-time vintages anywhere. The FRED macro state (growth_score, inflation_score from regime/latest.json) uses revised series. This means the Phase-0 DSR, while measured, was computed on data that is also latest-revision (the SPDR sector closes) and so cannot claim to be point-in-time honest.

L7 — Allocation is a simple EW 1/N (N=4) with no HRP, no Black-Litterman prior blending, no CVaR constraint, and no drawdown-budget enforcement. The vol-target de-risk overlay exists (narrative_rotation.py:581-642) and is measured to cut MaxDD by ~7pp on the 27y proxy (narrative_rotation.py:635-637) but is flagged display_only / optional and does NOT lift Sharpe. There is no gross/net leverage dial driven by regime intensity (P(Q4) = min gross, P(Q1) = max gross).

Cross — The Divergence Radar validation overlay (theme_validation.py) only applies to US baskets and only reads the radar.json output (which itself depends on the full alt-data pipeline). For CN/HK/CA, val_upgrade is always False and the tie-break is a pure no-op. There is no equivalent real-activity validation for non-US themes.

Cross — Membership is HINDSIGHT-CURATED (baskets.py:18 is explicit). The ~3y performance series and the Phase-0 rank-IC validation are therefore biased upward. The code documents this honestly but there is no survivorship correction, no synthetic OOS window, and no DSR/PBO computed specifically on the themed-basket universe (only on SPDR sectors).

upgrades.title: Regime-conditional basket return table (L3 core)
upgrades.spec: Add engine/basket_regime_returns.py. For each basket in membership.json, load the EW level series via _ew_level (engine/baskets.py:67). Load the historical regime label series from data/regime/regime_history.parquet (or compute it daily from the axes history). For each (basket, quad) cell compute: mu = mean excess return vs SPY (monthly, point-in-time regime labels only), sigma = std, CVaR_5pct, n_obs. Store as data/strategies/basket_regime_returns.json. In narrative_rotation.allocate() (narrative_rotation.py:446), consume this table to compute E[r_basket] = sum_k P(Quad_k) * mu_{basket,k} and rank baskets by E[r]/CVaR as a secondary sort WITHIN the trend-eligible set — so the EW gate and trend gate are preserved, but sizing shifts toward regime-fit leaders. Requires: regime history parquet (build from existing axes.py scores) + at least 3 years of regime labels for minimum cell counts.
deps: regime history parquet from engine/axes.py scores archived daily

upgrades.title: Regime probability distribution via Markov-switching HMM (L2)
upgrades.spec: Add engine/regime_probs.py. Fit a 4-state Gaussian HMM (hmmlearn or statsmodels MarkovRegression) over [growth_score, inflation_score] from the axes/latest.json daily history (data/regime/*.parquet). Output: P(Quad_k) vector + transition_matrix 4x4 + time_in_regime_days (hazard). Write to data/regime/regime_probs.json daily. Consume in narrative_rotation.allocate(): weight the conditional returns E[r] = sum_k P(k)*mu_{k} (L3 above). Also expose P(Q4) as the gross-dial input: when P(Q4) > 0.5, shrink gross allocation by (1 - P(Q4)) toward cash. Minimum 500 trading days of daily growth/inflation score history for stable HMM fit. Use 4 restarts + AIC to select state count.

upgrades.title: Point-in-time regime label series via ALFRED vintages (L1/L6 honesty)
upgrades.spec: In scripts/build_regime.py (or a new scripts/build_regime_pit.py), replace latest-revision FRED series with ALFRED vintage-matched pulls for the key growth/inflation indicators (WEI, NFP, CPI). ALFRED API: https://alfred.stlouisfed.org/api/v2/vintage_dates, pull vintage available as-of each historical date. Store as data/regime/pit_regime_labels.parquet with columns [date, quad_pit, growth_pit, inflation_pit]. Use pit_regime_labels as the input to engine/basket_regime_returns.py so the conditional return table is computed on what was KNOWABLE at the time. This fixes the 'revised-not-point-in-time' flag for the basket conditional return estimation.

upgrades.title: Yang-Zhang OHLC realized vol + HAR-RV forward vol per basket (L4)
upgrades.spec: In engine/basket_index.py, add function basket_realized_vol(cand: pd.DataFrame, win: int = 20) -> pd.Series that computes Yang-Zhang OHLC estimator from the consolidated candle (open/high/low/close columns already present). YZ formula: var_YZ = var_overnight + k*var_open + (1-k)*var_close_to_close where k=0.34/(1.34+(n+1)/(n-1)). Add basket_har_vol(rv_series) that fits HAR-RV (1d/5d/22d lags via OLS, causal rolling fit with 252d min) and outputs a 21d forward vol forecast. Consume in narrative_rotation._vol_overlay(): replace `lvl.pct_change().tail(VOL_WIN_D).std()` (narrative_rotation.py:487 and 607) with the YZ estimator. Expose forward HAR-RV as a widening signal: when HAR_forward > current_YZ * 1.3, widen the vol-target target downward (de-emphasize mean-reversion).

upgrades.title: Basket-level conditional forward-distribution cone (L4)
upgrades.spec: Wire engine/forward_dist.py (already in codebase, used by Anticipation Engine for BTC/index) to the basket candle. In engine/basket_score.py or a new engine/basket_forward.py, call forward_dist.multi_horizon_cone(basket_close_level, state_series, horizons={21:21, 63:63}) where state_series is the basket crowding composite z (from theme_crowding) — the existing validated association between crowding and DRAWDOWN (not return). Output per-basket: forward drawdown quantiles (p05/p25/p50) at 21d and 63d, conditional on the live crowding band. Render on basket_detail.html as a forward-range cone. Flag 'thin' when n_obs < 20 per band. This replaces the heuristic rollover_risk score (basket_score.py:176-209) with an empirical conditional drawdown distribution.

upgrades.title: DSR/PBO validation on the theme composite score vs basket universe (L6)
upgrades.spec: Add scripts/validate_theme_composite.py. Using the ~3y EW basket level series (all US baskets with >= 160 trading days of history), run: (1) cross-sectional rank-IC of theme_scoring composite score vs forward 21d and 63d basket excess returns, reported with HAC t-stat and hit rate; (2) portfolio backtest of the top-4-by-composite-score rule (vs top-4-by-trend-gate-EW, the Phase-0 baseline); (3) DSR on the composite-score portfolio vs the simpler EW-trend baseline; (4) PBO via CSCV on the two strategies. Output to data/strategies/basket_composite_validation.json. Surfaced on the allocation page as an honest caveat: the composite score adds X/is redundant beyond the EW trend gate. Key honesty: use the hindsight-curated series as-is but label the backtest explicitly as in-sample.

upgrades.title: Regime-driven gross/net dial (L7 portfolio construction)

Gate with label 'applied: False / regime_dial: display' until the L2 HMM and L3 conditional returns are validated.

upgrades.title: Transition-probability-weighted allocation sizing (L2/L3 bridge)
upgrades.spec: In narrative_rotation.allocate(), replace the flat EW 1/N_HOLD with inverse-CVaR sizing when the L3 basket_regime_returns table is available: weight_i proportional to 1/CVaR_{i,live_quad} subject to POS_CAP=0.30. This is the Hubble ranker from the blueprint: E[r_i]/CVaR_i ranked over eligible baskets, sized to the drawdown budget. Gate with a minimum n_obs_per_cell >= 15 check per basket; degrade to EW when cells are thin. Output both the EW weight and the CVaR-sized weight so the page can show the gap and the user can choose.

upgrades.title: Vol surface integration: IV-RV premium and skew as basket timing signal (L4/L5)
upgrades.spec: For US baskets with ETF proxies (etf_proxy field in membership.json), pull options data via Polygon STANDARD subscription (data/options/*.parquet if already fetched). In engine/basket_tape.py or a new engine/basket_vol_surface.py, compute: (1) IV-RV premium = 30d ATM IV vs trailing 20d realized vol (YZ when available, else close-to-close); (2) 25d skew = put IV minus call IV; (3) term slope = 60d IV minus 30d IV. When IV-RV premium is in the top quartile of its own 2y history AND skew is elevated, flag as 'vol_surface_stressed' — add to the crowding down-size input (CROWD_TRIM multiplier 1.2x). When IV-RV premium is low AND term slope is steep (risk premium being paid forward), flag as a potential entry setup. All as display-only with a directional=False tag until backtested.

one_line_verdict: A well-engineered, honestly documented trend-following/crowding-throttled basket allocator that correctly admits rank-IC ~0 and grounds its one validated edge in drawdown avoidance, but entirely lacks regime-conditional expected-return estimation (L3), Markov-switching transition probabilities (L2), point-in-time data for historical calibration (L6), and any forward distributional output beyond heuristic composite scores — the subsystem is rigorous about what it is but missing the core edges the blueprint requires.
