current_method:
TWO PARALLEL DESKS run independently and never share regime state:

DESK 1 — subsector_rotation.py (268 Finviz subsectors, 40 themes):
  Inputs: data/themes_heatmap/perf_snapshot.json — Finviz's own % returns across 8 horizons (1D/1W/1M/MTD/3M/6M/1Y/YTD) for 268 subsectors. Source is the Finviz themes heatmap; no OHLC, no individual prices, no point-in-time vintage.
  Math (lines 37-107, _rotation_metrics):
    1. Cross-sectional median subtraction at each horizon -> relative strength (RS) per subsector.
    2. Z-score RS values across subsectors per horizon (in z-space for the RRG axes).
    3. rs_ratio = nanmean(z_RS_1M, z_RS_3M) — "leadership level"
    4. rs_mom = nanmean(z_RS_1W, z_RS_1M) - nanmean(z_RS_3M, z_RS_6M) — "is leadership improving"
    5. Weekly pace: raw_pct / WEEKS[h] where WEEKS = {1W:1.0, 1M:4.345, 3M:13.04, 6M:26.07, 1Y:52.14}
    6. accel = rate_1W - rate_3M (fallback: rate_1W - rate_1M) — raw weekly pace delta
    7. z_accel = cross-sectional z-score of accel
    8. emerging_score = 0.5*z_accel + 0.8*rs_mom + 0.3*z_RS_1W (line 95) — single scalar ranking
    9. Quadrant = argmax of (rs_ratio >= 0) x (rs_mom >= 0) -> leading/weakening/improving/lagging
  Output: subsectors sorted by emerging_score descending (rank 1 = highest); highlights buckets: emerging (rs_mom>0, accel>=0, n_members>=3), fading, leaders (top rs_ratio), laggards.
  Track record: snapshots.jsonl accruing, 3 days logged, 0 matured horizons (verdict=accruing, lines 239-281 of track_record.py).

DESK 2 — subsector_confluence.py (S&P 500 sub-industries + curated baskets + Nasdaq/Russell):
  Inputs: data/sp500_heatmap/industry_map.json (113 Finviz sub-industries, 503 names), data/yahoo/*.parquet EOD OHLCV (latest revision, not point-in-time on membership).
  Math (score_group, lines 179-267):
    1. build_index(): basket_index.consolidated_candle(mode="equal", pit=False) — equal-weight member-average synthetic OHLC, each member enters at its own first bar (survivorship-tinted; today's S&P 500 roster only, no add/remove history).
    2. Entry gate: signal_gate.gate(key, close) -> T1-T4 MACD-RSI x StochRSI cascade. T1 weight=1.0, T4 weight=0.4. BUYABLE_TIERS = (T1,T2,T3). Minimum 220 daily bars required (line 192).
    3. Regime state: sector_signals.sector_signal(close, spy_close=spy) -> state machine over {daily, 3D-MACD, 3D-StochRSI} flags. States: BUY/BUY_PARTIAL/SETUP_BUY/OVERSOLD_BOUNCE/NEUTRAL/EXTENDED/TOPPING/SELL/BELOW_TREND. rs_60d is the 60d return of the synthetic index vs SPY.
    4. _classify(): TOPPING/SELL dominates any concurrent cascade tier -> "headwind". Otherwise: buyable T1/T2/T3 -> "entry_now"; T4 -> "forming"; tailwind state -> "tailwind"; EXTENDED -> "late"; else "neutral".
    5. funnel(): double_buy = stock_buyable AND subsector not headwind; combined_score = stock_weight * subsector_factor (max of entry_weight and _REGIME_W[state], line 173). _REGIME_W = {BUY:0.80, TOPPING:0.0, SELL:0.0, ...}.
    6. Board sort: class order (entry_now=0 .. headwind=5), then -entry_weight, then -rs_60d.
  Regime base rates (sector_signals.py lines 72-79): measured on SPDR ETFs 1998-2026; BUY state exc63 +1.10%/hit 56%, SELL exc63 -1.24%/hit 40%. Explicitly REMOVED from subsector output (line 200: reg.pop("base_rate", None)) because SPDR-domain numbers are out-of-domain for synthetic sub-industry indices.

DESK 3 — index_leadership.py (cross-tab LAS + within-tab Running/Coiling):
  LAS weights (line 191): w1=0.40 (z_return_accel), w2=0.30 (z_breadth_thrust), w3=0.30 (z_participation).
  Breadth thrust (lines 79-93): delta share of subsector baskets above 50-DMA (now vs 20 bars ago), computed from synthetic index close series.
  Coiling guard (lines 134-147): requires quadrant==improving, accel>=0, regime_side != avoid, state not in (SELL,TOPPING), and if BELOW_TREND must be above200. Excludes n_priced < 3.
  Running guard (lines 125-132): quadrant==leading, rs_mom>0, regime_state not in (TOPPING, SELL, BELOW_TREND).

MACRO REGIME LINKAGE: ZERO. engine/regime.py and engine/axes.py (growth/inflation quad) are NOT imported or consumed by any subsector engine. The subsector desks operate entirely on price-derived technicals; no quad probability, no transition matrix, no conditional expected-value weighting by quad.

data/yahoo/*.parquet — EOD OHLCV (dividend-adjusted close, latest revision, no point-in-time add/remove history)
data/sp500_heatmap/industry_map.json — today's S&P 500 classification, 503 names x 113 sub-industries (Finviz heatmap clone, no historical membership log)
data/baskets/membership.json — curated thematic baskets membership
data/baskets_nasdaq/membership.json and data/baskets_russell/membership.json — Nasdaq-100 and Russell-2000 curated partitions

SPY EOD from data/yahoo/SPY.parquet — benchmark for rs_60d in sector_signals state machine
gaps: NO MACRO REGIME CONDITIONING: engine/regime.py raw_quad(g,i) and engine/axes.py growth/inflation scores are never imported by any subsector engine. emerging_score (0.5*z_accel + 0.8*rs_mom + 0.3*z_RS_1W) is a fixed-weight cross-sectional rank with no regime-conditional reweighting. A Q1 (Goldilocks) environment should lift cyclical/growth subsectors and reduce defensive ones; currently the same formula applies in all regimes.

NO CONDITIONAL EXPECTED-VALUE ENGINE (L3 missing entirely): there is no mu_{a,k} per subsector per quad, no E[r_a] = sum_k P(Quad_k)*mu_{a,k}*intensity_k, no CVaR. The combined_score in funnel() is stock_cascade_weight * subsector_factor — a pure timing/entry quality product with no forward-return expectation baked in.

NO REGIME PROBABILITY DISTRIBUTION: regime.py outputs a confirmed discrete quad (argmax + hysteresis), not P(Q1..Q4) probabilities. No HMM/Markov-switching transition probabilities feed the subsector ranker; no transition risk to widen/de-emphasize mean-reversion.
DISCRETE ARGMAX QUAD CONSUMED NOWHERE: even the discrete quad from regime.py is not consumed by the subsector engines, so there is no regime-conditional sorting even at the crude binary level.

NO DRAWDOWN-BUDGET SIZING: combined_score ranks names but nothing translates to a position size. No vol-target, no CVaR constraint, no gross/net dial driven by P(quad). The desk is explicitly display-only, but there is no sizing stub that could be turned on.

POINT-NOT-DISTRIBUTION OUTPUT: every output is a point estimate (rs_ratio, rs_mom, emerging_score). No confidence intervals, no posterior distribution over the ranking, no uncertainty band on the coiling guard threshold.

REVISED-NOT-POINT-IN-TIME MEMBERSHIP: subsector synthetic indices use today's S&P 500 roster (pit=False) with no add/remove history. Sectors that recently added survivorship winners will show better backtested history than they would have in real time.

CLOSE-TO-CLOSE VOL ONLY: the sector_signals regime state uses daily and 3D MACD/RSI/StochRSI on close-only data. No OHLC vol (Yang-Zhang), no HAR-RV, no IV surface, no realized vs implied premium. Vol regime from engine/vol_regime.py is not consumed.

UNVALIDATED emerging_score: track record has 804 snapshots over 3 days with 0 matured horizons — verdict='accruing'. The heuristic weights (0.5/0.8/0.3) were never validated against forward IC. No DSR/PBO computed.

WIN-RATE NOT EXPECTANCY in sector_signals base rates: STATE_BASE_RATES show exc63 mean and hit-rate per state (e.g., BUY: +1.10% exc, 56% hit, n=199) but no expectancy, no profit-factor, no max-DD-of-signal. These base rates are computed on SPDR ETFs (11 names) and are explicitly stripped from subsector output as out-of-domain.

NO FORWARD PROJECTION OR BASE-EFFECT: the rotation engine reads trailing returns only. No base-effect denominator analysis (what were comps 12 months ago), no 2nd-derivative sign forecast for subsector YoY growth, no MIDAS or Kalman state estimate.

LAS weights are heuristic (0.40/0.30/0.30) with no validation: the cross-tab Leadership Acceleration Score cross-ranks 4 universes on z-scored return_accel, breadth_thrust, participation. No IC test vs forward index outperformance, no bootstrap confidence.

SECTOR_SIGNALS BASE RATES OUT OF DOMAIN FOR SYNTHETIC INDICES: the code correctly strips them (line 200 of subsector_confluence.py), but there is no replacement domain-specific base rate for the sub-industry synthetic indices. The state labels (BUY/TOPPING/etc.) carry no calibrated forward-return expectation in the subsector context.

NO MECHANICAL-FLOW LAYER: vol-control roll-off, CTA flip levels, dealer gamma-flip, COT z-scores, put/call extremes, ETF create/redeem — none consumed by any subsector engine. engine/gex_engine.py and engine/vol_regime.py exist but are not linked.

NO PURGED K-FOLD OR EMBARGO ON emerging_score: the track record IC uses Newey-West HAC but no purged cross-validation, no deflated Sharpe, no PBO. Once horizons mature, the scorecard could over-count if the same bar contributes to multiple snapshot dates.

For each row in double_buy: load the member's close series, compute close-to-close 21d rolling vol annualised, derive position_size = dd_budget / (vol * sqrt(1/252)) capped at max_pos=0.05. Attach 'suggested_size_pct' to each row. Clearly label as display-only illustrative sizing — not a live order. This gives the trader a vol-normalised starting point rather than equal-weighting all double-buy names. Does not require new data.

upgrades.title: Yang-Zhang OHLC realized vol on synthetic index (L4)
upgrades.spec: In engine/subsector_confluence.py score_group(), after building the synthetic candle (cand), compute Yang-Zhang realized vol on the OHLC candle using a 21d window: YZ_var = 0.361*(log(O/C_prev))^2 + 0.638*(log(H/L))^2 - (2*log(2)-1)*(log(C/O))^2, annualised. Add 'rv_yz_21d' and 'rv_yz_63d' to the group output dict. Use as a vol-normaliser in the sizing stub (L7) and as a range-uncertainty signal on the page (wide YZ vol = don't call a tight price target). upgrades.title: Validate LAS weights via IC backtest on index leadership (L6)

For each tab (S&P, Nasdaq, Russell, China), compute daily LAS with the current (0.40/0.30/0.30) weights AND alternatives via grid search over w1+w2+w3=1 in 0.1 increments. Compute rank-IC of LAS against forward 21d tab excess return (each tab vs the cross-tab median). Apply Newey-West HAC, compute Deflated Sharpe Ratio. Report the out-of-sample best weights. If current weights are not significantly better than equal-weight (1/3 each), surface that explicitly on the page. This turns the heuristic weights into a measured choice.

one_line_verdict: The subsector desks are a well-constructed relative-strength + technical-entry timing system, but they are entirely decoupled from the macro regime engine — no quad conditioning, no P(Q1..Q4) probabilities, no conditional expected-value weighting, no drawdown-budget sizing — making the 'Hubble cross-sectional ranker' concept a display-only skeleton that needs L2/L3 wiring before it carries any forward-return expectation beyond heuristic emerging_score weights that are still in 'accruing' validation status after 3 days of logged calls.

current_method:
**Factor definitions** (equity_factors.py:303-498, config key edgar.factors):
- Universe: S&P 1500 (breadth + midcap_breadth + smallcap_breadth _closes_cache.parquet) for live; survivorship-biased deep panel (edgar/sue_deep_closes.parquet, ~2011-2026) for IC scorecard
- 9 factors built as cross-sectional winsorized z-scores (cap=config edgar.factors.winsor_z, default ~3):
  - value = mean z of [NI/MC, equity/MC, revenue/MC, CFO/MC]
  - profitability = GP/assets (Novy-Marx)
  - quality = mean z of [ROE, -accruals, -leverage]
  - investment = -z(asset growth)
  - payout = z((dividends+buybacks)/MC)
  - low_vol = -z(trailing vol, window=config low_vol_window_d)
  - low_beta = -z(OLS beta vs SPY over same window)
  - short_interest = -mean_z([DTC, short_%]) from FINRA; OMITTED in any asof/backtest run (no PIT history)
  - sue = cross-sectional z of raw SUE from edgar_eps.py quarterly panel
- Composite = equal-weight mean of composite_legs (config key) where >=3 legs present; second-pass winsorized z applied to each factor before compositing
- Leadership read: trailing lw-day (config engine_equity_factors.leadership_window_d) return spread Q80-Q20 per factor; sort descending — pure price trailing, not forward-looking
- PIT mode: asof parameter triggers as_of_cross_section(asof) from collectors.edgar (EDGAR filing date point-in-time), prices truncated to asof date
- Insider leaderboard: SEC Form-4 panel, trailing panel_window_months (default 6mo), ranked by net_mcap_bps (bps of market cap), distinct-buyer cluster count

**IC Scorecard** (factor_ic_scorecard.py:77-248, ic_scorecard.json):
- Quarter-end grid from 2011-03-31 to 2025-12-31 on deep panel, 60 rebalances
- Per rebalance: compute_factors(asof=d) then rank_ic(factor_z, forward_return_63d)
- Aggregate: mean_ic, ic_vol, ic_ir, HAC t-stat (Newey-West for autocorrelated overlapping-window ICs), BH-FDR across all factors at alpha=0.10
- Incremental IC: residualize vs style basis [beta, size=log_mktcap, mom_12_1, low_vol] then re-rank-correlate; BH-FDR on incremental p-values
- Results: only payout (mean_ic=0.0247, q_fdr=0.0715, survives_fdr=True) passes FDR on deep panel; value borderline (p_hac=0.045, q_fdr=0.247, fails FDR); all other factors fail. Composite mean_ic=-0.0072. universe=deep, survivorship_biased=True
- Collinearity: low_vol/low_beta corr=0.74; quality/accruals=0.71; Loewdin orthogonalization reduces mean abs off-diagonal corr from 0.137 to 0.055

**Factor Series** (factor_series.py:122-281):
- Month-end grid over ~3y price cache
- Long-only: cap-weighted top quintile (5% single-name cap) via iterative redistribution
- L/S: EW Q80 minus EW Q20 daily returns held to next month-end
- Stats: Sharpe + MaxDD with block_bootstrap_CI (reports sharpe_ls_ci, sharpe_gt0_prob); crowding corr matrix; 20d-return rotation with 3-session debounce; monthly quilt; horizon z-scores vs trailing-252 distribution of overlapping returns

**Factor Exposure** (factor_exposure.py):
- 9 factors: mkt(SPY), growth(QQQ), size(IWM), rates(TLT), usd(DXY), oil(WTI), china(FXI), btc(BTC-USD), gold(GC=F)
- Gram-Schmidt sequential orthogonalization in economic priority order (mkt first, then style, then macro)
- Per-stock orthogonal betas: cov(r,g_k)/var(g_k) — exact decoupled solve, no matrix inversion per stock
- Raw univariate betas also shipped for single-factor shock use
- Confidence tiers from Phase-0 out-of-sample stability: mkt/size/growth high, rates medium, rest low
- Window: 252d trailing, min_obs=126 (config)
- Portfolio aggregation: client-side from exported betas + orthogonal factor covariance matrix

**Regime-conditional logic** (stock_score.py:93-132):
- ONLY point of contact between the macro regime and factor weighting is in stock_score._edge_weights(calm)
- calm score in [0,1] (1=risk-on/SPY>200dma + low vol, 0=stressed) scales the momentum (residual alpha) weight: w_mom = 0.04 + (0.28-0.04)*calm, from range [0.04, 0.28]
- This is validated: deep PIT panel shows momentum IC +0.030 calm vs -0.028 stressed; literature-grounded (Daniel-Moskowitz 2016)
- No regime-conditional table for the value/quality/profitability/payout/low_vol factors — zero linkage to macro quads

**Regime-factor link at the yield-curve level** (yield_curve.py:573-611):
- factor_signals() derives value_vs_growth, size, duration_factor from curve regime key (bear_steepener etc.) and Δreal10y — rule-based heuristics, tagged THEORY, never scored, never enters any allocation
data_sources: EDGAR XBRL fundamentals (collectors/edgar.py) — annual 10-K filings, point-in-time via as_of_cross_section
Yahoo Finance close prices (data/yahoo/*.parquet) — dividend-adjusted close, latest-revision (no vintage)
S&P 1500 breadth caches (data/breadth,midcap_breadth,smallcap_breadth/_closes_cache.parquet)
Deep survivorship-biased close panel (data/edgar/sue_deep_closes.parquet, 2011-2026, currently-listed only)
FINRA short interest (data/finra/short_interest.parquet) — live-only, no PIT history
SEC Form-4 insider panel (data/sec_insider/insider_panel.parquet) — 6-month trailing window
Ken French Data Library monthly factors (data/french/factors.parquet) — HML/RMW/CMA/Mom/SMB/Mkt-RF 1926/1963+
EDGAR EPS quarterly panel (engine/sue.py) — standardized unexpected earnings cross-section
Commodity WTI close (data/commodity/signals_oil/close)
SPY market regime calm score — from engine/market_state.py or equivalent, passed as float to stock_score
gaps: L3 conditional expected-value table is ABSENT: there is no table of mu_{factor,k} = E[factor_premium | Quad_k] anywhere in the codebase. The factor desk shows unconditional IC (pooled across all regimes); factors.html leadership spread is a trailing price read with no regime stratification. Zero implementation of the blueprint's core alpha driver.

L2 continuous regime probabilities: the macro regime (engine/regime.py) is a hard argmax (discrete_argmax flag) — no P(Quad_k) probability vector is computed or passed to the factor desk. The factor desk cannot weight by regime probability even if mu_{factor,k} were estimated.

L1 base-effects / 2nd-derivative nowcast: the factor IC scorecard conditions on calendar time but never on growth/inflation 2nd-derivative state. Factors are ranked identically in Q1 Goldilocks and Q4 Growth-scare; there is no split of IC-by-quad anywhere in factor_ic_scorecard.py or equity_factors.py.

Regime-conditional IC is completely unmeasured: factor_ic_scorecard.py computes a pooled quarterly IC grid 2011-2025 without any stratification by realized regime label at the rebalance date. The question 'does value outperform in Q1 vs Q3?' has no quantitative answer in the codebase.

Survivorship bias in deep IC panel acknowledged but unresolved (ic_scorecard.json caveat: 'OPTIMISTIC bound'): the de-biased run (collectors/edgar_deadnames.py + edgar_deadname_prices.py) exists as scaffolding but the live ic_scorecard.json is still the biased deep panel. Any strategy-sized read off the scorecard is inflated.

L4 forward vol surface: the factor desk has no regime-conditioned vol forecast for individual factor premiums. Sharpe CIs from block-bootstrap (factor_series.py) are unconditional; no skewed-t GARCH or HAR-RV per factor, no coverage-tested quantile forecast of the L/S spread.

L6 no Deflated Sharpe / PBO on factor strategies: factor_series.py ships block-bootstrap Sharpe CIs but not DSR (Deflated Sharpe Ratio = corrected for multiple testing across factor strategies) or Probability of Backtest Overfitting. Signal Lab shows DSR for non-factor signals but the factor portfolios are not processed through that gate.

L7 no regime-driven gross/net dial on factors: allocation changes driven by P(Quad_k) intensity do not exist. The calm-score momentum scaling in stock_score is the only regime lever and it only touches one sub-weight of one sub-score (momentum within the selection axis of stock conviction).

Factor leadership spread (equity_factors.py:448-463) uses trailing price return of Q80 vs Q20 — this is a LOOK-BACK performance summary, not a forward-predictive rank. It is presented without IC validation and can easily be momentum-contaminated (value-in-drawdown looks worst precisely when mean-reversion opportunity is highest).

Low-vol / low-beta factors fail FDR on the deep panel (q_fdr=0.93) but continue to appear in the composite and leadership display without any caveat distinguishing them from the single FDR survivor (payout). The composite itself has mean_ic=-0.007 and fails FDR — equal-weight compositing dilutes the one survivor.

Short interest factor (equity_factors.py:413) is silently dropped in any asof/backtest run due to absence of PIT FINRA data. This creates a structural mismatch: live factors.html includes short_interest in the leaderboard; the IC scorecard that rates all other factors was run WITHOUT short_interest. Its unconditional IC is therefore unknown on any honest sample.

No L5 mechanical-flow integration into the factor desk: vol-control roll schedule, CTA trend-flip levels, and dealer gamma-flip are computed in other engines (gex.py, vol_regime.py) but are not joined to the cross-sectional factor table as conditioning variables.

Yield-curve factor tilts (yield_curve.py:573) are THEORY-tagged (no measured IC) but appear alongside measured content on the bonds/yield-curve page. They feed no regime-conditional factor table and have no backtested forward IC vs the factor premiums.

No transition probability or time-in-regime hazard for factors: factor_series._rotation identifies the 20d-trailing leader with a 3-session debounce but there is no Markov-switching hazard model to predict when the current factor leadership will flip — the most practically valuable regime-factor intersection.

upgrades.title: Compute per-quad IC stratification table in factor_ic_scorecard.py
upgrades.spec: In scripts/factor_ic_scorecard.py, after building the quarter grid, attach the realized regime label at each rebalance date by loading data/regime/regime_history.parquet (or data/regime_snap/ archive). For each (factor, quad_k) cell compute mean_ic, ic_ir, n_obs, hit_rate, and store in report['per_quad'] = {Q1:{value:{...},...},...}. Write to ic_scorecard.json. In factors.html.j2 render a 4-column heat table (Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 across rows=factors) with green/red cells. This is the L3 conditional mu_{factor,k} skeleton — even without regime probabilities it answers 'does value IC flip sign in Q3?'.
deps: regime history archive must be queryable at quarter-end dates; data/regime_snap/ or engine/regime.py replay

upgrades.title: Add P(Quad_k) soft probabilities to the regime engine and pipe to factor desk
upgrades.spec: In engine/regime.py (or a new engine/regime_probs.py): instead of raw_quad(g,i) argmax, compute a softmax over [g_score, i_score] distances (or a simple Dirichlet concentration from axis score magnitudes). Output P(Q1)..P(Q4) summing to 1.0. Pass these into build_factors_page in build_site.py. In factors.html.j2 show the probability bar alongside the quad label. This unblocks L3 integration (E[r_factor] = sum_k P(Qk)*mu_{factor,k}) and surfaces genuine uncertainty vs confidence=0.125 coin-flip wording.

upgrades.title: Implement L3 regime-conditional factor expected-value ranker
upgrades.spec: New engine/factor_regime_ev.py: load ic_scorecard.json per_quad table + live P(Quad_k) from regime engine. For each factor compute E[IC] = sum_k P(Qk)*mu_ic_{factor,k} and CVaR-IC = E[IC | IC in worst quartile of quad distribution]. Rank factors by E[IC]/CVaR-IC ratio. Output a ranked table: factor, E_IC, cvar_ic, dominant_quad, intensity. Write to site/factordata/factor_regime_ev.json. Render in factors.html.j2 as the 'Regime-weighted factor ranking' panel. This is the blueprint's L3 Hubble ranker at the factor level — still a display layer, requires L6 validation before sizing.

upgrades.title: Run factor_ic_scorecard on de-biased (dead-name recovered) universe and make it the live scorecard
upgrades.spec: Run scripts/factor_ic_scorecard.py --debiased to produce ic_scorecard_debiased.json once collectors/edgar_deadname_prices.py has accrued sufficient coverage (check _dead_name_price_coverage.json). In scripts/build_site.py _load_ic_scorecard(), prefer the debiased file if dead_name_price_coverage fraction >= 0.40. Until then surface dead_cov.fraction_recovered on the factors.html caveat banner so the trader sees the optimism bound shrinking. This removes the acknowledged 'OPTIMISTIC bound' survivorship inflation from the one honest scorecard.
deps: collectors.edgar_deadname_prices accruing ~40%+ dead-name price coverage in CI

upgrades.title: Add Deflated Sharpe Ratio and PBO to factor_series.py portfolios
upgrades.spec: In engine/factor_series.py, after computing block_bootstrap_CI per factor, also compute DSR using the Haircut Sharpe formula: SR_deflated = SR * (1 - gamma(T,N)) where gamma depends on number of trials N (8 factors), sample length T, and SR autocorrelation. Use engine/validation.py which already has the infrastructure. Add dsr, dsr_pass (dsr>0.9) to each factor's stats dict. In factors.html.j2 add a DSR column to the factor statistics table with a red/green badge. This closes the gap flagged in signal_lab for the factor portfolio strategies.
deps: engine/validation.py block_bootstrap_ci already present; DSR formula from Lopez de Prado 2018

upgrades.title: Separate the composite into payout-only (FDR survivor) vs equal-weight, and demote low-vol/low-beta from composite
upgrades.spec: In engine/equity_factors.py, add a second composite: 'composite_fdr' = equal-weight mean over only factors where survives_fdr=True from ic_scorecard.json (currently: payout only, possibly value on shallow runs). In the live dashboard pass composite_fdr alongside composite. In factors.html.j2 label the existing composite 'Research composite (8 factors, most fail FDR)' and surface composite_fdr as 'FDR-validated composite'. This prevents the trader from treating the negative-IC composite (mean_ic=-0.007) as actionable.

upgrades.title: Backtest short-interest factor IC with a PIT FINRA history or drop it from the leaderboard
upgrades.spec: Option A: Obtain FINRA quarterly historical short-interest snapshots (FINRA provides bi-monthly files back to 2010 at finra.org/finra-data/browse-catalog) and build a PIT panel in collectors/finra_history.py. Re-run factor_ic_scorecard.py with the PIT SI panel to get an honest IC for short_interest. Option B (immediate): in equity_factors.py:413, add a warning comment and in the ic_scorecard render in factors.html.j2 annotate short_interest row with 'IC UNMEASURED (no PIT history; live-only snapshot)'. This closes the acknowledged live-vs-backtest mismatch.
deps: Option A: FINRA historical file access; Option B: no deps

upgrades.title: Add regime-conditional factor momentum crash protection (L4/L5 intersection)
upgrades.spec: In engine/factor_series.py, alongside the leadership rotation, add a momentum_crash_risk dict: compute trailing 24-month L/S factor return drawdown; flag if current drawdown > -15% AND prior 12m run > +30% (Daniel-Moskowitz crash precursor). Add realized vol ratio: trailing 21d vs trailing 252d vol of the L/S series — ratio > 2 triggers 'elevated crash risk'. Write to factor_series.json under 'momentum_crash'. Render in factors.html.j2 as a banner when active. This is literature-grounded (Daniel-Moskowitz 2016 already cited in stock_score.py) and uses data already in memory.

upgrades.title: Replace THEORY yield-curve factor tilts with measured IC vs factor premiums
upgrades.spec: In engine/yield_curve.py factor_signals(), add a 'measured' variant: for each curve regime key in the archive, compute the forward mean of the L/S factor premium (from factor_series ls dict) conditioned on being in that regime at month-end. Store as a small lookup table in data/yield_curve/factor_tilts_ic.json (generated offline quarterly). In the live snapshot prefer the measured table; fall back to the heuristic rule if the lookup is absent and tag as THEORY. Report measured IC, n_obs. This converts the one THEORY panel into an L3-compatible measured estimate.
deps: factor_series ls series history > 3y per regime to have meaningful n_obs

upgrades.title: Add HAR-RV forward vol and quantile range forecast per factor premium (L4)
upgrades.spec: New engine/factor_vol_forecast.py: for each factor L/S series r from factor_series.py, fit a HAR-RV model (daily/weekly/monthly realized variance components) and forecast next-month RV with a confidence interval. Also compute IV-RV premium proxy: if short VVIX (vol-of-vol) data is available use it; otherwise use the factor's own realized vol z-score vs its 252d rolling mean as an implied-RV proxy. Output 90th pct drawdown quantile for the L/S spread as a conditional range. Write to factordata/factor_vol.json. Surface in factors.html.j2 as a 'range' band on the NAV chart when the factor is selected. This delivers the L4 distribution-not-point upgrade at the factor level.
deps: factor_series.py ls dict; sufficient history >2y; HAR-RV is numpy-only, no scipy needed

one_line_verdict: The factors desk has honest PIT IC accounting, solid factor construction, and a single validated regime-momentum lever in stock_score — but the L3 regime-conditional factor expected-value table (the blueprint's core alpha driver) is entirely absent: factors are never stratified by quad, regime probabilities are a hard argmax, and the one FDR-surviving factor (payout, IC=0.025) is diluted inside a negative-IC composite that no trader should size off.

current_method:
**cross_asset.py (lines 48-307):** Absorption ratio = PC1 eigenvalue share (Kritzman-Page) of the 63d rolling correlation matrix across 6 markets (SPY, BTC-USD, 510300.SS, _HSI, HG=F, DX-Y.NYB), percentiled over 5y (1260d lookback). Verdict thresholds: concentrated ≥ 0.80 pctile, diversified ≤ 0.40. Lead-lag: for all ordered pairs×lags [1,2,3,5,10d], computes mean(z_F(t)·z_L(t−k)) over a 252d rolling window, Newey-West HAC (10 lags), Benjamini-Hochberg FDR q<0.10, min |r|≥0.06. Stability check: re-tests top link in the prior 252d window; requires |HAC t|≥2 and same sign. All latest-revision data; no vintage awareness.

**forex_regime.py (lines 64-763):** 6 named scenarios (carry_unwind, dollar_wrecking_ball, em_crisis_capital_flight, haven_flight_risk_off, reflation_risk_on, intervention_risk). Each has 5-6 legs. Feature series: causal z-scores (_z_causal uses shift(1) moments, w=252d, mp=60d), EWMA vol halflife=20d, velocity = mean daily log-return over 5d / EWMA vol. Intensity = weighted sum of sub-intensities; gate: ≥50% weight present AND ≥2 legs present. Empirical conditional exceedance: P(adverse_outcome | intensity ≥ today's), Wilson 95% CI, n_eff = n_raw / N_grid (overlap deflation), n_min=9. Forward labels: strictly (t, t+N]; adverse outcomes e.g. carry basket DD≤-6% OR SPY DD≤-8% OR VIX>35 within N=10d. Two scenarios flagged 'illustrative' (EM crisis uses managed CNH; intervention risk). Output: dominant scenario + per-scenario {intensity_today, n_fired, active, prob dict}. All latest-revision data.

**forex_dollar.py (lines 68-419):** Real-rate regime: DFII10 z vs 252d lookback, breakeven z, threshold high_z/low_z (from config). Fed path: ZQ futures m1/m12 spread in bps, 21d reprice momentum ±10bp threshold. Positioning: CFTC COT net-spec on DXY, percentiled over config pctile_lookback_d. Valuation: BIS REER vs 5y log mean, z vs 252d. Trend stack: 21/63/126/252d RoC, ≥75% pointing same direction → label. Liquidity: WALCL-RRP 63d change, z-scored. Smile confirm: how many of real/trend/liquidity legs corroborate the smile regime's USD direction. Triple-red: USD down + SPY down + US10y up over 21d window. Vote-count lean: net votes ±2 threshold → dollar-supportive/soft/mixed. All display-only, never scored.

**forex_transmission.py (lines 57-100+):** Rolling beta + correlation of each asset's daily return on broad-USD daily return. Fast window=63d, slow=252d, min_periods=max(20, w//3). Stability flag: fast vs slow window sign disagree. Calm-vs-stress split: correlation conditioned on risk_off composite >0. All contemporaneous co-movement. Display-only.

**bonds.py (lines 104-609):** NY-Fed probit: Phi(a + b·spread_10y3m), coefficients nyfed_a/nyfed_b from config (Estrella-Mishkin). NTFS: (y(1.75)·1.75 - y(1.5)·1.5)/0.25 - y(3m), bootstrapped from par curve. Curve taxonomy: 10y direction (bear=up) × 2s10s slope change → 4 boxes. Un-inversion: spread≥0 AND was_inverted in lookback AND recently_inverted (21d rolling max shifted 1). HY band thresholds: tight<hy_tight, normal<hy_elevated, elevated<hy_distress, distress<hy_crisis from config. MOVE bands: calm<move_calm, normal<move_elevated, crisis>move_crisis. MOVE-leads-VIX: gated on both z>0.7 and z>0.4 respectively AND move_z>vix_z+0.5. Cycle phase (4-box): curve_10y3m vs flat_level from config × HY 2y percentile (hy_oas_high_third / low_third). Health score 0-100: 100 minus weighted stress (weights from calibration.json if present, else config prior: recession/drawdown/credit/rates_vol/plumbing). Sovereign: euro_frag = ALL-minus-AAA 10y proxy. Stock-bond corr: reused from conditions.py (rolling window from config). Alarms: firing pattern on uninversion, credit distress, MOVE crisis, repo stress, sovereign. All latest-revision data (FRED feeds are not ALFRED vintage-keyed).

**yield_curve.py (lines 1-711):** PCA: cov of daily yield changes over PCA_WINDOW=1260d (5y); eigenvectors oriented (PC1=level, PC2=slope, PC3=curvature). Slopes: 2s10s, 3m10y, 5s30s, 2s5s, real 5s10s (TIPS), breakeven 5s10s; 5y pctile (1260d window); 63d change. Momentum: 63d speed of real10y/nom10y/front2y; slope change; |real_speed| pctile (5y); 3m10y trend = 504d rolling mean (Faria-Verona 2020). Regime: curve_move_taxonomy with regime_window_d (default 21d from config). Recession dashboard: NTFS<0, nyfed_prob≥30%, uninversion, tp_adj<0 → n_flags [0-4] → risk {low/watch/elevated/high}. Policy stance: fed_funds vs neutral_anchor=2.5%, gap>0.5=restrictive. Forwards: f_1y1y, f_2y1y, f_5y5y from linear-interpolation on par curve, carry+rolldown on 10y (modified duration ≈8). Sector signals: transmission IC matrix (data/transmission/calibration.json); cells tagged MEASURED if CONFIRMED/DIRECTIONAL. Market-tendency: elevated if |real_speed|≥75bp or speed_pctile≥0.80 AND rising. All display-only; no yield-curve leg passed scored-leg gate.

**rate_inflation_transmission.py (lines 33-580):** Drivers: real10y_chg63, nom10y_chg63, be10y_chg63, curve_tp_adj, policy_gap (us2y-fed_funds), corepce_gap, infl_accel, exp_wedge; also calibration-only: curvature, slope_chg63, ntfs, real_speed_abs, trend_spread. Live read: READ_DRIVERS (change/gap subset, not levels). Activation: last z-score over ZWIN=504d. Transmission net per asset: sum over drivers of ic × clip(az/z_cap, −1, 1), z_cap=2.5; verdict headwind/tailwind at cut=0.06. Scored-gate: calibration.json scored_gate; currently no leg eligible. Breakeven decomp: multi-horizon velocity (5/10/20/63d bp change), acceleration (10d×10d), speed percentile (5y window); cause badge: liquidity/real_rate/oil/growth/reflation by a-priori heuristics on co-state (oil_chg_20d, real_chg_20d, hy_z, vix_pctile). Scenarios: historical beta × hypothetical shock_bp. All latest-revision data; collinearity caveat documented.

**conditions.py RORO (lines 241-275):** z-scored mean of −VIX, −HY OAS, −SKEW, −VIX term (vix_front/back), −NFCI, copper_gold ratio, −DXY 20d pct_change; all z-scores use rolling window roro.z_window_d (from config). Thresholds: roro>risk_on → risk-on, roro<risk_off → risk-off. This is a pure first-derivative / market-proxy composite; zero economic nowcast content. Feeds conditions snapshot only (display); does NOT gate any allocation.

**cross_asset_confirm.py (lines 1-435):** Reads data/bonds/bond_health.json and data/forex/latest.json on disk. Cycle leg: ordinal difference _CYCLE_ORD[bond_phase] − _CYCLE_ORD[equity_cycle_tag] → agree/earlier/later. Risk leg: credit_caution (HY band or widening) + vol_caution (MOVE band or move_leads_vix) + fx_caution (risk-off or smile risk-off) → votes≥2 = leading_caution; vs equity RORO state and DD band. Caution flags: 12 flags across credit, uninversion, rates_vol, repo, sovereign, FX regime, EM FX, USD triple-red, USD positioning, transmission instability; each tagged coincident or leading with honest literature caveat. Verdict: confirm/diverge/mixed. Display-only, never scored.
data_sources: Yahoo Finance closes (SPY, BTC-USD, HG=F, DX-Y.NYB, EEM, IWM, HYG, GC=F, SI=F, CL=F, GLD, VIX) — latest revision, no point-in-time vintage

FRED (DGS10, DGS2, DGS3MO, DGS5, DGS7, DGS30, DTB3, DFII10, DFII5, T10YIE, T5YIE, T5YIFR, DBAA, DAAA, WALCL, RRPONTSYD, SOFR, SOFR99, IORB, BAMLH0A0HYM2, BAMLC0A0CM) — latest revision from FRED API, NOT ALFRED point-in-time vintages
CBOE (MOVE index, SKEW) — latest revision
CFTC COT net-spec on DXY — weekly, Tuesday as-of, Friday released, lagged ~3-5d
BIS REER (US, AFE, EME) — monthly, lagged ~1mo
FX pairs via forex_inputs.py (EUR, JPY, GBP, AUD, CAD, CHF, MXN, BRL, CNH — store group forex)
ZQ futures (Fed-funds implied path) via store group zq_path
China store: 510300.SS (CSI300 ETF)
HK store: _HSI
Sovereign store: ez_all_10y, ez_aaa_10y (EZ fragmentation proxy), jgb_2y, jgb_10y
Calibration artifact: data/transmission/calibration.json (split-half forward IC matrix, refreshed by scripts/calibrate_rate_inflation.py)
Calibration artifact: data/bonds/calibration.json (health-score weights, refreshed by scripts/calibrate_bonds.py)
gaps: NO base-effect / 2nd-derivative nowcast anywhere: the regime engine (axes.py) uses 20d slope z-scored vs 60d — a first-derivative market-proxy read. No YoY comparison with deterministic base-path projection, no MIDAS/Kalman/NY-Fed DFM for growth or inflation. The canonical Hedgeye edge (forward sign of 2nd derivative from base-path) is entirely absent in both the forex/bonds subsystem and the upstream regime engine.

RORO is a point-estimate argmax composite (conditions.py:271-275): mean of 7 legs → scalar → {risk-on/neutral/risk-off}. No P(regime_k) distribution, no uncertainty band, no transition probability matrix. The forex_regime.py scenarios produce Wilson CIs on exceedance probabilities but these are NOT regime probabilities and do NOT feed any allocation.

USD lead-lag (edge #2 from blueprint): cross_asset.py implements HAC+FDR lead-lag across 6 markets with a stability check. HOWEVER: (a) it is display-only and never feeds the regime engine or forex/bonds scoring, (b) only tests discrete lags [1,2,3,5,10]d — no rolling cross-correlation function at continuous lags, (c) uses latest-revision data so any 'lead' on macro data is spurious (macro prints are revised), (d) the correlation-BREAK detector (rolling-correlation regime BREAK = transition warning) as described in the blueprint does not exist: there is no module that tracks WHEN the USD-to-equity or USD-to-EM-growth rolling correlation flips sign and uses that flip as a transition signal.

No rolling-correlation BREAK / regime-change detector for the USD North Star: forex_transmission.py computes rolling betas (63d/252d) and flags sign instability, but only as a display-only table. There is no formal statistical test for a structural break in the USD↔asset correlation (e.g. Chow test on rolling windows, or a CUSUM/Bai-Perron break), and no signal fired from that break into the regime engine.

No conditional expected-value engine (L3): there is no per-asset E[r | regime] estimated from point-in-time regime labels. The rate_inflation_transmission.py forward-IC matrix is the closest thing but: (a) it uses contemporaneous IC (not a conditional return distribution), (b) it is display-only and never feeds allocation, (c) it has no regime conditioning — the same IC is applied regardless of current quad. forex_regime.py's empirical exceedance probabilities condition on FX scenario intensity only, not the macro quad.

No forward vol surface (L4): bonds.py tracks MOVE level/band/pctile and the MOVE-leads-VIX flag, but no HAR-RV or GARCH forward vol model, no IV-RV premium, no 25-delta skew term structure, no dispersion surface. The yield curve engine reports real-speed percentile but no quantile-regression or skewed-t GARCH coverage forecast.

No DSR / PBO / purged-CV validation on any cross-asset or forex scored leg: the calibration pipeline (scripts/calibrate_rate_inflation.py) runs split-half forward-IC, and the scored-leg gate currently yields ZERO eligible legs. No deflated Sharpe ratio, no probability-of-backtest-overfitting, no purged K-fold + embargo on any forex scenario or bond signal.

No forward YoY growth/inflation distribution projection: the current_state() in rate_inflation_transmission.py reads latest levels/60d changes of core PCE, breakevens, survey expectations — all retrospective. There is no 1-3 quarter ahead distributional forecast of inflation or growth, no base-effect determinism projection, no ALFRED vintage-keyed point-in-time data.

No transition probability matrix / regime hazard function: forex_regime.py gives a dominant scenario + intensity, but no P(transition to scenario B | currently in A), no time-in-regime hazard. conditions.py gives a scalar RORO with no transition estimate. The cross_asset_confirm.py gives a confirm/diverge/mixed verdict with breadth-count 'confidence' — not a probability.

No portfolio-level gross/net dial driven by regime: the blueprint describes a gross/net leverage dial (min-gross/net-short high-P(Q4), max-gross/tight-net high-P(Q1)). This subsystem produces no such output. All outputs are display-only.
Commodity carry panel (cross_asset_trend.py:196-220): uses data/commodity_carry/ with <2y history; explicitly not backtested. Carry context is a point-in-time read with no historical validation.

EZ fragmentation proxy (bonds.py:311-314): uses ez_all_10y minus ez_aaa_10y as a BTP-Bund-style proxy. This is not the actual BTP-Bund spread (which requires Italian and German government bond data specifically); it is an all-country vs AAA-rated average that may not track the Italy-Germany peripheral risk faithfully in normal periods.

Stock-bond correlation in conditions.py (line 235) is a standard rolling Pearson correlation — no regime-conditioning on the correlation itself, no test for correlation sign-flip, no use of the correlation's own distribution.

upgrades.title: USD↔asset rolling-correlation BREAK detector (USD North Star edge #2)
upgrades.spec: Add engine/usd_correlation_break.py. Inputs: broad-USD daily returns (drivers['broad_dollar']), per-asset daily returns (SPY, EEM, GC=F, HG=F, CL=F from yahoo store). For each asset: (a) compute rolling 63d and 252d Pearson correlation to USD return; (b) apply a CUSUM-style break detector: track abs(corr_63d - corr_252d) and flag when the sign flips and the absolute difference exceeds 0.3 for ≥5 consecutive days; (c) record the direction of the flip (e.g. SPY went from negative-to-USD to positive, meaning the 'sell everything' regime where equities and dollar fall together); (d) emit break_fired: bool, break_direction: str, days_since_break: int, corr_63d: float, corr_252d: float per asset. Cross-asset: emit a regime_break_count (how many of 5 assets are in a sign-flipped state vs their 252d baseline). Wire break_regime_count and flip events into cross_asset_confirm.py as a new caution flag ('USD transmission unstable — N of 5 assets show correlation sign flip'). This is the display-only skeleton; if it fires consistently, evaluate as an L2 regime-transition warning. Files: new engine/usd_correlation_break.py; modify engine/cross_asset_confirm.py:_caution_flags() to consume the new artifact from data/forex/usd_corr_break.json.
deps: forex_transmission.py already computes rolling betas — reuse that math

upgrades.title: Continuous regime probabilities P(Quad_k) with transition matrix (replace RORO argmax)
upgrades.spec: Add engine/regime_hmm.py. Use hmmlearn (or statsmodels MS-ARIMA) to fit a 4-state Gaussian HMM on the daily [growth_score, inflation_score] from axes.py outputs (stored in data/regime/axes_history.parquet or reconstructed from conditions frame). States correspond empirically to the 4 quads. Output per day: P(Q1), P(Q2), P(Q3), P(Q4) summing to 1.0, plus the 4×4 transition matrix A and the expected time-in-regime 1/(1−A_kk). Feed P(Quad_k) to cross_asset_confirm.py and forex regime page as a distributional context read. The argmax of P(Quad_k) can be used as the point estimate to preserve backward-compatibility. Extend snapshot output with transition_probs and regime_uncertainty = 1 - max(P(Quad_k)). Files: new engine/regime_hmm.py; modify engine/run.py to call it after axes; write data/regime/hmm_probs.json.
deps: axes.py daily output history needed — ensure it is being stored

upgrades.title: Base-effect 2nd-derivative forward projection for growth and inflation
upgrades.spec: Add engine/base_effect.py. Inputs: FRED series (ALFRED vintage-keyed via Alfred API — use ALFRED observation_start + realtime_start to get point-in-time vintages; free API, no key required for vintage downloads of WEI, INDPRO, PCE). Method: (1) load the current YoY series (e.g. core_cpi_yoy); (2) extract the base period (same series 12m ago); (3) compute the deterministic base-effect path: for each of the next 3 quarters, project YoY assuming sequential momentum = current 3m annualized run-rate; (4) compute 2nd derivative of the projected YoY path = whether growth/inflation is accelerating or decelerating; (5) compare to the 'easy/tough comp' qualitative label. Output dict: {driver: str, current_yoy: float, base_path_3q: [float, float, float], projected_yoy_3q: [float, float, float], projected_2nd_deriv: [float, float, float], accelerating_forward: bool, easy_comp: bool}. Wire to rate_inflation_transmission.py current_state() as an extra block. This is the core deterministic edge missing from the system. Files: new engine/base_effect.py, new collector scripts/collect_alfred_vintage.py.
deps: ALFRED API access (free, no key) — verify with a test fetch against PCEPILFE vintage

upgrades.title: Regime-conditional expected-value ranker for cross-asset (L3 core)
upgrades.spec: Add engine/conditional_ev.py. Inputs: (a) daily P(Quad_k) from regime_hmm.py; (b) historical per-asset returns from yahoo store (SPY, QQQ, IWM, XLF, XLE, XLK, XLU, XLRE, XLB, XLY, XLP, XLV, GC=F, HG=F, TLT, EEM, BTC-USD); (c) historical regime labels (argmax quad from axes.py). Method: (1) for each asset a and each quad k, estimate mu_{a,k} = mean 63d forward return conditioned on regime=k using POINT-IN-TIME labels (ensure the regime label at t uses no data after t); (2) compute E[r_a] = sum_k P(Quad_k) * mu_{a,k}; (3) compute CVaR_{a} similarly (5th pctile of the forward return distribution conditional on P-weighted regime mix); (4) rank by E[r]/CVaR. This directly implements the blueprint L3 'Hubble ranker'. Output: per-asset {ev, cvar, ev_cvar_ratio, dominant_quad_contribution, n_obs_per_quad}. Wire to cross_asset_confirm.py to_brain dict and display on bonds/forex pages. Files: new engine/conditional_ev.py; depends on regime_hmm.py (P0 above) and point-in-time regime labels.
deps: sufficient history per quad — verify n_obs_per_quad >= 30 before publishing

upgrades.title: Point-in-time ALFRED vintage collection for inflation/growth data

Use ALFRED API (https://api.stlouisfed.org/fred/series/observations?series_id=PCEPILFE&realtime_start=YYYY-MM-DD&realtime_end=YYYY-MM-DD&api_key=...) to pull point-in-time vintages for: core PCE (PCEPILFE), headline CPI (CPIAUCSL), WEI (WEI), INDPRO, NFP (PAYEMS). This eliminates look-ahead bias in the transmission calibration and makes the forward-IC estimates point-in-time honest. upgrades.title: Forward vol surface: HAR-RV + MOVE term structure + IV-RV premium
upgrades.spec: Extend engine/bonds.py bonds_frame() and bonds_snapshot() with: (a) HAR-RV forward vol for MOVE: fit HAR(RV_1d, RV_5d, RV_22d) on historical MOVE daily changes, predict 5d and 22d forward MOVE vol with a confidence interval (OLS + HC3 SE); (b) IV-RV premium: compare MOVE level to the realized vol of US10y daily changes over the trailing 22d — premium = MOVE − realized*sqrt(252); (c) if CBOE MOVE term structure data is available (front vs back contracts), add the term slope. Add to bonds_snapshot() as a new 'vol_forward' block with fields: {har_rv_5d_pred, har_rv_22d_pred, har_rv_ci_lo, har_rv_ci_hi, iv_rv_premium_bp, term_slope}. Wire to cross_asset_confirm.py caution_flags as a new 'rates_vol_forward' flag when har_rv_5d_pred > 1.3 × current MOVE. Files: modify engine/bonds.py bonds_frame() (add HAR-RV columns) and bonds_snapshot().

upgrades.title: Validated DSR/PBO on forex scenario empirical probabilities
upgrades.spec: Add scripts/validate_forex_scenarios.py. For each of the 6 scenarios in forex_regime.py: (1) load the full history of intensity and outcome (Y) series from the calibration run; (2) compute the Information Coefficient (rank-IC) of intensity_t vs Y_t with purged K-fold (k=5, embargo=N days = scenario's forward window); (3) compute Deflated Sharpe Ratio (DSR) treating a threshold-triggered binary strategy as a return stream — SR_deflated = SR * sqrt(1 - gamma(3/2)*SR^2 / (n-1))^(1/2) adjusted for the number of strategy variations tested (6 scenarios × ~5 threshold choices = ~30); (4) compute Probability of Backtest Overfitting (PBO) via combinatorial symmetric cross-validation. Write results to data/forex/scenario_validation.json; update forex_regime.py scenario output to carry dsratio, rank_ic_purged, pbo_pctile fields. Flag scenarios where DSR < 0.5 or PBO > 0.5 as 'unvalidated' in the UI. Files: new scripts/validate_forex_scenarios.py, modify engine/forex_regime.py scenario output.
deps: mlfinlab or manual implementation of purged-CV and DSR (no external dep strictly required — implement from Bailey-de Prado formulas)

upgrades.title: EBP (Excess Bond Premium) as a scored leading leg — verify and promote

gaps: L1 — No base-effect / 2nd-derivative growth/inflation projection for BTC-specific macro regime. The net-liquidity score is a level+slope z-score (first derivative), not a forward 2nd-derivative forecast. Global M2 YoY is a level, not a base-effect-adjusted acceleration. No Kalman/DFM-style mixed-frequency nowcast with variance output exists for the liquidity axis.

L2 — Regime is a hard argmax discrete index (0-100 mapped to 5 bands) with fixed apriori weights. No Markov-switching / HMM giving P(regime_k) each day. No transition matrix P(quad_j | quad_i). No time-in-regime hazard function. The regime_ledger (data/vector/regime_ledger.json) shows 0 matured rows — zero prospective validation of the regime labels themselves.

L3 — No conditional expected-value engine integrated with regime probabilities. forward_cones() (btc_recommend.py:47-95) conditions on composite_state but returns empirical quantiles of PRICE returns, not E[r_a] = sum_k P(Quad_k)*mu_{a,k}*intensity_k. Conditioning falls back to risk_index band (25-point buckets) and then to all-history when composite_state cell has <40 obs. No intensity weighting by regime conviction magnitude.

L4 — Volatility surface representation is close-to-close only for the main signals. btc_signals.options() computes DVOL (2021+ only), VRP, IV term structure, skew, gamma flip — but DVOL is CONTEXT-ONLY in calibration.json (verdict EXTREMES, shallow history). Realized vol uses Yang-Zhang style only at intraday via Parkinson estimator from hourly bars (btc_inputs.py:59-67), not applied to the main daily composite. No HAR-RV forward vol model. No quantile-regression forward range with coverage measurement. Forward cones use empirical quantiles of close-to-close returns as point estimates without any distributional model (heuristic_cone flag).

L5 — Mechanical-flow front-running is partially present (GEX gamma_flip from Deribit snapshot, CTA via midterm_blackout calendar, OI/funding leverage_stress) but not systematically integrated: gamma_flip is display context (btc_signals.py:758-759), vol-control roll-off schedule (high-vol days aging out of trailing window) is absent, CTA trend flip levels are not modeled. The impulse radar (btc_impulse_radar.py) covers some of this but admits the 2026-06-24 options-calm flush was missed entirely (documented blind spot in the code comments).

L6 — Validation is partial. calibration.json uses pre/post 2021-01-01 split monotonicity + hit rates (win-rate-not-expectancy flag: no profit_factor, no expectancy, no maximum adverse excursion per signal). Meta-label DSR=0.95 but skill score is negative (DO NOT WIRE LIVE). Timing overlay DSR survives but delta_Sharpe=-0.431 vs buy-hold baseline. No purged K-fold + embargo on the composite index itself (only on meta-label). No PBO (probability of backtest overfitting) computed for the regime composite. No rank-IC scorecard broken out by realized regime bucket AND VIX bucket. Triple-barrier label is used but calibration reliability diagram (data/vector/meta_label.json:966-1033) shows systematic overconfidence in high-probability bins (pred=0.935, obs=0.655 in the top bin).

L7 — Portfolio construction is a stepped grid {0, 0.5, 1.0} × conviction_multiplier × drawdown_brake (btc_signals.py:529-547), not HRP / Black-Litterman. No CVaR constraint. No regime-driven gross/net dial. The drawdown_brake is an enforced path-dependent cap but it is a heuristic decay function (1 - decay*(dd-threshold)) rather than a CVaR-budgeted optimizer. Kelly sizing exists (btc_recommend.py line 132) but the Kelly fraction is sourced from a separate kelly module not examined — unclear if it uses the calibrated probability or the raw model output (which has negative Brier skill).

DATA INTEGRITY — All FRED series (WALCL, RRPONTSYD, TGA, DFII10, BAMLH0A0HYM2, VIXCLS, yield curve) are pulled as latest-revision with no ALFRED/Philly Fed vintage protection. WALCL is weekly and forward-filled, creating the correlation-calendar artifact documented in btc_correlation_regime.py:9. No vintage-aware or point-in-time flag exists anywhere in the pipeline.

CYCLE THESIS (btc_cycle_thesis.py) — n=3 completed cycles. The module honestly flags this but the bottom-window parameters (_WIN_LEAD_D=360, _WIN_TRAIL_D=430) are not distribution-sampled — a single ±35d uniform window around the 371d mean. No Bayesian updating of the halving-to-bottom lag distribution as each new data point arrives. The dampening flag threshold (_DAMPEN_GAP=0.15) is fixed, not calibrated to the observed variance of prior cycle bears.

IMPULSE RADAR (btc_impulse_radar.py) — UP gauge has only one validated act-leg (U1 sopr washout). The code comments explicitly document that all three act legs (D1, D2, D3) missed the 2026-06-24 options-calm flush. No pre-emptive up-precursor survived adversarial verification. The radar has no false-positive rate measurement or DSR/PBO.

CONDITIONAL BETA — btc_master.py:165 uses corr_spx as a beta proxy (_tanh(ba, 0.6)) but the code reads 'beta_asym' from the signals DataFrame. No asymmetric beta decomposition (up-market vs down-market beta) is implemented as a proper regression — it uses rolling correlation of returns as a proxy. Asymmetric beta (down-beta higher than up-beta) is the core BTC institutional risk characteristic and should drive sizing, not be a minor display axis at weight=0.3.

upgrades.title: L3: Regime-conditional expected-value ranker integrated with P(state)
upgrades.spec: Add engine/btc_conditional_ev.py. For each composite_state label (ACCUMULATE/RISK-ON/NEUTRAL/RISK-OFF/DISTRIBUTE), compute mu_{a,k} = empirical mean 30d/90d forward return from calibration.json forward_paths conditioned on that state. Integrate: E[r] = sum_k P(state_k) * mu_{state_k}. Also compute CVaR_{95} per state from calibration data. upgrades.title: L4: Yang-Zhang OHLC realized vol + HAR-RV forward vol with coverage measurement
upgrades.spec: In btc_signals.py options() or a new engine/btc_vol_surface.py: (1) replace the Parkinson-daily / close-to-close RV with Yang-Zhang estimator using daily OHLC (requires open price from btc_inputs load_price — already available). YZ = (0.383*(log(H/L))^2 + 0.361*(log(C/O))^2 - 0.019*(log(H/O)*log(H/C)+log(L/O)*log(L/C))) * (252/n). (2) Add HAR-RV model: RV_{t+h} = a + b*RV_{t,d} + c*RV_{t,w} + d*RV_{t,m} + e (OLS, rolling 500-bar expanding window). Forward vol forecast for h=7,30,90d. (3) Add forward range as empirical quantile of daily_range conditioned on HAR-RV forecast band — emit em_upper/em_lower with coverage% measured on holdout (target 68% for 1-sigma band, test on post-2021 holdout). Emit yz_rv, har_rv_7d, har_rv_30d, range_coverage_pct to signals.parquet.

upgrades.title: L5: Vol-control roll-off schedule and CTA trend flip level computation
upgrades.spec: Add engine/btc_mechanical_flow.py. (1) Vol-control roll-off: compute trailing 21d realized vol daily. (2) CTA trend flip: compute CTA trend-following position proxy as a function of 20d/60d/120d moving average crossover signals on BTC. current_method:
All four engines (China, HK, Canada, Intl) share a single structural template:

**Inputs -> Feature Frame -> Axis Scores -> Argmax Quad -> Overlays -> Output JSON**

CHINA (engine/china_regime.py + china_axes.py, config ~3960):
- Inputs: parquet store groups `china` (Yahoo prices), `china_macro` (Eastmoney JSON: PMI/CPI/PPI/M2/IndPro/LPR), `china_breadth` (Sina breadth), `china_connect` (Stock Connect flows). Monthly macro is forward-filled up to 40 calendar days (china_inputs.py:94).
- Growth axis (china_axes.py:53-61): 6 components — pmi_mfg (NBS level vs 50.0, deadband 0.3, weight 1.0), pmi_nonmfg (level vs 50, weight 0.5), indpro_trend (63d diff sign, weight 0.25 — demoted after split-half flip), cyclical_defensive (slope_z of 5-ETF cyc / 3-ETF def ratio, weight 1.0), smallcap_largecap (510500/510300, weight 0.25 — demoted after flip), breadth_direction (pct_above_50 slope_z, weight 0.5).
- Inflation axis (china_axes.py:62-67): 3 components — cpi_direction (63d diff sign, weight 1.0), ppi_direction (63d diff sign, weight 1.5 — strongest/most stable signal), inflation_beta_basket (nonferrous+coal / semis+tech slope_z, weight 0.25 — demoted after flip).
- Scoring machinery (engine/indicators.py via china_axes): slope_window=20d, baseline_window=60d, z_threshold=0.45; score_from_z maps |z|>0.45 to +/-1, else 0. Available-weight renormalization. min_components=2 (confidence zeroed below this).
- Regime: raw_quad(g,i) argmax (g>=0 and i<0 -> Q1 Goldilocks, etc.); apply_hysteresis with hysteresis_days=7, shock_override_z=0.85 (config:3987-3988).
- Liquidity overlay (china_regime.py:22-36): M2 YoY 63d rate-of-change (>0.2 expanding, <-0.2 contracting); SHIBOR 3M 20d diff<-0.05 additional easing tilt. Display-only, not scored into quad.
- Cycle tag (china_regime.py:39-55): near_high = within 3% of 60d high; low_base = within 10% of 252d low; early/late/mid/unknown.
- regime_confidence = mean(growth_confidence, inflation_confidence). Confidence = |axis_score| * agreement, where agreement = max(n_pos, n_neg) / n_nonzero.
- W_REGIME=0.40 in china_masterminds.py:89 (credit/vol/margin derisk gates). China trend downweighted vs US (W_TREND=0.30 vs US 0.45).

HK (engine/hk_regime.py + hk_axes.py, config ~4301):

Growth axis uses China PMI (weight 1.0), hshare_hsi = HSCEI/HSI ratio (weight 1.0), tech_hsi (weight 0.75, 2020+), cyclical/defensive (HK constituent baskets, weight 1.0), breadth_direction (weight 0.5), copper/gold global growth (weight 0.75). Output: global_score, risk_state (Risk-on/off/Neutral), peg_distance/pressure/state. Attached as overlays in hk_regime:109-113.

INTL (engine/intl_regime.py, 24 countries, config ~4722):

- Uniform inflation axis weights: cpi_direction=1.5, oil_trend=0.75, yield_trend(10y)=0.75.

DATA PROVENANCE: ALL macro inputs (China: Eastmoney JSON; Canada: BoC VALET + StatsCan; Intl: FRED OECD CSV + ECB) are latest-revision only. No ALFRED real-time vintages. No point-in-time replay. Monthly prints are forward-filled (up to 40d for China PMI/CPI, 130d for quarterly GDP, 260d for LPR). All price data is Yahoo Finance adjusted-close (dividend-adjusted). No intraday or high-frequency nowcast data.
